WITH
-- ── 1. THÔNG TIN MÃ CK + GIÁ + NGÀNH + CHỈ SỐ ──────────────────────────
co_phieu AS (
 SELECT
    s.symbol                        AS ma_ck,
    s.FloorCode                     AS floor_code,
    s.stocktype,
  cat.industry_name               AS ten_nganh,  
    CASE s.FloorCode
        WHEN '10' THEN 'HOSE'
        WHEN '02' THEN 'HNX'
        WHEN '04' THEN 'UPCOM'
        WHEN '03' THEN 'FDS'
        WHEN '06' THEN 'CorpBond'
    END                              AS ten_san,
    CASE
        WHEN s.FloorCode IN ('02', '04', '03') 
            THEN DECODE(s.StockType, '4', 'HĐTL') || DECODE(s.underlyingSymbol, 'GB05', 'TPCP', 'GB10', 'TPCP', s.underlyingSymbol)
        ELSE NULL
    END                              AS loai_phai_sinh,
    s.underlyingsymbol               AS San_pham_phai_sinh,
    s.MaturityDate                   AS ngay_dao_han,
    s.reference                      AS gia_tham_chieu,
    s.closePrice                     AS gia_dong_cua,
    s.change                         AS thay_doi_gia,
    CASE
        WHEN s.reference IS NULL OR s.reference = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND((s.change / s.reference) * 100, 2)
    END                              AS pct_thay_doi
--    ,mk.indexName                    AS chi_so
--         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
--                PARTITION BY s.tradingdate, s.symbol
--                ORDER BY s.TRADINGTIME DESC, SEQUENCE ASC 
--            ) AS rn
FROM uat_mdds_stg.tmp_jad_stockinfor_eod s
--LEFT JOIN uat_mdds_stg.JAD_CSIDXINFOR idx
--    ON idx.Symbol       = s.symbol
--   AND date_format (idx.tradingdate , 'yyyyMMdd') = :Ngay_gd
--LEFT JOIN uat_mdds_stg.tmp_JAD_MARKETINFOR_eod mk
--        on mk.marketcode = idx.indexcode
--        AND date_format (mk.tradingdate , 'yyyyMMdd') = :Ngay_gd
LEFT JOIN uat_ids_stg.company_profiles cp
        ON cp.equity_ticker    = s.symbol
        and date_format( cp.ds_snpst_dt, 'yyyyMMdd') = :Ngay_gd
LEFT JOIN uat_ids_stg.categories cat
        ON cat.id           = cp.category_l1_id
        AND cat.active_flg  = 1
        AND date_format( cat.ds_snpst_dt, 'yyyyMMdd') =  :Ngay_gd
WHERE 1=1
  AND date_format(to_date(s.TradingDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd') = :Ngay_gd
  AND s.FloorCode   IN ('10', '02', '04', '03')
  AND  NOT  (
    (s.floorcode = '02'  AND s.stocktype  in (1,4))
    OR
    (s.floorcode = '10' AND s.stocktype = 1)
)
--  AND s.symbol = 'ABC'
--  AND s.STOCKTYPE = '4'
)
--where rn =1,
,so_lenh AS (
    -- HOSE: Market ID thực tế dùng 'STK', 'STO', 'UPX'
    SELECT
    t.SYMBOL                                                                AS symbol,
--    date_format(to_date(t.TRADE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd'),
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
             THEN t.EXECUTION_VOLUME                    ELSE 0 END)        AS tong_kl,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
             THEN CAST(REPLACE(t.EXECUTION_VALUE, ',', '') AS DECIMAL(38,2))
             ELSE 0 END)                                                    AS tong_gt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
                  AND t.BOARD_TYPE IN ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')
             THEN t.EXECUTION_VOLUME                    ELSE 0 END)        AS tong_kl_tt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
                  AND t.BOARD_TYPE IN ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')
             THEN CAST(REPLACE(t.EXECUTION_VALUE, ',', '') AS DECIMAL(38,2))
             ELSE 0 END)                                                                                                      AS tong_gt_tt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
                  AND t.BUY_FOREIGNER_INVESTOR_TYPE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.EXECUTION_VOLUME                    ELSE 0 END)        AS kl_nn_mua,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
                  AND t.SELL_FOREIGNER_INVESTOR_TYPE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.EXECUTION_VOLUME                    ELSE 0 END)        AS kl_nn_ban,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
                  AND t.BUY_FOREIGNER_INVESTOR_TYPE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.EXECUTION_Value                  ELSE 0 END)        AS gt_nn_mua,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
                  AND t.SELL_FOREIGNER_INVESTOR_TYPE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.EXECUTION_Value                    ELSE 0 END)        AS gt_nn_ban
FROM uat_ordertrade_stg.trade_book_hose t
WHERE 1=1
        AND t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
--        AND t.BOARD_TYPE IN ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')--- NEU LA THOA THUAN
--        and symbol = 'SHB' 
   AND date_format(to_date(t.TRADE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd') = :Ngay_gd
GROUP BY t.SYMBOL
union all 
SELECT
    t.ISSUE_CODE                                                            AS symbol,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
             THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY                                    ELSE 0 END) AS tong_kl,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
             THEN CAST(t.TRADE_PRICE AS NUMERIC) * t.TRADE_QUANTITY   ELSE 0 END) AS tong_gt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                  AND t.BOARD_ID IN ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')
             THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY                                    ELSE 0 END) AS tong_kl_tt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                  AND t.BOARD_ID IN ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')
             THEN CAST(t.TRADE_PRICE AS NUMERIC) * t.TRADE_QUANTITY   ELSE 0 END) AS tong_gt_tt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                  AND t.BUY_FOREIGN_INVESTOR_TYPE_CODE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY                                    ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_mua,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                  AND t.SELL_FOREIGN_INVESTOR_TYPE_CODE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY                                    ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_ban,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                  AND t.BUY_FOREIGN_INVESTOR_TYPE_CODE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY  * trade_price                               ELSE 0 END) AS gt_nn_mua,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                  AND t.SELL_FOREIGN_INVESTOR_TYPE_CODE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY * trade_price                                 ELSE 0 END) AS gt_nn_ban
 from uat_ordertrade_stg.trade_book_hnx t
 where 1=1 
--AND t.BOARD_ID IN ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')--- NEU LA THOA THUAN
t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
AND t.trade_date  = :Ngay_gd 
group by  t.ISSUE_CODE
),
-- ── 3. GỘP HOSE + HNX THEO MÃ ───────────────────────────────────────────
so_lenh_agg AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        SUM(tong_kl)                        AS tong_kl,
        SUM(tong_gt)                        AS tong_gt,
        SUM(tong_kl_tt)                     AS tong_kl_tt,
        SUM(tong_gt_tt)                     AS tong_gt_tt,
        SUM(kl_nn_mua)                      AS kl_nn_mua,
        SUM(kl_nn_ban)                      AS kl_nn_ban,
        SUM(kl_nn_mua) - SUM(kl_nn_ban)    AS klnn_rong,
        SUM(gt_nn_mua)                      AS gt_nn_mua,
        SUM(gt_nn_ban)                      AS gt_nn_ban,
        SUM(gt_nn_mua) - SUM(gt_nn_ban)    AS gtnn_rong
    FROM so_lenh
    GROUP BY symbol
)
-- ── KẾT QUẢ CUỐI ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
SELECT
    c.ma_ck,
    c.ten_san,
    c.ten_nganh,
--    c.chi_so,
    c.loai_phai_sinh,
    c.stocktype,
    c.ngay_dao_han,
    :Ngay_gd                            AS ngay_gd,
    c.gia_tham_chieu,
    c.gia_dong_cua,
    c.thay_doi_gia,
    c.pct_thay_doi,
    COALESCE(sl.tong_kl,    0)          AS tong_kl,
    COALESCE(sl.tong_gt,    0)          AS tong_gt,
--    COALESCE(sl.tong_kl_ps, 0)         AS tong_kl_phai_sinh,
--    COALESCE(sl.tong_gt_ps, 0)         AS tong_gt_phai_sinh,
    COALESCE(sl.tong_kl_tt, 0)         AS tong_kl_thoa_thuan,
    COALESCE(sl.tong_gt_tt, 0)         AS tong_gt_thoa_thuan,
        COALESCE(sl.kl_nn_mua,  0)         AS kl_nn_mua,
        COALESCE(sl.kl_nn_ban,  0)         AS kl_nn_ban,
        COALESCE(sl.gt_nn_mua,  0)         AS gt_nn_mua,
        COALESCE(sl.gt_nn_ban,  0)         AS gt_nn_ban,
        COALESCE(sl.gtnn_rong,  0)         AS gtnn_rong,
    COALESCE(sl.klnn_rong,  0)         AS klnn_rong
FROM co_phieu           c
LEFT JOIN so_lenh_agg   sl ON sl.symbol = c.ma_ck
where 1=1
--and c.ten_san = 'HOSE'
--and c.ma_ck = 'ABW'
ORDER BY c.Floor_Code, c.ma_ck;
;

SELECT
    s.symbol,
    s.floorcode,
    s.stocktype,
    CASE
        WHEN s.floorcode = 'HNX'  AND s.stocktype = '1'            THEN 'Trái phiếu'
        WHEN s.floorcode = 'HNX'  AND s.stocktype = '2'            THEN 'Cổ phiếu'
        WHEN s.floorcode = 'HNX'  AND s.stocktype = '3'            THEN ''Chứng chỉ quỹ' - HNX không có CCQ
        WHEN s.floorcode = 'HNX'  AND s.stocktype IN ('5','6')     THEN 'chứng quyền'--- HNX không có chứng quyền'

        WHEN s.floorcode = 'HOSE' AND s.stocktype = '2'            THEN 'Cổ phiếu'
        WHEN s.floorcode = 'HOSE' AND s.stocktype = '3'            THEN 'Chứng chỉ quỹ'
        WHEN s.floorcode = 'HOSE' AND s.stocktype = '4'            THEN 'Chứng quyền'
        ELSE 'Không xác định'
    END AS loai_chung_khoan
FROM security_master s;

with HNX_UPCOM as 
(
SELECT
    t.[Issue Code]                  AS symbol,
    t.[Trade date]                  AS ngay_gd,
        Market ID,                                                                         
    -- KL NN mua: dòng mà BÊN MUA là nước ngoài
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Buy Foreign Investor Type Code] IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.[Trade quantity] ELSE 0 END)    AS kl_nn_mua,

    -- KL NN bán: dòng mà BÊN BÁN là nước ngoài
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Sell Foreign Investor Type Code] IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.[Trade quantity] ELSE 0 END)    AS kl_nn_ban
FROM Trade_HNX t
WHERE t.[Trade date] = :ngay_gd
  AND t.[Market ID] IN ('STX','UPX')       -- HNX niêm yết + UPCOM, loại trừ DVX/BDX/HCX
GROUP BY t.[Issue Code], t.[Trade date],Market ID
),
HOSE as 
(
SELECT
    t.Symbol,
    t.[Trade Date]                  AS ngay_gd,
        Market ID,
    -- KL NN mua: dòng mà BÊN MUA là nước ngoài
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Buy - Foreigner Investor type] IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.[Execution - Volume] ELSE 0 END)    AS kl_nn_mua,

    -- KL NN bán: dòng mà BÊN BÁN là nước ngoài
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Sell - Foreigner Investor type] IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.[Execution - Volume] ELSE 0 END)    AS kl_nn_ban,
FROM TRADE_BOOK_HOSE t
WHERE t.[Trade Date] = :ngay_gd
AND t.[Market ID] = 'STO'    
GROUP BY t.Symbol, t.[Trade Date],Market ID;
)
--Tính từng sàn
SELECT 
  marketid,
  tradedate,
  kl_nn_mua,
  kl_nn_ban,
  (kl_nn_mua - kl_nn_ban) AS kl_nn_rong
FROM (SELECT * FROM HNX_UPCOM UNION ALL SELECT * FROM HOSE)
UNION ALL
--Tính toàn thị trường
SELECT 
  'TOTAL' marketid,
  tradedate,
  SUM(kl_nn_mua) AS kl_nn_mua,
  SUM(kl_nn_ban) AS kl_nn_ban,
  SUM(kl_nn_mua) - SUM(kl_nn_ban) AS kl_nn_rong
FROM (SELECT * FROM HNX_UPCOM UNION ALL SELECT * FROM HOSE)
GROUP BY tradedate

                        s.couponrate                     AS lai_suat,
                        s.yield                         AS ytm_binh_quan,

----------------------------------------------------------------------TẠI NGÀY THEO H --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
WITH MDDS_raw AS (
    SELECT 
        s.floorCode                    AS san,
        s.symbol                       AS ma_chung_khoan,
--        idx.indexCode                  AS ma_chi_so,
        s.StockType,
        s.underlyingSymbol,
        DECODE(s.StockType, '4', 'HĐTL') || DECODE(s.underlyingSymbol, 'GB05', 'TPCP', 'GB10', 'TPCP', s.underlyingSymbol) AS loai_phai_sinh,
        TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay_gd,
        s.TRADINGTIME                  AS tradingtime,
        s.""OPEN""                       AS Gia_mo_cua,
        s.""HIGH""                       AS Gia_cao_nhat,
        s.""LOW""                        AS Gia_thap_nhat,
        s.closePrice                   AS Gia_dong_cua,
        s.reference                    AS Gia_tham_chieu,
        s.change                       AS Thay_doi,
        ROUND((s.change / NULLIF(s.reference, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pct_bien_dong,
        CASE 
            WHEN :loai_gtgd = 'THOA_THUAN' THEN s.pt_total_traded_qtty
            WHEN :loai_gtgd = 'KHOP_LENH'  THEN s.totaltrading - s.pt_total_traded_qtty
            ELSE s.totaltrading
        END                             AS kl_luy_ke_theo_loc
    FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR s
--    JOIN JAD_CSIDXINFOR idx ON idx.Symbol = s.symbol
    WHERE 1=1
--      AND s.symbol = 'MBB'   
      AND s.FloorCode   IN ('10', '02', '04', '03')
            AND s.StockType  NOT IN ('1')
--      AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') = :ngay_gd
),
MDDS AS (
    SELECT
        m.*,
        COALESCE(
            LEAD(m.kl_luy_ke_theo_loc) OVER (ORDER BY m.tradingtime) - m.kl_luy_ke_theo_loc,
            m.kl_luy_ke_theo_loc - LAG(m.kl_luy_ke_theo_loc) OVER (ORDER BY m.tradingtime),
            m.kl_luy_ke_theo_loc
        ) AS kl_tai_thoi_diem,
        (
            SELECT jm.MARKETINDEX                    
            FROM JAD_MARKETINFOR jm
            WHERE jm.MARKETID = '10'
--              AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(jm.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') = :ngay_gd
              AND jm.INDEXTIME <= m.tradingtime
            ORDER BY jm.INDEXTIME DESC
            FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
        ) AS gia_vnindex
    FROM MDDS_raw m
),
Ky_bao_cao AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        m.ngay_gd,
        CASE WHEN CEIL(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.ngay_gd,'MM')) / 3.0) = 1 
             THEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.ngay_gd,'YYYY')) - 1 ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.ngay_gd,'YYYY')) END AS report_year,
        CASE WHEN CEIL(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.ngay_gd,'MM')) / 3.0) = 1 
             THEN 4 ELSE CEIL(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.ngay_gd,'MM')) / 3.0) - 1 END AS report_quarter
    FROM MDDS m
),
Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd,
        statement_cd,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
            SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) AS statement_cd,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    cd.company_profile_id,
                    cd.report_year,
                    cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY
                    CASE
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
                    END,
                    cd.submission_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM gms_ids_uat.company_data cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms f
            ON f.id = cd.form_id
           AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND f.form_cd LIKE '%QUAR'
          AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')
          AND cd.submission_date <= ts.den_ngay
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM gms_ids_uat.violation_report vr
              JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf
                  ON vf.id = vr.form_id
                 AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
              WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year
                AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                AND vr.base_date <= ts.den_ngay
                AND vr.language_cd = 'VI'
          )
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* LNST theo từng kỳ BCTC */
LNST AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        lnst,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cdc.company_profile_id,
            cp.equity_ticker,
            cdc.report_year,
            cdc.report_quarter,
            d.data_value AS lnst,
            cdc.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    d.company_profile_id,
                    d.report_year,
                    d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY
                    d.updated_date DESC NULLS LAST,
                    d.created_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp
            ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d
            ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
           AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
           AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc
            ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
           AND rc.financial_statement_cd = cdc.statement_cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr
            ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
           AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rcol
            ON rcol.col_cd = d.col_cd
           AND rcol.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        WHERE rcol.col_desc = '1'
          AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
          AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
          AND (
              (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) IN ('DN', 'BH')
               AND rr.row_desc = '60')
              OR (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD'
                  AND rr.row_desc = '21')
          )
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* Doanh thu theo từng kỳ BCTC */
Doanh_thu AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        doanh_thu,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cdc.company_profile_id,
            cp.equity_ticker,
            cdc.report_year,
            cdc.report_quarter,
            d.data_value AS doanh_thu,
            cdc.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    d.company_profile_id,
                    d.report_year,
                    d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY
                    d.updated_date DESC NULLS LAST,
                    d.created_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp
            ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d
            ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
           AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
           AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc
            ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
           AND rc.financial_statement_cd = cdc.statement_cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr
            ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
           AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rcol
            ON rcol.col_cd = d.col_cd
           AND rcol.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        WHERE rcol.col_desc = '1'
          AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
          AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
          AND (
              (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) IN ('DN', 'BH')
               AND rr.row_desc = '10')
              OR (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD'
                  AND rr.row_desc = '03')
          )
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    a.ma_chung_khoan, a.san, a.ma_chi_so AS chi_so, a.loai_phai_sinh,
    a.ngay_gd, a.tradingtime,
    a.Gia_mo_cua, a.Gia_cao_nhat, a.Gia_thap_nhat, a.Gia_dong_cua, a.Gia_tham_chieu,
    a.kl_tai_thoi_diem AS khoi_luong,
    a.gia_vnindex,
    kb.report_year, kb.report_quarter, dt.doanh_thu, ln.lnst AS loi_nhuan
FROM MDDS a
JOIN Ky_bao_cao kb ON kb.ngay_gd = a.ngay_gd
LEFT JOIN Doanh_thu dt ON dt.MCK = a.ma_chung_khoan AND dt.report_year = kb.report_year AND dt.report_quarter = kb.report_quarter
LEFT JOIN LNST ln ON ln.equity_ticker = a.ma_chung_khoan AND ln.report_year = kb.report_year AND ln.report_quarter = kb.report_quarter
ORDER BY a.tradingtime;

WITH Lich_giao_dich AS (
    -- Lịch giao dịch của mã CK, đánh số lùi từ :den_ngay
    SELECT
        ngay,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ngay DESC) AS rn
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay
        FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR s
        WHERE s.symbol = :ma_ck
          AND TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
    )
),
Khoang_thoi_gian AS (
    -- Xác định khoảng ngày theo bộ lọc: 5 NGÀY / 1 NĂM / TÙY CHỈNH
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN :loai_khoang = '5_NGAY'    THEN (SELECT MIN(ngay) FROM Lich_giao_dich WHERE rn <= 5)
            WHEN :loai_khoang = '1_NAM'     THEN (SELECT MIN(ngay) FROM Lich_giao_dich WHERE rn <= 252)
            WHEN :loai_khoang = 'TUY_CHINH' THEN TO_DATE(:tu_ngay_tuychinh, 'YYYYMMDD')
        END AS ngay_bat_dau,
        CASE
            WHEN :loai_khoang = 'TUY_CHINH' THEN TO_DATE(:den_ngay_tuychinh, 'YYYYMMDD')
            ELSE TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
        END AS ngay_ket_thuc
    FROM DUAL
),
-- MDDS theo NGÀY (mỗi ngày 1 dòng EOD, không phải intraday theo tradingtime)
MDDS AS (
    SELECT
        san, ma_chung_khoan, StockType, underlyingSymbol, loai_phai_sinh,
        ngay_gd,
        Gia_mo_cua, Gia_cao_nhat, Gia_thap_nhat, Gia_dong_cua, Gia_tham_chieu, Thay_doi, pct_bien_dong,
        kl_luy_ke_theo_loc AS khoi_luong   -- lấy nguyên KLGD cuối ngày (đã là tổng cả ngày, không cần LEAD/LAG)
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            s.floorCode                    AS san,
            s.symbol                       AS ma_chung_khoan,
            s.StockType,
            s.underlyingSymbol,
            DECODE(s.StockType, '4', 'HĐTL') || DECODE(s.underlyingSymbol, 'GB05', 'TPCP', 'GB10', 'TPCP', s.underlyingSymbol) AS loai_phai_sinh,
            TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay_gd,
            s.""OPEN""                       AS Gia_mo_cua,
            s.""HIGH""                       AS Gia_cao_nhat,
            s.""LOW""                        AS Gia_thap_nhat,
            s.closePrice                   AS Gia_dong_cua,
            s.reference                    AS Gia_tham_chieu,
            s.change                       AS Thay_doi,
            ROUND((s.change / NULLIF(s.reference, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pct_bien_dong,
            CASE 
                WHEN :loai_gtgd = 'THOA_THUAN' THEN s.pt_total_traded_qtty
                WHEN :loai_gtgd = 'KHOP_LENH'  THEN s.totaltrading - s.pt_total_traded_qtty
                ELSE s.totaltrading
            END                             AS kl_luy_ke_theo_loc,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY s.symbol, s.tradingdate
                ORDER BY s.TRADINGTIME DESC
            ) AS rn                                             -- ✅ lấy đúng snapshot CUỐI NGÀY
        FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR s
        WHERE s.symbol = :ma_ck
          AND s.FloorCode IN ('10', '02', '04', '03')
          AND s.StockType NOT IN ('1')

    FROM (
        SELECT 
            TO_DATE(jm.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay_gd,

                  (SELECT ngay_bat_dau  FROM Khoang_thoi_gian)

),
Ky_bao_cao AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        m.ngay_gd,
        CASE WHEN CEIL(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.ngay_gd,'MM')) / 3.0) = 1 
             THEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.ngay_gd,'YYYY')) - 1 ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.ngay_gd,'YYYY')) END AS report_year,
        CASE WHEN CEIL(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.ngay_gd,'MM')) / 3.0) = 1 
             THEN 4 ELSE CEIL(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.ngay_gd,'MM')) / 3.0) - 1 END AS report_quarter
    FROM MDDS m

SELECT 
    a.ma_chung_khoan, a.san, a.loai_phai_sinh,
    a.ngay_gd,
    a.Gia_mo_cua, a.Gia_cao_nhat, a.Gia_thap_nhat, a.Gia_dong_cua, a.Gia_tham_chieu, a.pct_bien_dong,

WITH MDDS_raw AS (
    SELECT 
        s.floorCode                    AS san,
        s.symbol                       AS ma_ck,
        s.fullname                     AS ten_ck,
        TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay_gd,
        s.TRADINGTIME                  AS tradingtime,
        s."OPEN"                       AS Gia_mo_cua,
        s."HIGH"                       AS Gia_cao_nhat,
        s."LOW"                        AS Gia_thap_nhat,
        s.closePrice                   AS Gia_dong_cua,
        s.reference                    AS Gia_tham_chieu,
        s.change                       AS Thay_doi,
        ROUND((s.change / NULLIF(s.reference, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pct_bien_dong,
        s.MaturityDate                  AS ngay_dao_han,
        s.couponrate                    AS lai_suat,
        s.yield                        AS ytm_binh_quan,
        CASE 
            WHEN :loai_gtgd = 'THOA_THUAN' THEN s.pt_total_traded_qtty
            WHEN :loai_gtgd = 'KHOP_LENH'  THEN s.totaltrading - s.pt_total_traded_qtty
            ELSE s.totaltrading
        END                             AS kl_luy_ke_theo_loc
    FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR s
    WHERE 1=1
--      AND s.symbol = 'VBA123036'
      AND s.FloorCode IN ('10', '02', '04', '03')
      AND s.StockType IN ('1')                                           
      AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') = :ngay_gd
),
MDDS AS (
    SELECT
        m.*,
        COALESCE(
            LEAD(m.kl_luy_ke_theo_loc) OVER (ORDER BY m.tradingtime) - m.kl_luy_ke_theo_loc,
            m.kl_luy_ke_theo_loc - LAG(m.kl_luy_ke_theo_loc) OVER (ORDER BY m.tradingtime),
            m.kl_luy_ke_theo_loc
        ) AS kl_tai_thoi_diem
    FROM MDDS_raw m
)
SELECT 
    a.ma_ck,
    a.ten_ck,
    a.san,
    a.ngay_gd,
    a.tradingtime,
    a.Gia_mo_cua,
    a.Gia_cao_nhat,
    a.Gia_thap_nhat,
    a.Gia_dong_cua,
    a.Gia_tham_chieu,
    a.pct_bien_dong,
    a.kl_tai_thoi_diem              AS khoi_luong,
    a.ngay_dao_han,
    a.lai_suat,
    a.ytm_binh_quan
FROM MDDS a
ORDER BY a.tradingtime;

WITH Lich_giao_dich AS (
    -- Lịch giao dịch của mã trái phiếu, đánh số lùi từ :den_ngay
    SELECT
        ngay,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ngay DESC) AS rn
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay
        FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR s
        WHERE s.symbol = :ma_ck
          AND TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
    )
),
Khoang_thoi_gian AS (
    -- Xác định khoảng ngày theo bộ lọc: 5 NGÀY / 1 NĂM / TÙY CHỈNH
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN :loai_khoang = '5_NGAY'    THEN (SELECT MIN(ngay) FROM Lich_giao_dich WHERE rn <= 5)
            WHEN :loai_khoang = '1_NAM'     THEN (SELECT MIN(ngay) FROM Lich_giao_dich WHERE rn <= 252)
            WHEN :loai_khoang = 'TUY_CHINH' THEN TO_DATE(:tu_ngay_tuychinh, 'YYYYMMDD')
        END AS ngay_bat_dau,
        CASE
            WHEN :loai_khoang = 'TUY_CHINH' THEN TO_DATE(:den_ngay_tuychinh, 'YYYYMMDD')
            ELSE TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
        END AS ngay_ket_thuc
    FROM DUAL
),
-- MDDS theo NGÀY (mỗi ngày 1 dòng EOD, không phải intraday theo tradingtime)
MDDS AS (
    SELECT
        san, ma_ck, ten_ck, ngay_gd,
        Gia_mo_cua, Gia_cao_nhat, Gia_thap_nhat, Gia_dong_cua, Gia_tham_chieu, Thay_doi, pct_bien_dong,
        ngay_dao_han, lai_suat, ytm_binh_quan,
        kl_luy_ke_theo_loc AS khoi_luong   -- snapshot cuối ngày = tổng KLGD cả ngày, không cần LEAD/LAG
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            s.floorCode                    AS san,
            s.symbol                       AS ma_ck,
            s.fullname                     AS ten_ck,
            TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay_gd,
            s."OPEN"                       AS Gia_mo_cua,
            s."HIGH"                       AS Gia_cao_nhat,
            s."LOW"                        AS Gia_thap_nhat,
            s.closePrice                   AS Gia_dong_cua,
            s.reference                    AS Gia_tham_chieu,
            s.change                       AS Thay_doi,
            ROUND((s.change / NULLIF(s.reference, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pct_bien_dong,
            s.MaturityDate                  AS ngay_dao_han,
            s.couponrate                    AS lai_suat,
            s.yield                        AS ytm_binh_quan,
            CASE 
                WHEN :loai_gtgd = 'THOA_THUAN' THEN s.pt_total_traded_qtty
                WHEN :loai_gtgd = 'KHOP_LENH'  THEN s.totaltrading - s.pt_total_traded_qtty
                ELSE s.totaltrading
            END                             AS kl_luy_ke_theo_loc,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY s.symbol, s.tradingdate
                ORDER BY s.TRADINGTIME DESC
            ) AS rn                                              
        FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR s
        WHERE s.symbol = :ma_ck
          AND s.FloorCode IN ('10', '02', '04', '03')
          AND s.StockType IN ('1')                               
          AND TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') BETWEEN 
                  (SELECT ngay_bat_dau  FROM Khoang_thoi_gian) 
              AND (SELECT ngay_ket_thuc FROM Khoang_thoi_gian)
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    a.ma_ck,
    a.ten_ck,
    a.san,
    a.ngay_gd,
    a.Gia_mo_cua,
    a.Gia_cao_nhat,
    a.Gia_thap_nhat,
    a.Gia_dong_cua,
    a.Gia_tham_chieu,
    a.pct_bien_dong,
    a.khoi_luong,
    a.ngay_dao_han,
    a.lai_suat,
    a.ytm_binh_quan
FROM MDDS a
ORDER BY a.ngay_gd;

WITH Gia_chi_so AS
(
    SELECT
        MARKETID,
        MARKETCODE          AS Chi_so,
        MARKETINDEX         AS Gia_dong_cua,
        HIGH                AS Gia_cao_nhat,
        LOW                 AS Gia_thap_nhat,
        ADVANCES            AS So_luong_ma_tang,
        DECLINES            AS So_luong_ma_giam,
        NOCHANGE            AS So_luong_ma_dung_gia,
        NUMBEROFCE          AS So_luong_ma_tang_tran,
        NUMBEROFFL          AS So_luong_ma_giam_san,
        INDEXTIME,
        totalVolume         AS tong_khoi_luong,
        totalValue          AS tong_gia_tri,
        PT_TOTAL_VALUE      AS tong_gia_tri_thoa_thuan,
        PT_TOTAL_TRADE      AS tong_khoi_luong_thoa_thuan,
                indexchange                        AS thay_doi,
                indexpercentchange  AS Thay_doi_perent
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            jm.MARKETID,
            jm.MARKETINDEX,
            jm.HIGH,
            jm.LOW,
            jm.ADVANCES,
            jm.DECLINES,
            jm.NOCHANGE,
            jm.NUMBEROFCE,
            jm.NUMBEROFFL,
            jm.INDEXTIME,
            jm.tradingdate,
            jm.MARKETCODE,
            jm.totalVolume,
            jm.totalValue,
            jm.PT_TOTAL_VALUE,
            jm.PT_TOTAL_TRADE,
                        indexchange,
                        indexpercentchange,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY tradingdate, marketCode
                ORDER BY indexTime DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM uat_mdds_stg.JAD_MARKETINFOR jm
        WHERE 1=1
                  AND TSCPRODGRPID in ('STO', 'STX', 'UPX')
          AND date_format(TO_DATE(tradingdate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd') = :ngay_gd
    )
    WHERE rn = 1  
),
so_lenh AS (
    -- HOSE: Market ID thực tế dùng 'STK', 'STO', 'UPX'
    SELECT
   idx.INDEXCODE,
--    date_format(to_date(t.TRADE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd'),
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
             THEN t.EXECUTION_VOLUME                    ELSE 0 END)        AS tong_kl,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
             THEN CAST(REPLACE(t.EXECUTION_VALUE, ',', '') AS DECIMAL(38,2))
             ELSE 0 END)                                                    AS tong_gt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
                  AND t.BOARD_TYPE IN ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')
             THEN t.EXECUTION_VOLUME                    ELSE 0 END)        AS tong_kl_tt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
                  AND t.BOARD_TYPE IN ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')
             THEN CAST(REPLACE(t.EXECUTION_VALUE, ',', '') AS DECIMAL(38,2))
             ELSE 0 END)                                                                                                      AS tong_gt_tt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
                  AND t.BUY_FOREIGNER_INVESTOR_TYPE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.EXECUTION_VOLUME                    ELSE 0 END)        AS kl_nn_mua,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
                  AND t.SELL_FOREIGNER_INVESTOR_TYPE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.EXECUTION_VOLUME                    ELSE 0 END)        AS kl_nn_ban,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
                  AND t.BUY_FOREIGNER_INVESTOR_TYPE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.EXECUTION_Value                  ELSE 0 END)        AS gt_nn_mua,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
                  AND t.SELL_FOREIGNER_INVESTOR_TYPE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.EXECUTION_Value                    ELSE 0 END)        AS gt_nn_ban
FROM uat_ordertrade_stg.trade_book_hose t
left JOIN uat_mdds_stg.JAD_CSIDXINFOR idx ON t.SYMBOL = idx.SYMBOL
WHERE 1=1
--	and symbol = 'SHB' 
   AND date_format(to_date(t.TRADE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd') = :Ngay_gd
   AND t.MARKET_ID = 'STK'  
    GROUP BY idx.INDEXCODE
union all 
SELECT
    idx.INDEXCODE ,              
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
             THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY                                    ELSE 0 END) AS tong_kl,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
             THEN CAST(t.TRADE_PRICE AS NUMERIC) * t.TRADE_QUANTITY   ELSE 0 END) AS tong_gt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                  AND t.BOARD_ID IN ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')
             THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY                                    ELSE 0 END) AS tong_kl_tt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                  AND t.BOARD_ID IN ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')
             THEN CAST(t.TRADE_PRICE AS NUMERIC) * t.TRADE_QUANTITY   ELSE 0 END) AS tong_gt_tt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                  AND t.BUY_FOREIGN_INVESTOR_TYPE_CODE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY                                    ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_mua,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                  AND t.SELL_FOREIGN_INVESTOR_TYPE_CODE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY                                    ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_ban,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                  AND t.BUY_FOREIGN_INVESTOR_TYPE_CODE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY  * trade_price                         ELSE 0 END) AS gt_nn_mua,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                  AND t.SELL_FOREIGN_INVESTOR_TYPE_CODE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY * trade_price                                 ELSE 0 END) AS gt_nn_ban
 from uat_ordertrade_stg.trade_book_hnx t
 left JOIN uat_mdds_stg.JAD_CSIDXINFOR idx ON t.issue_code  = idx.SYMBOL
 where 1=1 
AND date_format(to_date(t.TRADE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd') = :Ngay_gd
AND t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
group by  idx.INDEXCODE
),
KLNN AS (
    SELECT
        INDEXCODE,
        SUM(tong_kl)                        AS tong_kl,
        SUM(tong_gt)                        AS tong_gt,
        SUM(tong_kl_tt)                     AS tong_kl_tt,
        SUM(tong_gt_tt)                     AS tong_gt_tt,
        SUM(kl_nn_mua)                      AS kl_nn_mua,
        SUM(kl_nn_ban)                      AS kl_nn_ban,
        SUM(kl_nn_mua) - SUM(kl_nn_ban)    AS klnn_rong,
        SUM(gt_nn_mua)                      AS gt_nn_mua,
        SUM(gt_nn_ban)                      AS gt_nn_ban,
        SUM(gt_nn_mua) - SUM(gt_nn_ban)    AS gtnn_rong
    FROM so_lenh
    GROUP BY INDEXCODE
)
--select * from KLNN
,
so_co_phieu_luu_hanh AS (
   SELECT
        symbol,
        so_luong_cp_luu_hanh
    FROM (
        SELECT
            t.ticker_symbol AS symbol,
            t.outstanding_shares AS so_luong_cp_luu_hanh,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY t.ticker_symbol
                ORDER BY TO_DATE(t.snapshot_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM uat_vsdc_stg.outstanding_shares  t
        WHERE 1=1
          AND date_format(TO_DATE(t.snapshot_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd') <= :den_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)
--select * from SCPLH_ranked ;
,Gia_tung_ma AS 
(
   SELECT
        symbol,
        gia_dong_cua
    FROM (
        SELECT
            symbol,
            closePrice AS gia_dong_cua,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY symbol, tradingdate
                ORDER BY tradingtime DESC,sequence DESC
            ) AS rn
--            ,t.*
        FROM uat_mdds_stg.JAD_STOCKINFOR t
        WHERE date_format(to_date(t.tradingdate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd') = :ngay_gd
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
-- Vốn hóa TỪNG MÃ = Giá mã × KLLH mã (không phải giá chỉ số × KLLH mã như bản gốc)
Von_hoa_chi_so AS 
(
    SELECT INDEXCODE, SUM(von_hoa_ma) AS von_hoa
    from 
    (
    SELECT
        idx.INDEXCODE,
        g.symbol,
        g.gia_dong_cua * s.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh AS von_hoa_ma
    FROM Gia_tung_ma g
    JOIN so_co_phieu_luu_hanh s ON s.symbol = g.symbol
    JOIN uat_mdds_stg.JAD_CSIDXINFOR idx     ON idx.Symbol = g.symbol
    )
        GROUP BY INDEXCODE
)
--select * from Von_hoa_chi_so ;
SELECT 
    a.*, 
    b.tong_kl,
    b.tong_gt,
    b.kl_nn_mua,
    b.kl_nn_ban,
    b.klnn_rong,
    b.gtnn_rong,
    b.tong_kl_tt,
    b.tong_gt_tt,
    c.von_hoa
FROM Gia_chi_so a
left JOIN KLNN b     ON a.Chi_so = b.INDEXCODE
left JOIN Von_hoa_chi_so c  ON c.INDEXCODE = a.Chi_so;

    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN :loai_khoang = '3_THANG' THEN (SELECT MIN(ngay) FROM Lich_giao_dich WHERE rn <= 63)
            WHEN :loai_khoang = '6_THANG' THEN (SELECT MIN(ngay) FROM Lich_giao_dich WHERE rn <= 126)
            WHEN :loai_khoang = '9_THANG' THEN (SELECT MIN(ngay) FROM Lich_giao_dich WHERE rn <= 189)
            WHEN :loai_khoang = '1_NAM'   THEN (SELECT MIN(ngay) FROM Lich_giao_dich WHERE rn <= 252)
            WHEN :loai_khoang = '3_NAM'   THEN (SELECT MIN(ngay) FROM Lich_giao_dich WHERE rn <= 756)
            WHEN :loai_khoang = 'TAT_CA'  THEN (SELECT MIN(ngay) FROM Lich_giao_dich)
        END AS ngay_bat_dau,
        TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD') AS ngay_ket_thuc
    FROM DUAL
),

    SELECT marketCode, ngay_gd, diem_dong_cua

          AND TO_DATE(tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') BETWEEN
              (SELECT ngay_bat_dau FROM Khoang_thoi_gian) AND (SELECT ngay_ket_thuc FROM Khoang_thoi_gian)
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.ngay_gd, m.symbol ORDER BY s.ngay_bao_cao DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn

    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN ln.lnst_ttm IS NOT NULL THEN vh.von_hoa END)

    ) AS pe_chi_so,

--Bộ lọc tham số là <Từ ngày - Đến ngày>. Với công thức: 
--- % thay đổi giá:        (Giá đóng cửa <Đến ngày> - Giá đóng cửa <Từ ngày-1>) / Giá đóng cửa <Từ ngày-1> * 100
--- Giá        :                        Giá đóng cửa tại <Đến ngày>
--- KLGD:        Tổng KLGD trong khoảng <Từ ngày - Đến ngày>
--- Vốn hóa:        Giá đóng cửa tại Đến ngày × Số cổ phiếu lưu hành tại Đến ngày.
--- P/E:        P/E của mã tại Đến ngày.
--- P/B:        P/B của mã tại Đến ngày.
/* EOD từng mã; lấy snapshot cuối cùng trong ngày */
WITH
Gia_cuoi AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        ngay_gd,
        gia_dong_cua,
        ten_nganh,
        Thay_doi,
        pct_thay_doi
    FROM (
        SELECT
            s.symbol,
            date_format(to_date(s.TradingDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd') AS ngay_gd,
            s.closePrice AS gia_dong_cua,
            cat.industry_name               AS ten_nganh,  
            s.reference                                 Tham_chieu,
            s.change                                        Thay_doi,
            CASE
        WHEN s.reference IS NULL OR s.reference = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND((s.change / s.reference) * 100, 2)
    END                              AS pct_thay_doi,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY s.symbol, s.tradingdate
                ORDER BY s.tradingtime  DESC,s.`sequence` DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM uat_mdds_stg.JAD_STOCKINFOR s
        LEFT JOIN uat_ids_stg.company_profiles cp
                ON cp.equity_ticker    = s.symbol
            LEFT JOIN uat_ids_stg.categories cat
                ON cat.id           = cp.category_l1_id
                AND cat.active_flg  = 1
        WHERE date_format(to_date(s.TradingDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd') <= :den_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)

FROM (

                  AND t.BOARD_TYPE  NOT IN ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')
             THEN CAST(REPLACE(t.EXECUTION_VALUE, ',', '') AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS kl
    FROM uat_ordertrade_stg.trade_book_hose t
    WHERE date_format(TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd')
          BETWEEN :Tu_ngay AND :Đen_ngay

    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        t.issue_code AS symbol,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                  AND t.BOARD_ID NOT IN ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')
             THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY                                    ELSE 0 END) AS kl
    FROM uat_ordertrade_stg.trade_book_hnx t
    WHERE date_format(TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd')
          BETWEEN :Tu_ngay AND :Đen_ngay
      AND t.market_id IN ('STX', 'UPX')
)

    FROM (
        SELECT

                PARTITION BY t.ticker_symbol
                ORDER BY TO_DATE(t.snapshot_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') DESC

    )

),
Von_hoa AS (

        gc.gia_dong_cua AS gia_cuoi,
        k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh AS kllh,
        CASE
            WHEN gc.gia_dong_cua IS NOT NULL
             AND k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh IS NOT NULL
            THEN gc.gia_dong_cua * k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh
        END AS von_hoa
    FROM Gia_cuoi gc
    LEFT JOIN KLLH k
        ON k.symbol = gc.symbol

            ) x

WITH

    SELECT
        TO_DATE(:tu_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD') AS tu_ngay,
        TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD') AS den_ngay
    FROM DUAL
),

Gia_EOD AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        ngay_gd,
        gia_dong_cua,
		floorCode
    FROM (
        SELECT
            s.symbol,
            TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay_gd,
			floorCode,
            s.closePrice AS gia_dong_cua,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY s.symbol, s.tradingdate
                ORDER BY s.INDEXTIME DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR s
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') <= ts.den_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* Giá đóng cửa phiên gần nhất trước ngày bắt đầu */
Gia_dau AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        gia_dong_cua AS gia_dau
    FROM (
        SELECT
            g.symbol,
            g.gia_dong_cua,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY g.symbol
                ORDER BY g.ngay_gd DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Gia_EOD g
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE g.ngay_gd < ts.tu_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* Giá đóng cửa phiên gần nhất tại hoặc trước ngày kết thúc */
Gia_cuoi AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        gia_dong_cua,
        ngay_gd AS ngay_gia_cuoi,
		floorCode
    FROM (
        SELECT
            g.symbol,
            g.gia_dong_cua,
            g.ngay_gd,
			g.floorCode,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY g.symbol
                ORDER BY g.ngay_gd DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Gia_EOD g
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE g.ngay_gd <= ts.den_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* Tổng khối lượng giao dịch trong khoảng lọc */
KHGD AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        SUM(kl) AS tong_kl
    FROM (
        SELECT
            t.symbol,
            t.execution_volume AS kl
        FROM krx.trade_book_hose t
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
              BETWEEN ts.tu_ngay AND ts.den_ngay
          AND t.market_id = 'STK'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            t."Issue Code" AS symbol,
            t.trade_quantity AS kl
        FROM krx.trade_book_hnx t
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
              BETWEEN ts.tu_ngay AND ts.den_ngay
          AND t.market_id IN ('STX', 'UPX')
    )
    GROUP BY symbol
),

KLLH_asof AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        so_luong_cp_luu_hanh
    FROM (
        SELECT
            t.MCK AS symbol,
            t."Khối lượng chứng khoán đang lưu hành"
                AS so_luong_cp_luu_hanh,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY t.MCK
                ORDER BY TO_DATE(t."Ngày báo cáo", 'DD/MM/YYYY') DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM "BM 1_Báo cáo về khối lượng chứng khoán đang lưu hành" t
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE t.Loai_CK = 'Co phieu'
          AND TO_DATE(t."Ngày báo cáo", 'DD/MM/YYYY') <= ts.den_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
Von_hoa AS (
    SELECT
        gc.symbol,
        gc.gia_dong_cua AS gia_cuoi,
        k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh AS kllh,
        CASE
            WHEN gc.gia_dong_cua IS NOT NULL
             AND k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh IS NOT NULL
            THEN gc.gia_dong_cua * k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh
        END AS von_hoa
    FROM Gia_cuoi gc
    LEFT JOIN KLLH_asof k
        ON k.symbol = gc.symbol
),

WITH
/* BƯỚC 1:
   Xác định đúng 1 company_data cho mỗi NNT + kỳ:
   - Kỳ phải tồn tại trong violation_report với base_date <= :den_ngay
   - company_data phải APPROVED
   - Chỉ lấy HN/TH/ME/RI
   - Ưu tiên loại báo cáo: HN -> TH -> ME -> RI
   - Trong cùng loại báo cáo: lấy submission_date mới nhất
*/
Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd,
        submission_date
        ,SUBSTR(form_cd,1,2) STATEMENT_CD
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY CASE 	WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
							END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM gms_ids_uat.company_data cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND f.form_cd LIKE '%QUAR'
          AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM gms_ids_uat.violation_report vr
			  JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf ON vf.id = vr.form_id AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
              WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year
                AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                AND vr.base_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')

          )
		  		AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')
				AND cd.submission_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
				AND vr.LANGUAGE_CD = 'VI'
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
--SELECT * FROM Company_data_chuan 
--WHERE 1=1 
--AND company_profile_id = '1591';
/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 2:
   - Từ các kỳ hợp lệ ở trên, lấy LNST trong DATA
   - DATA join bằng: company_profile_id + report_year + report_quarter
   - Chỉ các kỳ thực sự có LNST mới tồn tại ở đây
   - Xếp thứ tự và lấy 4 kỳ LNST gần nhất
   ========================================================= */
LNST_4_ky AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        lnst
    FROM (
        SELECT x.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id ORDER BY x.report_year DESC, x.report_quarter DESC ) AS rn     
        FROM (
            SELECT
                cdc.company_profile_id,
                cp.equity_ticker,
                cdc.report_year,
                cdc.report_quarter,
                d.data_value AS lnst
                ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY d.company_profile_id, d.report_year, d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY d.UPDATED_DATE DESC NULLS LAST, d.CREATED_DATE DESC
            ) AS rn1
            FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
               AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
               AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
               AND cdc.STATEMENT_CD = FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD
			JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
            WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
              AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
              AND (
                     ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'DN' AND rr.row_desc = '60' )
                  OR ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'BH' AND rr.row_desc = '60' )
                  OR ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD' AND rr.row_desc = '21' )
              )
              /* kỳ phải thực sự có giá trị LNST */
              AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
--              AND cp.equity_ticker = 'HVN'
        ) x
        WHERE x.rn1 = 1
    )
    WHERE rn <= 4
)
/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 3:
   Chỉ tính TTM khi đủ 4 kỳ có LNST
   ========================================================= */
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 4 THEN SUM(lnst) END AS lnst_ttm
    FROM LNST_4_ky
    WHERE 1=1
    AND equity_ticker = 'HVN'
    GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker

                ORDER BY TO_DATE(t."Ngày báo cáo", 'DD/MM/YYYY') DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM "BM 1_Báo cáo về khối lượng chứng khoán đang lưu hành" t
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE t.Loai_CK = 'Co phieu'
          AND TO_DATE(t."Ngày báo cáo", 'DD/MM/YYYY') <= ts.den_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
Von_hoa AS (
    SELECT
        gc.symbol,
        gc.gia_dong_cua AS gia_cuoi,
        k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh AS kllh,
        CASE
            WHEN gc.gia_dong_cua IS NOT NULL
             AND k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh IS NOT NULL
            THEN gc.gia_dong_cua * k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh
        END AS von_hoa
    FROM Gia_cuoi gc
    LEFT JOIN KLLH_asof k
        ON k.symbol = gc.symbol
),
Nganh AS (

        cp.equity_ticker,
        c.industry_name
    FROM gms_ids_uat.categories c
    JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp
        ON cp.category_l1_id = c.id

),
Chi_so_thi_truong AS

),
Chi_so_nganh AS
(

        idx.Symbol AS symbol,
        m.MARKETCODE AS bo_chi_so_nganh
    FROM JAD_CSIDXINFOR idx
    JOIN JAD_MARKETINFOR m ON m.MARKETCODE = idx.INDEXCODE
     WHERE m.MARKETCODE NOT IN ('HOSE','UPCOM','HNX')
)
/* BƯỚC 1:
   Xác định đúng 1 company_data cho mỗi NNT + kỳ:
   - Kỳ phải tồn tại trong violation_report với base_date <= :den_ngay
   - company_data phải APPROVED
   - Chỉ lấy HN/TH/ME/RI
   - Ưu tiên loại báo cáo: HN -> TH -> ME -> RI
   - Trong cùng loại báo cáo: lấy submission_date mới nhất
*/
Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd,
        submission_date
        ,SUBSTR(form_cd,1,2) STATEMENT_CD
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY CASE 	WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
							END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM gms_ids_uat.company_data cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND f.form_cd LIKE '%QUAR'
          AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM gms_ids_uat.violation_report vr
			  JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf ON vf.id = vr.form_id AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
              WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year
                AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                AND vr.base_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
				
          )
		  AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')
		  AND cd.submission_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
		  AND vr.LANGUAGE_CD = 'VI'
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
--SELECT * FROM Company_data_chuan 
--WHERE 1=1 
--AND company_profile_id = '1591';
/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 2:
   - Từ các kỳ hợp lệ ở trên, lấy LNST trong DATA
   - DATA join bằng: company_profile_id + report_year + report_quarter
   - Chỉ các kỳ thực sự có LNST mới tồn tại ở đây
   - Xếp thứ tự và lấy 4 kỳ LNST gần nhất
   ========================================================= */
LNST_4_ky AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        lnst
    FROM (
        SELECT x.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id ORDER BY x.report_year DESC, x.report_quarter DESC ) AS rn     
        FROM (
            SELECT
                cdc.company_profile_id,
                cp.equity_ticker,
                cdc.report_year,
                cdc.report_quarter,
                d.data_value AS lnst
                ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY d.company_profile_id, d.report_year, d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY d.UPDATED_DATE DESC NULLS LAST, d.CREATED_DATE DESC
            ) AS rn1
            FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
               AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
               AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
               AND cdc.STATEMENT_CD = rc.FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD 
			JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
            WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
              AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
              AND (
                     ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'DN' AND rr.row_desc = '60' )
                  OR ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'BH' AND rr.row_desc = '60' )
                  OR ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD' AND rr.row_desc = '21' )
              )
              /* kỳ phải thực sự có giá trị LNST */
              AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
--              AND cp.equity_ticker = 'HVN'
        ) x
        WHERE x.rn1 = 1
    )
    WHERE rn <= 4
),
lnst_ttm AS
(
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker symbol,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 4 THEN SUM(lnst) END AS lnst_ttm
    FROM LNST_4_ky
    WHERE 1=1
--    AND equity_ticker = 'HVN'
    GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker
/* Một giá trị VCSH cho mỗi mã/kỳ */
),
VCSH_quy AS (
    SELECT
        equity_ticker symbol,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        vcsh,
        company_profile_id
    FROM (
        SELECT x.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id ORDER BY x.report_year DESC, x.report_quarter DESC ) AS rn1   
        FROM 
        (
        SELECT
            cp.equity_ticker,
            d.report_year,
            d.report_quarter,
            d.data_value AS vcsh,
            cdc.company_profile_id,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    d.company_profile_id,
                    d.report_year,
                    d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY
                    d.updated_date DESC NULLS LAST,
                    d.created_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp
            ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d
            ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
           AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
           AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc
            ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
           AND rc.financial_statement_cd = cdc.statement_cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr
            ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
           AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rcol
            ON rcol.col_cd = d.col_cd
           AND rcol.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        WHERE rcol.col_desc = '1'
          AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
          AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
          AND (
              (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) IN ('DN', 'BH')
               AND rr.row_desc = '400')
              OR (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD'
                  AND rr.row_desc = '500')
          )
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1
)
WHERE rn1 = 1
    )
Select 
    ma,
    nganh,
    tong_kl,
    gia_dong_cua,
    phan_tram_thay_doi,
    von_hoa,
    pe,
    pb,
	Bo_chi_so_thi_truong,
	Bo_chi_so_nganh,
	San
from 
(
    SELECT
	ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY tong_kl DESC NULLS LAST, ma
        ) AS stt,
        k.symbol AS ma,
        k.tong_kl,
        gc.gia_dong_cua,
        gd.gia_dau,
        vh.von_hoa,
        lt.lnst_ttm,
        vt.vcsh,
        ng.industry_name AS nganh,
		ROUND(
            (gia_dong_cua - gia_dau)
            / NULLIF(gia_dau, 0) * 100,
            2
        ) AS phan_tram_thay_doi,
        von_hoa,
        ROUND(von_hoa / NULLIF(lnst_ttm, 0), 2) AS pe,
        ROUND(von_hoa / NULLIF(vcsh, 0), 2) AS pb,
		ctt.bo_chi_so_thi_truong                                          AS Bo_chi_so_thi_truong,
		cn.bo_chi_so_nganh                                                AS Bo_chi_so_nganh,
		 CASE 
    WHEN gc.floorCode = '10' THEN 'HOSE'
    WHEN gc.floorCode = '02' THEN 'HNX'
    WHEN gc.floorCode = '04' THEN 'UPCOM'
    ELSE gc.floorCode
        END AS San
    FROM KHGD k
    LEFT JOIN Gia_cuoi gc
        ON gc.symbol = k.symbol
    LEFT JOIN Gia_dau gd
        ON gd.symbol = k.symbol
    LEFT JOIN Von_hoa vh
        ON vh.symbol = k.symbol
    LEFT JOIN LNST_TTM lt
        ON lt.symbol = k.symbol
    LEFT JOIN VCSH_quy vt
        ON vt.symbol = k.symbol
    LEFT JOIN Nganh ng
        ON ng.equity_ticker = k.symbol
	LEFT JOIN Chi_so_thi_truong ctt ON ctt.symbol = k.symbol
	LEFT JOIN Chi_so_nganh cn       ON cn.symbol = k.symbol
	)
WHERE stt <= :top_n
ORDER BY stt

--------Top khối lượng gốm các chỉ tiêu: Mã CK,% thay đổi giá,Giá,KLGD,Vốn hóa,P/E,P/B
Bộ lọc tham số là <Từ ngày - Đến ngày>. Với công thức: 
- % thay đổi giá:	(Giá đóng cửa <Đến ngày> - Giá đóng cửa <Từ ngày-1>) / Giá đóng cửa <Từ ngày-1> * 100
- Giá	:			Giá đóng cửa tại <Đến ngày>
- KLGD:	Tổng KLGD trong khoảng <Từ ngày - Đến ngày>
- Vốn hóa:	Giá đóng cửa tại Đến ngày × Số cổ phiếu lưu hành tại Đến ngày.
- P/E:	P/E của mã tại Đến ngày.
- P/B:	P/B của mã tại Đến ngày.

WITH
Tham_so AS (
    SELECT
        TO_DATE(:tu_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD') AS tu_ngay,
        TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD') AS den_ngay
    FROM DUAL
),
/* EOD từng mã; lấy snapshot cuối cùng trong ngày */
Gia_EOD AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        ngay_gd,
        gia_dong_cua,
		floorCode
    FROM (
        SELECT
            s.symbol,
            TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay_gd,
			floorCode,
            s.closePrice AS gia_dong_cua,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY s.symbol, s.tradingdate
                ORDER BY s.INDEXTIME DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR s
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') <= ts.den_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* Giá đóng cửa phiên gần nhất trước ngày bắt đầu */
Gia_dau AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        gia_dong_cua AS gia_dau
    FROM (
        SELECT
            g.symbol,
            g.gia_dong_cua,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY g.symbol
                ORDER BY g.ngay_gd DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Gia_EOD g
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE g.ngay_gd < ts.tu_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* Giá đóng cửa phiên gần nhất tại hoặc trước ngày kết thúc */
Gia_cuoi AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        gia_dong_cua,
        ngay_gd AS ngay_gia_cuoi,
		floorCode
    FROM (
        SELECT
            g.symbol,
            g.gia_dong_cua,
            g.ngay_gd,
			g.floorCode,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY g.symbol
                ORDER BY g.ngay_gd DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Gia_EOD g
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE g.ngay_gd <= ts.den_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* Tổng khối lượng giao dịch trong khoảng lọc */
KHGD AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        SUM(kl) AS tong_kl
    FROM (
        SELECT
            t.symbol,
            t.execution_volume AS kl
        FROM krx.trade_book_hose t
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
              BETWEEN ts.tu_ngay AND ts.den_ngay
          AND t.market_id = 'STK'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            t."Issue Code" AS symbol,
            t.trade_quantity AS kl
        FROM krx.trade_book_hnx t
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
              BETWEEN ts.tu_ngay AND ts.den_ngay
          AND t.market_id IN ('STX', 'UPX')
    )
    GROUP BY symbol
),
/* KLLH gần nhất có hiệu lực tại ngày kết thúc */
KLLH_asof AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        so_luong_cp_luu_hanh
    FROM (
        SELECT
            t.MCK AS symbol,
            t."Khối lượng chứng khoán đang lưu hành"
                AS so_luong_cp_luu_hanh,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY t.MCK
                ORDER BY TO_DATE(t."Ngày báo cáo", 'DD/MM/YYYY') DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM "BM 1_Báo cáo về khối lượng chứng khoán đang lưu hành" t
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE t.Loai_CK = 'Co phieu'
          AND TO_DATE(t."Ngày báo cáo", 'DD/MM/YYYY') <= ts.den_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
Von_hoa AS (
    SELECT
        gc.symbol,
        gc.gia_dong_cua AS gia_cuoi,
        k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh AS kllh,
        CASE
            WHEN gc.gia_dong_cua IS NOT NULL
             AND k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh IS NOT NULL
            THEN gc.gia_dong_cua * k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh
        END AS von_hoa
    FROM Gia_cuoi gc
    LEFT JOIN KLLH_asof k
        ON k.symbol = gc.symbol
),
Nganh AS (
    SELECT
        cp.equity_ticker,
        c.industry_name
    FROM gms_ids_uat.categories c
    JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp
        ON cp.category_l1_id = c.id
    WHERE c.active_flg = 1
),
Chi_so_thi_truong AS
(

/* BƯỚC 1:
   Xác định đúng 1 company_data cho mỗi NNT + kỳ:
   - Kỳ phải tồn tại trong violation_report với base_date <= :den_ngay
   - company_data phải APPROVED
   - Chỉ lấy HN/TH/ME/RI
   - Ưu tiên loại báo cáo: HN -> TH -> ME -> RI
   - Trong cùng loại báo cáo: lấy submission_date mới nhất
*/
Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd,
        submission_date
        ,SUBSTR(form_cd,1,2) STATEMENT_CD
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY CASE 	WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
							END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM gms_ids_uat.company_data cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND f.form_cd LIKE '%QUAR'
          AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM gms_ids_uat.violation_report vr
			  JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf ON vf.id = vr.form_id AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
              WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year
                AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                AND vr.base_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
				
          )
		  AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')
		  AND cd.submission_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
		  AND vr.LANGUAGE_CD = 'VI'
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),

/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 2:
   - Từ các kỳ hợp lệ ở trên, lấy LNST trong DATA
   - DATA join bằng: company_profile_id + report_year + report_quarter
   - Chỉ các kỳ thực sự có LNST mới tồn tại ở đây
   - Xếp thứ tự và lấy 4 kỳ LNST gần nhất
   ========================================================= */
LNST_4_ky AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        lnst
    FROM (
        SELECT x.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id ORDER BY x.report_year DESC, x.report_quarter DESC ) AS rn     
        FROM (
            SELECT
                cdc.company_profile_id,
                cp.equity_ticker,
                cdc.report_year,
                cdc.report_quarter,
                d.data_value AS lnst
                ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY d.company_profile_id, d.report_year, d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY d.UPDATED_DATE DESC NULLS LAST, d.CREATED_DATE DESC
            ) AS rn1
            FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
               AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
               AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
               AND cdc.STATEMENT_CD = rc.FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD 
			JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
            WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
              AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
              AND (
                     ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'DN' AND rr.row_desc = '60' )
                  OR ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'BH' AND rr.row_desc = '60' )
                  OR ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD' AND rr.row_desc = '21' )
              )
              /* kỳ phải thực sự có giá trị LNST */
              AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
--              AND cp.equity_ticker = 'HVN'
        ) x
        WHERE x.rn1 = 1
    )
    WHERE rn <= 4
),
lnst_ttm AS
(
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker symbol,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 4 THEN SUM(lnst) END AS lnst_ttm
    FROM LNST_4_ky
    WHERE 1=1
--    AND equity_ticker = 'HVN'
    GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker
/* Một giá trị VCSH cho mỗi mã/kỳ */
),
VCSH_quy AS (
    SELECT
        equity_ticker symbol,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        vcsh,
        company_profile_id
    FROM (
        SELECT x.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id ORDER BY x.report_year DESC, x.report_quarter DESC ) AS rn1

        (
        SELECT
            cp.equity_ticker,

                    d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY
                    d.updated_date DESC NULLS LAST,
                    d.created_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp
            ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d
            ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
           AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
           AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc
            ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
           AND rc.financial_statement_cd = cdc.statement_cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr
            ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
           AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rcol
            ON rcol.col_cd = d.col_cd
           AND rcol.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        WHERE rcol.col_desc = '1'
          AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
          AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
          AND (
              (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) IN ('DN', 'BH')
               AND rr.row_desc = '400')
              OR (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD'
                  AND rr.row_desc = '500')
          )
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1
)
WHERE rn1 = 1

--------------------------------Tham số từ ngày đến ngày -------------------------------------------------
WITH Tham_so AS (
    SELECT
        TO_DATE(:tu_ngay, 'yyyyMMdd') AS tu_ngay,
        TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'yyyyMMdd') AS den_ngay
),
Khoi_luong_giao_dich AS (
select 
        symbol,
        ngay_gd,
        SUM(kl) AS khoi_luong
from 
(
    SELECT
        t.symbol,
        TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS ngay_gd,
        t.execution_volume AS kl
    FROM uat_ordertrade_stg.trade_book_hose t
    CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
    WHERE TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
          BETWEEN ts.tu_ngay AND ts.den_ngay
      AND t.market_id = 'STK'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        t.issue_code AS symbol,
        TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS ngay_gd,
        t.trade_quantity AS kl
    FROM uat_ordertrade_stg.trade_book_hnx t
    CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
    WHERE TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
          BETWEEN ts.tu_ngay AND ts.den_ngay
      AND t.market_id IN ('STX', 'UPX')
	  )
	      GROUP BY
        symbol,
        ngay_gd
),
/*
  Snapshot EOD của mỗi mã/ngày.
  Tránh tạo nhiều nến khi JAD_STOCKINFOR có dữ liệu intraday.
*/
MDDS AS (
    SELECT
        san,
        ma_chung_khoan,
        stock_type,
        ngay_gd,
        gia_mo_cua,
        gia_cao_nhat,
        gia_thap_nhat,
        gia_dong_cua,
        gia_tham_chieu
    FROM (
        SELECT
            s.floorcode AS san,
            s.symbol AS ma_chung_khoan,
            s.stocktype AS stock_type,
            TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay_gd,
            s.open AS gia_mo_cua,
            s.high AS gia_cao_nhat,
            s.low AS gia_thap_nhat,
            s.closeprice AS gia_dong_cua,
            s.reference AS gia_tham_chieu,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY s.symbol, s.tradingdate
                ORDER BY s.indextime DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR s
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
              BETWEEN ts.tu_ngay AND ts.den_ngay
          AND s.floorcode IN ('10', '02', '04', '03')
          AND s.stocktype <> '1'
		  AND s.symbol = :ma_chung_khoan
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* Kỳ BCTC gần nhất đã kết thúc tại từng ngày trên biểu đồ */
Ky_bao_cao AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        m.ngay_gd,
        CASE
            WHEN CEIL(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.ngay_gd, 'MM')) / 3) = 1
                THEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.ngay_gd, 'YYYY')) - 1
            ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.ngay_gd, 'YYYY'))
        END AS report_year,
        CASE
            WHEN CEIL(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.ngay_gd, 'MM')) / 3) = 1
                THEN 4
            ELSE CEIL(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.ngay_gd, 'MM')) / 3) - 1
        END AS report_quarter
    FROM MDDS m
),

/*
  Một company_data hợp lệ cho mỗi mã/năm/quý:
  HN > TH > ME > RI; cùng loại lấy bản nộp gần nhất.
*/
Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd,
        statement_cd,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
            SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) AS statement_cd,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    cd.company_profile_id,
                    cd.report_year,
                    cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY
                    CASE
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
                    END,
                    cd.submission_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM gms_ids_uat.company_data cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms f
            ON f.id = cd.form_id
           AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND f.form_cd LIKE '%QUAR'
          AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM gms_ids_uat.violation_report vr
              JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf
                  ON vf.id = vr.form_id
                 AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
              WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year
                AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                AND vr.base_date <= ts.den_ngay
                AND vr.language_cd = 'VI'
          )
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* LNST theo từng kỳ BCTC */
LNST AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        lnst,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cdc.company_profile_id,
            cp.equity_ticker,
            cdc.report_year,
            cdc.report_quarter,
            d.data_value AS lnst,
            cdc.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    d.company_profile_id,
                    d.report_year,
                    d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY
                    d.updated_date DESC NULLS LAST,
                    d.created_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp
            ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d
            ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
           AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
           AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc
            ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
           AND rc.financial_statement_cd = cdc.statement_cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr
            ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
           AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rcol
            ON rcol.col_cd = d.col_cd
           AND rcol.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        WHERE rcol.col_desc = '1'
          AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
          AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
          AND (
              (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) IN ('DN', 'BH')
               AND rr.row_desc = '60')
              OR (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD'
                  AND rr.row_desc = '21')
          )
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* Doanh thu theo từng kỳ BCTC */
Doanh_thu AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        doanh_thu,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cdc.company_profile_id,
            cp.equity_ticker,
            cdc.report_year,
            cdc.report_quarter,
            d.data_value AS doanh_thu,
            cdc.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    d.company_profile_id,
                    d.report_year,
                    d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY
                    d.updated_date DESC NULLS LAST,
                    d.created_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp
            ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d
            ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
           AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
           AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc
            ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
           AND rc.financial_statement_cd = cdc.statement_cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr
            ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
           AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rcol
            ON rcol.col_cd = d.col_cd
           AND rcol.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        WHERE rcol.col_desc = '1'
          AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
          AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
          AND (
              (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) IN ('DN', 'BH')
               AND rr.row_desc = '10')
              OR (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD'
                  AND rr.row_desc = '03')
          )
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    a.ma_chung_khoan,
    a.ngay_gd,
    a.gia_mo_cua,
    a.gia_cao_nhat,
    a.gia_thap_nhat,
    a.gia_dong_cua,
    a.gia_tham_chieu,
    k.khoi_luong,
    kb.report_year,
    kb.report_quarter,
    dt.doanh_thu,
    ln.lnst
FROM MDDS a
LEFT JOIN Khoi_luong_giao_dich k
    ON k.symbol = a.ma_chung_khoan
   AND k.ngay_gd = a.ngay_gd
JOIN Ky_bao_cao kb
    ON kb.ngay_gd = a.ngay_gd
LEFT JOIN Doanh_thu dt
    ON dt.equity_ticker = a.ma_chung_khoan
   AND dt.report_year = kb.report_year
   AND dt.report_quarter = kb.report_quarter
   AND dt.submission_date <= a.ngay_gd
LEFT JOIN LNST ln
    ON ln.equity_ticker = a.ma_chung_khoan
   AND ln.report_year = kb.report_year
   AND ln.report_quarter = kb.report_quarter
   AND ln.submission_date <= a.ngay_gd
ORDER BY
    a.ma_chung_khoan,
    a.ngay_gd;
