/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 2: tính các chỉ tiêu theo từng DN, từng kỳ
   - Từ các kỳ hợp lệ ở trên, lấy chỉ tiêu trong DATA
   - DATA join bằng: company_profile_id + report_year + report_quarter
   - Điều kiện FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD = form_tp
   - Cùng chỉ tiêu: lấy create_date mới nhất
   ========================================================= */
Chitiet_DN AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
		Case when report_quarter = 1 then to_date ('31-03-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy')
			when report_quarter = 2 then to_date ('30-06-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy')
			when report_quarter = 3 then to_date ('30-09-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy')
			when report_quarter = 4 then to_date ('31-12-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy') 
			end as Ngay_ket_thuc,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'VCSH' THEN data_value END) AS VCSH,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'LNST' THEN data_value END) AS LNST,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'DOANH_THU' THEN data_value END) AS DOANH_THU
    FROM (
        SELECT
            rn, company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id,
            report_year, report_quarter,
            CASE
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='400')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='400')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='500')) THEN 'VCSH'
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='21')) THEN 'LNST'
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='10')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='10')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='03')) THEN 'DOANH_THU'
            END AS chi_tieu,
            data_value
        FROM (
            SELECT x.*,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                       PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id, x.report_year, x.report_quarter, x.row_id, x.col_id
                       ORDER BY x.updated_date DESC, x.created_date DESC, x.data_id DESC
                   ) AS rn
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    cdc.company_profile_id,
                    cp.equity_ticker,
                    cp.equity_listing_exch,
                    cp.category_l1_id,
                    rc.enterprise_type_cd,
                    cdc.report_year,
                    cdc.report_quarter,
                    rc.report_cd,
                    rc2.id AS col_id,
                    rc2.col_desc,
                    rr.id AS row_id,
                    rr.row_desc,
                    d.data_value,
                    d.created_date,
                    d.updated_date,
                    d.id AS data_id
                FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.company_profiles cp
                  ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.data d
                  ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
                 AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
                 AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.report_catalog rc
                  ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
                 AND cdc.form_tp = rc.FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rrow rr
                  ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
                 AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rcol rc2
                  ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd
                 AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                WHERE 1=1
                and cp.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND d.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rc.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rr.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rc2.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rc2.col_desc IN ('1','2')
            ) x
        ) t
        WHERE rn = 1
    ) q
    WHERE chi_tieu IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id, report_year, report_quarter
)

                gh.symbol

        gh.symbol AS ma,
        CASE
            WHEN gh.floorcode = '10' THEN 'HOSE'
            WHEN gh.floorcode = '02' THEN 'HNX'
            WHEN gh.floorcode = '04' THEN 'UPCOM'
            ELSE gh.floorcode
        END AS san,
        kh.khoi_luong AS khoi_luong,
        gh.gia_hien_tai AS gia_dong_cua,
        DLS.dinh_gia_dong_cua,
        vh.von_hoa,
        ROUND(

            2
        ) AS pe,
        ROUND(
            vh.von_hoa / NULLIF(vm.vcsh, 0),
            2
        ) AS pb
    FROM Gia_hien_tai gh
    LEFT JOIN KLGD_hien_tai kh
        ON kh.symbol = gh.symbol
	LEFT Join Dinh_lich_su DLS 
		on DLS.symbol = gh.symbol
    LEFT JOIN Von_hoa vh

    LEFT JOIN LNST4Q lt
        ON lt.equity_ticker = gh.symbol
    LEFT JOIN VCSH vm
        ON vm.equity_ticker = gh.symbol
)
WHERE stt <= :top_n
ORDER BY stt;

--------------------------------Tham số từ ngày đến ngày -------------------------------------------------
WITH
Tham_so AS (
    SELECT
        TO_DATE(:tu_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD') AS tu_ngay,
        TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD') AS den_ngay
    FROM DUAL
),
Khoi_luong_giao_dich AS (
select 
        symbol,
        ngay_gd,
        SUM(kl) AS khoi_luong
from 
(
    SELECT
        t.symbol,
        TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay_gd,
        t.execution_volume AS kl
    FROM krx.trade_book_hose t
    CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
    WHERE TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
          BETWEEN ts.tu_ngay AND ts.den_ngay
      AND t.market_id = 'STK'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        t."Issue Code" AS symbol,
        TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay_gd,
        t.trade_quantity AS kl
    FROM krx.trade_book_hnx t
    CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
    WHERE TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
          BETWEEN ts.tu_ngay AND ts.den_ngay
      AND t.market_id IN ('STX', 'UPX')
	  )
	      GROUP BY
        symbol,
        ngay_gd
),
/*
  Snapshot EOD của mỗi mã/ngày.
  Tránh tạo nhiều nến khi JAD_STOCKINFOR có dữ liệu intraday.
*/
MDDS AS (
    SELECT
        san,
        ma_chung_khoan,
        stock_type,
        ngay_gd,
        gia_mo_cua,
        gia_cao_nhat,
        gia_thap_nhat,
        gia_dong_cua,
        gia_tham_chieu
    FROM (
        SELECT
            s.floorcode AS san,
            s.symbol AS ma_chung_khoan,
            s.stocktype AS stock_type,
            TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay_gd,
            s.open AS gia_mo_cua,
            s.high AS gia_cao_nhat,
            s.low AS gia_thap_nhat,
            s.closeprice AS gia_dong_cua,
            s.reference AS gia_tham_chieu,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY s.symbol, s.tradingdate
                ORDER BY s.indextime DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR s
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
              BETWEEN ts.tu_ngay AND ts.den_ngay
          AND s.floorcode IN ('10', '02', '04', '03')
          AND s.stocktype <> '1'
		  AND s.symbol = :ma_chung_khoan
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* Kỳ BCTC gần nhất đã kết thúc tại từng ngày trên biểu đồ */
Ky_bao_cao AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        m.ngay_gd,
        CASE
            WHEN CEIL(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.ngay_gd, 'MM')) / 3) = 1
                THEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.ngay_gd, 'YYYY')) - 1
            ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.ngay_gd, 'YYYY'))
        END AS report_year,
        CASE
            WHEN CEIL(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.ngay_gd, 'MM')) / 3) = 1
                THEN 4
            ELSE CEIL(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.ngay_gd, 'MM')) / 3) - 1
        END AS report_quarter
    FROM MDDS m
),

/*
  Một company_data hợp lệ cho mỗi mã/năm/quý:
  HN > TH > ME > RI; cùng loại lấy bản nộp gần nhất.
*/
Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd,
        statement_cd,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
            SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) AS statement_cd,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    cd.company_profile_id,
                    cd.report_year,
                    cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY
                    CASE
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
                    END,
                    cd.submission_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM gms_ids_uat.company_data cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms f
            ON f.id = cd.form_id
           AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND f.form_cd LIKE '%QUAR'
          AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')
          AND cd.submission_date <= ts.den_ngay
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM gms_ids_uat.violation_report vr
              JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf
                  ON vf.id = vr.form_id
                 AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
              WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year
                AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                AND vr.base_date <= ts.den_ngay
                AND vr.language_cd = 'VI'
          )
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* LNST theo từng kỳ BCTC */
LNST AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        lnst,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cdc.company_profile_id,
            cp.equity_ticker,
            cdc.report_year,
            cdc.report_quarter,
            d.data_value AS lnst,
            cdc.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    d.company_profile_id,
                    d.report_year,
                    d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY
                    d.updated_date DESC NULLS LAST,
                    d.created_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp
            ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d
            ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
           AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
           AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc
            ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
           AND rc.financial_statement_cd = cdc.statement_cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr
            ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
           AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rcol
            ON rcol.col_cd = d.col_cd
           AND rcol.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        WHERE rcol.col_desc = '1'
          AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'

WITH MDDS_raw AS (
    SELECT 
        s.floorCode                    AS san,
        s.symbol                       AS ma_chung_khoan,
--        idx.indexCode                  AS ma_chi_so,
        s.StockType,
        s.underlyingSymbol,
        DECODE(s.StockType, '4', 'HĐTL') || DECODE(s.underlyingSymbol, 'GB05', 'TPCP', 'GB10', 'TPCP', s.underlyingSymbol) AS loai_phai_sinh,
        TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay_gd,
        s.TRADINGTIME                  AS tradingtime,
        s.""OPEN""                       AS Gia_mo_cua,
        s.""HIGH""                       AS Gia_cao_nhat,
        s.""LOW""                        AS Gia_thap_nhat,
        s.closePrice                   AS Gia_dong_cua,
        s.reference                    AS Gia_tham_chieu,
        s.change                       AS Thay_doi,
        ROUND((s.change / NULLIF(s.reference, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pct_bien_dong,
        CASE 
            WHEN :loai_gtgd = 'THOA_THUAN' THEN s.pt_total_traded_qtty
            WHEN :loai_gtgd = 'KHOP_LENH'  THEN s.totaltrading - s.pt_total_traded_qtty
            ELSE s.totaltrading
        END                             AS kl_luy_ke_theo_loc
    FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR s
--    JOIN JAD_CSIDXINFOR idx ON idx.Symbol = s.symbol
    WHERE 1=1
--      AND s.symbol = 'MBB'   
      AND s.FloorCode   IN ('10', '02', '04', '03')
  	  AND s.StockType  NOT IN ('1')
--      AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') = :ngay_gd
),
MDDS AS (
    SELECT
        m.*,
        COALESCE(
            LEAD(m.kl_luy_ke_theo_loc) OVER (ORDER BY m.tradingtime) - m.kl_luy_ke_theo_loc,
            m.kl_luy_ke_theo_loc - LAG(m.kl_luy_ke_theo_loc) OVER (ORDER BY m.tradingtime),
            m.kl_luy_ke_theo_loc
        ) AS kl_tai_thoi_diem,
        (
            SELECT jm.MARKETINDEX                    
            FROM JAD_MARKETINFOR jm
            WHERE jm.MARKETID = '10'
--              AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(jm.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') = :ngay_gd
              AND jm.INDEXTIME <= m.tradingtime
            ORDER BY jm.INDEXTIME DESC
            FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
        ) AS gia_vnindex
    FROM MDDS_raw m
),
Ky_bao_cao AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        m.ngay_gd,
        CASE WHEN CEIL(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.ngay_gd,'MM')) / 3.0) = 1 
             THEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.ngay_gd,'YYYY')) - 1 ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.ngay_gd,'YYYY')) END AS report_year,
        CASE WHEN CEIL(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.ngay_gd,'MM')) / 3.0) = 1 
             THEN 4 ELSE CEIL(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.ngay_gd,'MM')) / 3.0) - 1 END AS report_quarter
    FROM MDDS m
),

            cdc.report_quarter,
            d.data_value AS lnst,
            cdc.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    d.company_profile_id,
                    d.report_year,
                    d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY
                    d.updated_date DESC NULLS LAST,
                    d.created_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp
            ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d
            ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
           AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
           AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc
            ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
           AND rc.financial_statement_cd = cdc.statement_cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr
            ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
           AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rcol

        WHERE rcol.col_desc = '1'

          AND (

              OR (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD'
                  AND rr.row_desc = '21')
          )
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)

            WHEN :loai_khoang = '6M' THEN 126

select 
ngay_gd,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ngay_gd DESC) AS rn
from

/* BƯỚC 1:
   Xác định đúng 1 company_data cho mỗi NNT + kỳ:
   - company_data phải APPROVED
   - Ưu tiên loại báo cáo: HN -> TH -> ME -> RI
   - Trong cùng loại báo cáo: lấy submission_date mới nhất
*/
,Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd, form_tp,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
			substr(f.form_cd,1,2) as form_tp,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY CASE 	WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
							END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM UAT_IDS_STG.company_data cd
        JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND cd.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
          AND f.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
--    AND report_year in (:p_year)
--	AND report_quarter in (:p_quarter)
),
/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 2: tính các chỉ tiêu theo từng DN, từng kỳ
   - Từ các kỳ hợp lệ ở trên, lấy chỉ tiêu trong DATA
   - DATA join bằng: company_profile_id + report_year + report_quarter
   - Điều kiện FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD = form_tp
   - Cùng chỉ tiêu: lấy create_date mới nhất
   ========================================================= */
Chitiet_DN AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
		Case when report_quarter = 1 then to_date ('31-03-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy')
			when report_quarter = 2 then to_date ('30-06-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy')
			when report_quarter = 3 then to_date ('30-09-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy')
			when report_quarter = 4 then to_date ('31-12-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy') 
			end as Ngay_ket_thuc,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'VCSH' THEN data_value END) AS VCSH,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'LNST' THEN data_value END) AS LNST,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'DOANH_THU' THEN data_value END) AS DOANH_THU
    FROM (
        SELECT
            rn, company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id,
            report_year, report_quarter,
            CASE
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='400')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='400')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='500')) THEN 'VCSH'
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='21')) THEN 'LNST'
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='10')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='10')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='03')) THEN 'DOANH_THU'
            END AS chi_tieu,
            data_value
        FROM (
            SELECT x.*,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                       PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id, x.report_year, x.report_quarter, x.row_id, x.col_id
                       ORDER BY x.updated_date DESC, x.created_date DESC, x.data_id DESC
                   ) AS rn
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    cdc.company_profile_id,
                    cp.equity_ticker,
                    cp.equity_listing_exch,
                    cp.category_l1_id,
                    rc.enterprise_type_cd,
                    cdc.report_year,
                    cdc.report_quarter,
                    rc.report_cd,
                    rc2.id AS col_id,
                    rc2.col_desc,
                    rr.id AS row_id,
                    rr.row_desc,
                    d.data_value,
                    d.created_date,
                    d.updated_date,
                    d.id AS data_id
                FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.company_profiles cp
                  ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.data d
                  ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
                 AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
                 AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.report_catalog rc
                  ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
                 AND cdc.form_tp = rc.FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rrow rr
                  ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
                 AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rcol rc2
                  ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd
                 AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                WHERE 1=1
                and cp.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND d.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rc.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rr.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rc2.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rc2.col_desc IN ('1','2')
            ) x
        ) t
        WHERE rn = 1
    ) q
    WHERE chi_tieu IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id, report_year, report_quarter
)
--select * from Chitiet_DN;
--where equity_ticker = 'DC4';
,LNST4Q as 
(
SELECT 
company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
		CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 4 THEN SUM(LNST) END AS lnst_ttm
--        Sum(LNST)
--		, count(1)
--		,report_year
--        ,report_quarter
FROM (
	select company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
		LNST,
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY company_profile_id ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC ) AS rn1
	from Chitiet_DN ct
	where report_quarter in (1,2,3,4)
	and date_format(ngay_ket_thuc, 'yyyyMMdd') <= :Ngay_gd
--	AND date_format(TO_DATE(Ngay_ket_thuc, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd')  <= :Ngay_gd
--	AND report_year in (:p_year)
--	AND report_quarter in (:p_quarter)
	)
WHERE rn1 <=4
group by 
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker
        ,equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id
)
--select * from LNST4Q;
,VCSH as 
(
SELECT company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
		sum (VCSH) VCSH
FROM (
	select company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
		VCSH,
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY company_profile_id ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC ) AS rn1
	from Chitiet_DN ct
	where report_quarter in (1,2,3,4)
	and date_format(TO_DATE(Ngay_ket_thuc, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd')  <= :Ngay_gd
	)
WHERE rn1=1
group by 
--report_year,
--        report_quarter,
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker
        ,equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id
)
SELECT
    stt,
    ma,
    san,
    khoi_luong,
    gia_dong_cua,
    dinh_gia_dong_cua,
    von_hoa,
    pe,
    pb
        from 
        (
    SELECT
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY
                dls.dinh_gia_dong_cua DESC,
                gh.symbol
        ) AS stt,
        gh.symbol AS ma,
        CASE
            WHEN gh.floorcode = '10' THEN 'HOSE'
            WHEN gh.floorcode = '02' THEN 'HNX'
            WHEN gh.floorcode = '04' THEN 'UPCOM'
            ELSE gh.floorcode
        END AS san,
        kh.khoi_luong AS khoi_luong,
        gh.gia_hien_tai AS gia_dong_cua,
        DLS.dinh_gia_dong_cua,
        vh.von_hoa,
        ROUND(
            vh.von_hoa / NULLIF(lt.lnst_ttm, 0),
            2
        ) AS pe,
        ROUND(
            vh.von_hoa / NULLIF(vm.vcsh, 0),
            2
        ) AS pb
    FROM Gia_hien_tai gh
    LEFT JOIN KLGD_hien_tai kh
        ON kh.symbol = gh.symbol
	LEFT Join Dinh_lich_su DLS 
		on DLS.symbol = gh.symbol
    LEFT JOIN Von_hoa vh
        ON vh.symbol = gh.symbol
    LEFT JOIN LNST4Q lt
        ON lt.equity_ticker = gh.symbol
    LEFT JOIN VCSH vm
        ON vm.equity_ticker = gh.symbol
)
WHERE stt <= :top_n
ORDER BY stt;

WITH
/* BƯỚC 1:
   Xác định đúng 1 company_data cho mỗi NNT + kỳ:
   - Kỳ phải tồn tại trong violation_report với base_date <= :den_ngay
   - company_data phải APPROVED
   - Chỉ lấy HN/TH/ME/RI
   - Ưu tiên loại báo cáo: HN -> TH -> ME -> RI
   - Trong cùng loại báo cáo: lấy submission_date mới nhất
*/
Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd,
        submission_date
        ,SUBSTR(form_cd,1,2) STATEMENT_CD
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY CASE 	WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
							END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM gms_ids_uat.company_data cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND f.form_cd LIKE '%QUAR'
          AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM gms_ids_uat.violation_report vr
			  JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf ON vf.id = vr.form_id AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
              WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year
                AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                AND vr.base_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')

          )
		  		AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')
				AND cd.submission_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
				AND vr.LANGUAGE_CD = 'VI'
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
--SELECT * FROM Company_data_chuan 
--WHERE 1=1 
--AND company_profile_id = '1591';
/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 2:
   - Từ các kỳ hợp lệ ở trên, lấy LNST trong DATA
   - DATA join bằng: company_profile_id + report_year + report_quarter
   - Chỉ các kỳ thực sự có LNST mới tồn tại ở đây
   - Xếp thứ tự và lấy 4 kỳ LNST gần nhất
   ========================================================= */
LNST_4_ky AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        lnst
    FROM (
        SELECT x.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id ORDER BY x.report_year DESC, x.report_quarter DESC ) AS rn     
        FROM (
            SELECT
                cdc.company_profile_id,
                cp.equity_ticker,
                cdc.report_year,
                cdc.report_quarter,
                d.data_value AS lnst
                ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY d.company_profile_id, d.report_year, d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY d.UPDATED_DATE DESC NULLS LAST, d.CREATED_DATE DESC
            ) AS rn1
            FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
               AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
               AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
               AND cdc.STATEMENT_CD = FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD
			JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
            WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
              AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
              AND (
                     ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'DN' AND rr.row_desc = '60' )
                  OR ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'BH' AND rr.row_desc = '60' )
                  OR ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD' AND rr.row_desc = '21' )
              )
              /* kỳ phải thực sự có giá trị LNST */
              AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
--              AND cp.equity_ticker = 'HVN'
        ) x
        WHERE x.rn1 = 1
    )
    WHERE rn <= 4
)
/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 3:
   Chỉ tính TTM khi đủ 4 kỳ có LNST
   ========================================================= */
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 4 THEN SUM(lnst) END AS lnst_ttm
    FROM LNST_4_ky
    WHERE 1=1
    AND equity_ticker = 'HVN'
    GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker

WITH ---- lấy ngày giao dịch ngày chốt
Tham_so AS (--- theo khoảng thời gian tham số
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN :loai_khoang = '3M' THEN 63
            WHEN :loai_khoang = '6M' THEN 126
            WHEN :loai_khoang = '1Y' THEN 252
        END AS so_phien
)
,Cua_so_giao_dich AS ( --- lịch giao dịch là ngày gd theo phiên
select 
ngay_gd,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ngay_gd DESC) AS rn
from 
(
    SELECT
        ngay_gd,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ngay_gd DESC) AS rn,
		ts.so_phien
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            TO_DATE(jm.tradingdate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS ngay_gd
        FROM uat_mdds_stg.JAD_MARKETINFOR jm
        WHERE 1=1
          AND date_format(TO_DATE(jm.tradingdate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd') <= :Ngay_gd
    )
    CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
)
    WHERE rn <= so_phien + 1
)
--select * from Cua_so_giao_dich;
,KLGD_hien_tai AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        SUM(kl) AS khoi_luong
    FROM (
        SELECT
            t.symbol,
            TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS ngay_gd,
            SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
                  AND t.BOARD_TYPE  NOT IN ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')
             THEN CAST(REPLACE(t.EXECUTION_VOLUME, ',', '') AS DECIMAL(38,2))) AS kl
        FROM uat_ordertrade_stg.trade_book_hose t
        WHERE 1=1
        and date_format(TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd') = :Ngay_gd
        and t.market_id = 'STK'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            t.issue_code AS symbol,
            TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS ngay_gd,
            SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                  AND t.BOARD_ID NOT IN ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')
             THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY                                    ELSE 0 END) AS kl
        FROM uat_ordertrade_stg.trade_book_hnx t
        WHERE 1=1
        and date_format(TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd') = :Ngay_gd
        and t.market_id IN ('STX', 'UPX')
    ) x
--   	JOIN Cua_so_giao_dich cs ON cs.ngay_gd = x.ngay_gd and cs.rn = 1 
    GROUP BY
        symbol
)
--select * from KLGD_hien_tai;
,Gia_EOD AS (
SELECT
            s.symbol,
            TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS ngay_gd,
            s.floorcode,
            s.closeprice AS gia_dong_cua,
--            cat.industry_name               AS ten_nganh, 
            s.change					Thay_doi,
            CASE
        WHEN s.reference IS NULL OR s.reference = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND((s.change / s.reference) * 100, 2)

        FROM uat_mdds_stg.tmp_jad_stockinfor_eod s
        JOIN Cua_so_giao_dich cs ON cs.ngay_gd = TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'yyyy-MM-dd')

/* Đỉnh là giá đóng cửa cao nhất của N phiên trước phiên chốt */
,Dinh_lich_su AS (
    SELECT
        ge.symbol,
--        gia_dong_cua,
--        cs.rn,
--        cs.ngay_gd,
--        ge.ngay_gd
        Min(ge.gia_dong_cua) AS dinh_gia_dong_cua

--select * from Dinh_lich_su;
--where symbol = 'ABW';
,KLLH_asof AS (
SELECT
        symbol,
        so_luong_cp_luu_hanh
    FROM (
        SELECT
            t.ma_ck AS symbol,
            t.khoi_luong_ck_dang_luu_hanh AS so_luong_cp_luu_hanh,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY t.ma_ck
                ORDER BY TO_DATE(t.ds_snpst_dt, 'yyyy-MM-dd') DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM uat_vsdc_stg.outstanding_shares  t
        WHERE 1=1
          AND TO_DATE(t.ds_snpst_dt, 'yyyy-MM-dd') <= :Ngay_gd
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)
--select * from KLLH_asof;
--where symbol = 'ABW';
,Von_hoa AS (
    SELECT
        tvd.symbol,
        tvd.gia_hien_tai,
        kllh.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh,
        CASE
            WHEN kllh.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh IS NOT NULL
            THEN tvd.gia_hien_tai * kllh.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh
        END AS von_hoa
    FROM Gia_hien_tai tvd
    LEFT JOIN KLLH_asof kllh
        ON kllh.symbol = tvd.symbol
)
/* BƯỚC 1:
   Xác định đúng 1 company_data cho mỗi NNT + kỳ:
   - company_data phải APPROVED
   - Ưu tiên loại báo cáo: HN -> TH -> ME -> RI
   - Trong cùng loại báo cáo: lấy submission_date mới nhất
*/
,Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd, form_tp,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
			substr(f.form_cd,1,2) as form_tp,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY CASE 	WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
							END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM UAT_IDS_STG.company_data cd
        JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND cd.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
          AND f.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
--    AND report_year in (:p_year)
--	AND report_quarter in (:p_quarter)
),
/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 2: tính các chỉ tiêu theo từng DN, từng kỳ
   - Từ các kỳ hợp lệ ở trên, lấy chỉ tiêu trong DATA
   - DATA join bằng: company_profile_id + report_year + report_quarter
   - Điều kiện FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD = form_tp
   - Cùng chỉ tiêu: lấy create_date mới nhất
   ========================================================= */
Chitiet_DN AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
		Case when report_quarter = 1 then to_date ('31-03-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy')
			when report_quarter = 2 then to_date ('30-06-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy')
			when report_quarter = 3 then to_date ('30-09-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy')
			when report_quarter = 4 then to_date ('31-12-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy') 
			end as Ngay_ket_thuc,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'VCSH' THEN data_value END) AS VCSH,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'LNST' THEN data_value END) AS LNST,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'DOANH_THU' THEN data_value END) AS DOANH_THU
    FROM (
        SELECT
            rn, company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id,
            report_year, report_quarter,
            CASE
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='400')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='400')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='500')) THEN 'VCSH'
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='21')) THEN 'LNST'
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='10')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='10')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='03')) THEN 'DOANH_THU'
            END AS chi_tieu,
            data_value
        FROM (
            SELECT x.*,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                       PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id, x.report_year, x.report_quarter, x.row_id, x.col_id
                       ORDER BY x.updated_date DESC, x.created_date DESC, x.data_id DESC
                   ) AS rn
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    cdc.company_profile_id,
                    cp.equity_ticker,
                    cp.equity_listing_exch,
                    cp.category_l1_id,
                    rc.enterprise_type_cd,
                    cdc.report_year,
                    cdc.report_quarter,
                    rc.report_cd,
                    rc2.id AS col_id,
                    rc2.col_desc,
                    rr.id AS row_id,
                    rr.row_desc,
                    d.data_value,
                    d.created_date,
                    d.updated_date,
                    d.id AS data_id
                FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.company_profiles cp
                  ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.data d

select

        and date_format(TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd') = :Ngay_gd
        and t.market_id = 'STK'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            t.issue_code AS symbol,

            SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                  AND t.BOARD_ID NOT IN ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')

,Company_data_chuan AS (

                ORDER BY CASE 	WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1

								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
							END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM UAT_IDS_STG.company_data cd
        JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND cd.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
          AND f.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
    )
    WHERE rn = 1

--	AND report_quarter in (:p_quarter)
),
/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 2: tính các chỉ tiêu theo từng DN, từng kỳ
   - Từ các kỳ hợp lệ ở trên, lấy chỉ tiêu trong DATA
   - DATA join bằng: company_profile_id + report_year + report_quarter
   - Điều kiện FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD = form_tp
   - Cùng chỉ tiêu: lấy create_date mới nhất
   ========================================================= */
Chitiet_DN AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
		Case when report_quarter = 1 then to_date ('31-03-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy')
			when report_quarter = 2 then to_date ('30-06-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy')
			when report_quarter = 3 then to_date ('30-09-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy')
			when report_quarter = 4 then to_date ('31-12-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy') 
			end as Ngay_ket_thuc,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'VCSH' THEN data_value END) AS VCSH,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'LNST' THEN data_value END) AS LNST,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'DOANH_THU' THEN data_value END) AS DOANH_THU
    FROM (
        SELECT
            rn, company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id,
            report_year, report_quarter,
            CASE
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='400')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='400')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='500')) THEN 'VCSH'
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='21')) THEN 'LNST'
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='10')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='10')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='03')) THEN 'DOANH_THU'
            END AS chi_tieu,
            data_value
        FROM (
            SELECT x.*,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                       PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id, x.report_year, x.report_quarter, x.row_id, x.col_id
                       ORDER BY x.updated_date DESC, x.created_date DESC, x.data_id DESC
                   ) AS rn
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    cdc.company_profile_id,
                    cp.equity_ticker,
                    cp.equity_listing_exch,
                    cp.category_l1_id,
                    rc.enterprise_type_cd,
                    cdc.report_year,
                    cdc.report_quarter,
                    rc.report_cd,
                    rc2.id AS col_id,
                    rc2.col_desc,
                    rr.id AS row_id,
                    rr.row_desc,
                    d.data_value,
                    d.created_date,
                    d.updated_date,
                    d.id AS data_id
                FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.company_profiles cp
                  ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.data d
                  ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
                 AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
                 AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.report_catalog rc
                  ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
                 AND cdc.form_tp = rc.FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rrow rr
                  ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
                 AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rcol rc2
                  ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd
                 AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                WHERE 1=1
                and cp.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND d.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rc.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rr.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rc2.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rc2.col_desc IN ('1','2')
            ) x
        ) t
        WHERE rn = 1
    ) q
    WHERE chi_tieu IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id, report_year, report_quarter
)

WITH MDDS_LICH_SU AS (
    SELECT
        closePrice AS diem_dong_cua,
        change,
        symbol,
        floorCode,
        TO_DATE(tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay_gd
    FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR
),
DAY_CU AS (
    -- Đáy cũ = giá đóng cửa THẤP NHẤT trong N tháng trước đó, KHÔNG tính ngày hiện tại
    SELECT
        symbol,
        ngay_gd,
        diem_dong_cua,
        MIN(diem_dong_cua) OVER (
            PARTITION BY symbol
            ORDER BY ngay_gd
            RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL :so_thang MONTH PRECEDING AND INTERVAL 1 DAY PRECEDING
        ) AS day_cu
    FROM MDDS_LICH_SU
),
GIA_HIEN_TAI AS (
    SELECT
        d.symbol,
        d.diem_dong_cua,
        d.day_cu,
        m.change,
        m.floorCode
    FROM DAY_CU d
    JOIN MDDS_LICH_SU m ON d.symbol = m.symbol AND d.ngay_gd = m.ngay_gd
    WHERE date_format(d.ngay_gd, 'yyyyMMdd') = :den_ngay
),
KHGD AS (
    SELECT symbol, SUM(kl) AS tong_kl FROM (
        SELECT
            t.SYMBOL AS symbol,
            t.EXECUTION_VOLUME AS kl
        FROM krx.trade_book_hose t
        WHERE t.MARKET_ID = 'STK'
          AND date_format(to_date(t.TRADE_DATE, 'd/M/yyyy'), 'yyyyMMdd') = :den_ngay
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            t.ISSUE_CODE AS symbol,
            t.TRADE_QUANTITY AS kl
        FROM krx.trade_book_hnx t
        WHERE t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
          AND t.TRADE_DATE = :den_ngay
    ) x
    GROUP BY symbol
),
-- Xếp hạng top N mã THỦNG ĐÁY tại đến_ngày, sắp theo KLGD giảm dần
Top_Thung_Day AS (
    SELECT
        g.symbol,
        g.diem_dong_cua,
        g.day_cu,
        g.change,
        g.floorCode,
        ROUND((g.diem_dong_cua - g.day_cu) / NULLIF(g.day_cu, 0) * 100, 2) AS pct_thung_day,
        k.tong_kl
    FROM GIA_HIEN_TAI g
    LEFT JOIN KHGD k ON k.symbol = g.symbol
    WHERE g.diem_dong_cua < g.day_cu
    ORDER BY k.tong_kl DESC
    LIMIT :top_n
),
Khoi_luong_giao_dich AS (
    -- Khối lượng RIÊNG TỪNG PHIÊN, để hiển thị cột dưới mỗi cây nến
    SELECT symbol, Trade_date AS ngay_gd, SUM(kl) AS kl_KL
    FROM (
        SELECT t.Symbol AS symbol, t.Trade_date, t.Execution_Volume AS kl
        FROM TRADE_BOOK_HOSE t
        WHERE t.Trade_date BETWEEN :tu_ngay AND :den_ngay 
          AND t.Market_ID = 'STK'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT t.`Issue Code` AS symbol, t.Trade_date, t.Trade_quantity AS kl
        FROM TRADE_BOOK_HNX t
        WHERE t.Trade_date BETWEEN :tu_ngay AND :den_ngay 
          AND t.Market_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
    ) x
    GROUP BY symbol, Trade_date
),
MDDS AS (
    -- OHLC từng phiên trong khoảng tu_ngay -> den_ngay, chỉ lấy các mã nằm trong Top_Thung_Day
    SELECT 
        s.floorCode                                          AS san,
        s.symbol                                              AS ma_chung_khoan,
        s.StockType,
        TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY')                  AS ngay_gd,
        s.open                                                AS Gia_mo_cua,
        s.high                                                AS Gia_cao_nhat,
        s.low                                                 AS Gia_thap_nhat,
        s.closePrice                                          AS Gia_dong_cua,
        s.reference                                           AS Gia_tham_chieu
    FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR s
    JOIN JAD_CSIDXINFOR idx ON idx.Symbol = s.symbol
    JOIN Top_Thung_Day td    ON td.symbol = s.symbol
    WHERE TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') BETWEEN TO_DATE(:tu_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD') 
                                                    AND TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
      AND s.FloorCode  IN ('10', '02', '04', '03')
      AND s.StockType NOT IN ('1')
),
NGANH AS (
    SELECT c.industry_cd, c.industry_name, cp.equity_ticker 
    FROM IDS.categories c
    JOIN IDS.COMPANY_PROFILES cp ON cp.CATEGORY_L1_ID = c.id 
    WHERE c.active_flg = 1
),
Chi_so_thi_truong AS (
    SELECT idx.Symbol AS symbol, idx.INDEXCODE AS bo_chi_so_thi_truong
    FROM JAD_CSIDXINFOR idx
    WHERE idx.INDEXCODE IN ('HOSE','HNX','UPCOM')
),
Chi_so_nganh AS (
    SELECT idx.Symbol AS symbol, idx.INDEXCODE AS bo_chi_so_nganh
    FROM JAD_CSIDXINFOR idx
    WHERE idx.INDEXCODE NOT IN ('HOSE','HNX','UPCOM')
),
Ky_bao_cao AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        m.ngay_gd,
        CASE WHEN CEIL(MONTH(m.ngay_gd) / 3.0) = 1 THEN YEAR(m.ngay_gd) - 1 ELSE YEAR(m.ngay_gd) END AS report_year,
        CASE WHEN CEIL(MONTH(m.ngay_gd) / 3.0) = 1 THEN 4 ELSE CEIL(MONTH(m.ngay_gd) / 3.0) - 1 END AS report_quarter
    FROM MDDS m
),
LNST AS (
    SELECT SUM(d.data_value) AS lnst, equity_ticker, d.report_year, d.report_quarter
    FROM IDS.data d
    JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc     ON d.report_catalog_id = rc.id
    JOIN IDS.rrow rr                ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
    JOIN IDS.rcol rc2               ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
    JOIN IDS.company_profiles cp    ON cp.id = d.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID 
    JOIN Top_Thung_Day td            ON td.symbol = equity_ticker
    WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1' AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
      AND ((rc.enterprise_type_cd = 'dn' AND rr.row_desc IN ('60'))
       OR  (rc.enterprise_type_cd = 'bh' AND rr.row_desc IN ('60'))
       OR  (rc.enterprise_type_cd = 'td' AND rr.row_desc IN ('21')))
    GROUP BY equity_ticker, d.report_year, d.report_quarter
),
Doanh_thu AS (
    SELECT SUM(d.data_value) AS doanh_thu, cp.equity_ticker AS MCK, d.report_year, d.report_quarter
    FROM IDS.data d
    JOIN IDS.company_profiles cp ON d.company_profile_id = cp.id
    JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc   ON d.report_catalog_id = rc.id
    JOIN IDS.rrow rr             ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
    JOIN IDS.rcol rc2            ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
    JOIN Top_Thung_Day td        ON td.symbol = cp.equity_ticker
    WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1' AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
      AND ((rc.enterprise_type_cd = 'dn' AND rr.row_desc IN ('10'))
       OR  (rc.enterprise_type_cd = 'bh' AND rr.row_desc IN ('10'))
       OR  (rc.enterprise_type_cd = 'td' AND rr.row_desc IN ('03')))
    GROUP BY cp.equity_ticker, d.report_year, d.report_quarter
)
SELECT 
    a.ma_chung_khoan,
    n.industry_name          AS nganh,
    CASE 
        WHEN a.san = '10' THEN 'HOSE'
        WHEN a.san = '02' THEN 'HNX'
        WHEN a.san = '04' THEN 'UPCOM'
        ELSE a.san
    END                       AS San,
    ctt.bo_chi_so_thi_truong AS Bo_chi_so_thi_truong,
    cn.bo_chi_so_nganh       AS Bo_chi_so_nganh,
    td.pct_thung_day          AS Phan_tram_thung_day,   -- % thủng đáy (tại đến_ngày, dùng để xếp hạng)
    td.day_cu                 AS Day_cu,
    a.ngay_gd,
    a.Gia_mo_cua,
    a.Gia_cao_nhat,
    a.Gia_thap_nhat,
    a.Gia_dong_cua,
    a.Gia_tham_chieu,
    k.kl_KL                   AS khoi_luong,
    kb.report_year,
    kb.report_quarter,
    dt.doanh_thu,
    ln.lnst
FROM MDDS a
JOIN Top_Thung_Day td             ON td.symbol = a.ma_chung_khoan
JOIN NGANH n                     ON n.equity_ticker = a.ma_chung_khoan
LEFT JOIN Khoi_luong_giao_dich k ON k.symbol = a.ma_chung_khoan AND k.ngay_gd = a.ngay_gd
JOIN Ky_bao_cao kb               ON kb.ngay_gd = a.ngay_gd
LEFT JOIN Doanh_thu dt           ON dt.MCK = a.ma_chung_khoan AND dt.report_year = kb.report_year AND dt.report_quarter = kb.report_quarter
LEFT JOIN LNST ln                ON ln.equity_ticker = a.ma_chung_khoan AND ln.report_year = kb.report_year AND ln.report_quarter = kb.report_quarter
LEFT JOIN Chi_so_thi_truong ctt  ON ctt.symbol = a.ma_chung_khoan
LEFT JOIN Chi_so_nganh cn        ON cn.symbol = a.ma_chung_khoan
ORDER BY td.tong_kl DESC, a.ngay_gd;

Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd,
        statement_cd,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
            SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) AS statement_cd,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    cd.company_profile_id,
                    cd.report_year,
                    cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY
                    CASE
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
                    END,
                    cd.submission_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM gms_ids_uat.company_data cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms f
            ON f.id = cd.form_id
           AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND f.form_cd LIKE '%QUAR'
          AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')
          AND cd.submission_date <= ts.den_ngay
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM gms_ids_uat.violation_report vr
              JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf
                  ON vf.id = vr.form_id
                 AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
              WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year
                AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                AND vr.base_date <= ts.den_ngay
          )
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* Doanh thu theo từng kỳ BCTC */
Doanh_thu AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        doanh_thu,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cdc.company_profile_id,
            cp.equity_ticker,
            cdc.report_year,
            cdc.report_quarter,
            d.data_value AS doanh_thu,
            cdc.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    d.company_profile_id,
                    d.report_year,
                    d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY
                    d.updated_date DESC NULLS LAST,
                    d.created_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp
            ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d
            ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
           AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
           AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc
            ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
           AND rc.financial_statement_cd = cdc.statement_cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr
            ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
           AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rcol
            ON rcol.col_cd = d.col_cd
           AND rcol.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        WHERE rcol.col_desc = '1'
          AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
          AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
          AND (
              (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) IN ('DN', 'BH')
               AND rr.row_desc = '10')
              OR (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD'
                  AND rr.row_desc = '03')
          )
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)

WITH
/* BƯỚC 1:
   Xác định đúng 1 company_data cho mỗi NNT + kỳ:
   - Kỳ phải tồn tại trong violation_report với base_date <= :den_ngay
   - company_data phải APPROVED
   - Chỉ lấy HN/TH/ME/RI
   - Ưu tiên loại báo cáo: HN -> TH -> ME -> RI
   - Trong cùng loại báo cáo: lấy submission_date mới nhất
*/
Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd,
        submission_date
        ,SUBSTR(form_cd,1,2) STATEMENT_CD
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY CASE         WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
                                                                WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
                                                                WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
                                                                WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
                                                        END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM gms_ids_uat.company_data cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND f.form_cd LIKE '%QUAR'
          AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM gms_ids_uat.violation_report vr
                          JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf ON vf.id = vr.form_id AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
              WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year
                AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                AND vr.base_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')

          )
                                  AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')
                                AND cd.submission_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
    
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),

/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 2:
   - Từ các kỳ hợp lệ ở trên, lấy LNST trong DATA
   - DATA join bằng: company_profile_id + report_year + report_quarter
   - Chỉ các kỳ thực sự có LNST mới tồn tại ở đây
   - Xếp thứ tự và lấy 4 kỳ LNST gần nhất
   ========================================================= */
LNST_4_ky AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        lnst
    FROM (
        SELECT x.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id ORDER BY x.report_year DESC, x.report_quarter DESC ) AS rn     
        FROM (
            SELECT
                cdc.company_profile_id,
                cp.equity_ticker,
                cdc.report_year,
                cdc.report_quarter,
                d.data_value AS lnst
                ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY d.company_profile_id, d.report_year, d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY d.UPDATED_DATE DESC NULLS LAST, d.CREATED_DATE DESC
            ) AS rn1
            FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
               AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
               AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
               AND cdc.STATEMENT_CD = FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD
                        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
            WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
              AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
              AND (
                     ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'DN' AND rr.row_desc = '60' )
                  OR ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'BH' AND rr.row_desc = '60' )
                  OR ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD' AND rr.row_desc = '21' )
              )

WITH
/* Giá đóng cửa phiên gần nhất trước ngày bắt đầu */
Gia_dau AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        gia_dong_cua AS gia_dau
    FROM (
        SELECT
            g.symbol,
            g.closePrice gia_dong_cua,
			g.floorCode,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY g.symbol
                ORDER BY g.ngay_gd DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM tmp_jad_stockinfor_eod g
        WHERE TO_DATE(g.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') < :tu_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* Giá đóng cửa phiên gần nhất tại hoặc trước ngày kết thúc */
Gia_cuoi AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        gia_dong_cua,
        ngay_gd AS ngay_gia_cuoi,
		floorCode
    FROM (
        SELECT
            g.symbol,
            g.closePrice gia_dong_cua,
            g.tradingdate ngay_gd ,
			g.floorCode,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY g.symbol
                ORDER BY g.tradingdate DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM tmp_jad_stockinfor_eod g
        WHERE TO_DATE(g.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') <= :den_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)
,Top_giam_gia AS (
    SELECT
        gc.symbol,
        gc.floorcode,
        gc.gia_dong_cua,
        gd.gia_dau,
        ROUND(
            (gc.gia_dong_cua - gd.gia_dau)
            / NULLIF(gd.gia_dau, 0) * 100,
            2
        ) AS phan_tram_thay_doi
    FROM Gia_cuoi gc
    JOIN Gia_dau gd
        ON gd.symbol = gc.symbol
    WHERE gc.gia_dong_cua < gd.gia_dau
)
/* Tổng khối lượng giao dịch trong khoảng lọc */
KHGD AS (
    SELECT
    symbol,
    SUM(kl) AS tong_kl
FROM (
    SELECT
        t.symbol,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
                  AND t.BOARD_TYPE  NOT IN ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')
             THEN CAST(REPLACE(t.EXECUTION_VOLUME, ',', '') AS DECIMAL(38,2))) AS kl
    FROM uat_ordertrade_stg.trade_book_hose t
    WHERE date_format(TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd')
          BETWEEN :Tu_ngay AND :Đen_ngay
      AND t.market_id = 'STK'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        t.issue_code AS symbol,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                  AND t.BOARD_ID NOT IN ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')
             THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY                                    ELSE 0 END) AS kl
    FROM uat_ordertrade_stg.trade_book_hnx t
    WHERE date_format(TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd')
          BETWEEN :Tu_ngay AND :Đen_ngay
      AND t.market_id IN ('STX', 'UPX')
)
GROUP BY symbol
),
/* KLLH gần nhất có hiệu lực tại ngày kết thúc */
KLLH_asof AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        so_luong_cp_luu_hanh
    FROM (
        SELECT
            t.ticker_symbol AS symbol,
            t.outstanding_shares AS so_luong_cp_luu_hanh,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY t.ticker_symbol
                ORDER BY TO_DATE(t.snapshot_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM uat_vsdc_stg.outstanding_shares  t
        WHERE 1=1
          AND TO_DATE(t.ds_snpst_dt, 'yyyy-MM-dd') <= :den_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)
,Von_hoa AS (
    SELECT
        gc.symbol,
        gc.gia_dong_cua AS gia_cuoi,
        k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh AS kllh,
        CASE
            WHEN gc.gia_dong_cua IS NOT NULL
             AND k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh IS NOT NULL
            THEN gc.gia_dong_cua * k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh
        END AS von_hoa
    FROM Gia_cuoi gc
    LEFT JOIN KLLH_asof k
        ON k.symbol = gc.symbol
)
/* BƯỚC 1:
   Xác định đúng 1 company_data cho mỗi NNT + kỳ:
   - company_data phải APPROVED
   - Ưu tiên loại báo cáo: HN -> TH -> ME -> RI
   - Trong cùng loại báo cáo: lấy submission_date mới nhất
*/
,Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd, form_tp,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
			substr(f.form_cd,1,2) as form_tp,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY CASE 	WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
							END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM UAT_IDS_STG.company_data cd
        JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND cd.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
          AND f.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
--    AND report_year in (:p_year)
--	AND report_quarter in (:p_quarter)
),
/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 2: tính các chỉ tiêu theo từng DN, từng kỳ
   - Từ các kỳ hợp lệ ở trên, lấy chỉ tiêu trong DATA
   - DATA join bằng: company_profile_id + report_year + report_quarter
   - Điều kiện FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD = form_tp
   - Cùng chỉ tiêu: lấy create_date mới nhất
   ========================================================= */
Chitiet_DN AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
		Case when report_quarter = 1 then to_date ('31-03-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy')
			when report_quarter = 2 then to_date ('30-06-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy')
			when report_quarter = 3 then to_date ('30-09-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy')
			when report_quarter = 4 then to_date ('31-12-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy') 
			end as Ngay_ket_thuc,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'VCSH' THEN data_value END) AS VCSH,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'LNST' THEN data_value END) AS LNST,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'DOANH_THU' THEN data_value END) AS DOANH_THU
    FROM (
        SELECT
            rn, company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id,
            report_year, report_quarter,
            CASE
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='400')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='400')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='500')) THEN 'VCSH'
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='21')) THEN 'LNST'
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='10')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='10')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='03')) THEN 'DOANH_THU'
            END AS chi_tieu,
            data_value
        FROM (
            SELECT x.*,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                       PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id, x.report_year, x.report_quarter, x.row_id, x.col_id
                       ORDER BY x.updated_date DESC, x.created_date DESC, x.data_id DESC
                   ) AS rn
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    cdc.company_profile_id,
                    cp.equity_ticker,
                    cp.equity_listing_exch,
                    cp.category_l1_id,
                    rc.enterprise_type_cd,
                    cdc.report_year,
                    cdc.report_quarter,
                    rc.report_cd,
                    rc2.id AS col_id,
                    rc2.col_desc,
                    rr.id AS row_id,
                    rr.row_desc,
                    d.data_value,
                    d.created_date,
                    d.updated_date,
                    d.id AS data_id
                FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.company_profiles cp
                  ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.data d
                  ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
                 AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
                 AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.report_catalog rc
                  ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
                 AND cdc.form_tp = rc.FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rrow rr
                  ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
                 AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rcol rc2
                  ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd
                 AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                WHERE 1=1
                and cp.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND d.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rc.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rr.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rc2.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rc2.col_desc IN ('1','2')
            ) x
        ) t
        WHERE rn = 1
    ) q
    WHERE chi_tieu IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id, report_year, report_quarter
)

    LEFT JOIN Von_hoa vh

    LEFT JOIN Nganh ng

    LEFT JOIN LNST_TTM lt

    LEFT JOIN VCSH_moi_nhat vm

)

WHERE stt <= :top_n
ORDER BY stt;

        Company_data_chuan AS (

                        form_cd,
                        submission_date

                                cd.id AS company_data_id,
                                f.form_cd,
                                cd.submission_date,
                                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                                        ORDER BY CASE         WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
                                                                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
                                                                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
                                                                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4

                                        AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                                        AND vr.base_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
                          )
                                  AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')

                           AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
                        JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc
                                ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id

                        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr
                                ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd

                        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rcol
                                ON rcol.col_cd = d.col_cd

                                          AND rr.row_desc = '500')
                          )

        )

                )

Gia_dau AS (

Gia_cuoi AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,

		floorCode
    FROM (
        SELECT
            g.symbol,
            g.closePrice gia_dong_cua,

                PARTITION BY g.symbol

            ) AS rn
        FROM tmp_jad_stockinfor_eod g
        WHERE TO_DATE(g.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') <= :den_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)
,Top_giam_gia AS (
    SELECT
        gc.symbol,
        gc.floorcode,
        gc.gia_dong_cua,
        gd.gia_dau,
        ROUND(
            (gc.gia_dong_cua - gd.gia_dau)
            / NULLIF(gd.gia_dau, 0) * 100,
            2
        ) AS phan_tram_thay_doi
    FROM Gia_cuoi gc
    JOIN Gia_dau gd
        ON gd.symbol = gc.symbol
    WHERE gc.gia_dong_cua < gd.gia_dau
)
/* Tổng khối lượng giao dịch trong khoảng lọc */
KHGD AS (
    SELECT
    symbol,
    SUM(kl) AS tong_kl
FROM (
    SELECT
        t.symbol,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
                  AND t.BOARD_TYPE  NOT IN ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')
             THEN CAST(REPLACE(t.EXECUTION_VOLUME, ',', '') AS DECIMAL(38,2))) AS kl
    FROM uat_ordertrade_stg.trade_book_hose t
    WHERE date_format(TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd')
          BETWEEN :Tu_ngay AND :Đen_ngay
      AND t.market_id = 'STK'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        t.issue_code AS symbol,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                  AND t.BOARD_ID NOT IN ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')
             THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY                                    ELSE 0 END) AS kl
    FROM uat_ordertrade_stg.trade_book_hnx t
    WHERE date_format(TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd')
          BETWEEN :Tu_ngay AND :Đen_ngay
      AND t.market_id IN ('STX', 'UPX')
)
GROUP BY symbol
),
/* KLLH gần nhất có hiệu lực tại ngày kết thúc */
KLLH_asof AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        so_luong_cp_luu_hanh
    FROM (
        SELECT
            t.ticker_symbol AS symbol,
            t.outstanding_shares AS so_luong_cp_luu_hanh,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY t.ticker_symbol
                ORDER BY TO_DATE(t.snapshot_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM uat_vsdc_stg.outstanding_shares  t
        WHERE 1=1
          AND TO_DATE(t.ds_snpst_dt, 'yyyy-MM-dd') <= :den_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)
,Von_hoa AS (
    SELECT
        gc.symbol,
        gc.gia_dong_cua AS gia_cuoi,
        k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh AS kllh,
        CASE
            WHEN gc.gia_dong_cua IS NOT NULL
             AND k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh IS NOT NULL
            THEN gc.gia_dong_cua * k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh
        END AS von_hoa
    FROM Gia_cuoi gc
    LEFT JOIN KLLH_asof k
        ON k.symbol = gc.symbol
)

,Company_data_chuan AS (

    FROM (

            f.form_cd,
			substr(f.form_cd,1,2) as form_tp,

                ORDER BY CASE 	WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
							END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM UAT_IDS_STG.company_data cd
        JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND cd.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
          AND f.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
--    AND report_year in (:p_year)
--	AND report_quarter in (:p_quarter)
),
/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 2: tính các chỉ tiêu theo từng DN, từng kỳ
   - Từ các kỳ hợp lệ ở trên, lấy chỉ tiêu trong DATA
   - DATA join bằng: company_profile_id + report_year + report_quarter
   - Điều kiện FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD = form_tp
   - Cùng chỉ tiêu: lấy create_date mới nhất
   ========================================================= */
Chitiet_DN AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
		Case when report_quarter = 1 then to_date ('31-03-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy')
			when report_quarter = 2 then to_date ('30-06-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy')
			when report_quarter = 3 then to_date ('30-09-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy')
			when report_quarter = 4 then to_date ('31-12-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy') 
			end as Ngay_ket_thuc,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'VCSH' THEN data_value END) AS VCSH,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'LNST' THEN data_value END) AS LNST,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'DOANH_THU' THEN data_value END) AS DOANH_THU
    FROM (
        SELECT
            rn, company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id,
            report_year, report_quarter,
            CASE
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='400')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='400')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='500')) THEN 'VCSH'
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='21')) THEN 'LNST'
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='10')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='10')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='03')) THEN 'DOANH_THU'
            END AS chi_tieu,
            data_value
        FROM (
            SELECT x.*,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                       PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id, x.report_year, x.report_quarter, x.row_id, x.col_id
                       ORDER BY x.updated_date DESC, x.created_date DESC, x.data_id DESC
                   ) AS rn
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    cdc.company_profile_id,
                    cp.equity_ticker,
                    cp.equity_listing_exch,
                    cp.category_l1_id,
                    rc.enterprise_type_cd,
                    cdc.report_year,
                    cdc.report_quarter,
                    rc.report_cd,
                    rc2.id AS col_id,
                    rc2.col_desc,
                    rr.id AS row_id,
                    rr.row_desc,
                    d.data_value,
                    d.created_date,
                    d.updated_date,
                    d.id AS data_id
                FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.company_profiles cp
                  ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.data d
                  ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
                 AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
                 AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.report_catalog rc
                  ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
                 AND cdc.form_tp = rc.FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rrow rr
                  ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
                 AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rcol rc2
                  ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd
                 AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                WHERE 1=1
                and cp.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND d.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rc.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rr.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rc2.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rc2.col_desc IN ('1','2')
            ) x
        ) t
        WHERE rn = 1
    ) q
    WHERE chi_tieu IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id, report_year, report_quarter
)

    ma,
    san,
    nganh,
    tong_kl,
    gia_dong_cua,
    thay_doi,
    phan_tram_thay_doi,
    von_hoa,
    pe,
    pb
	(

            ORDER BY
                tg.phan_tram_thay_doi DESC,
                tg.symbol
        ) AS stt,
        tg.symbol AS ma,

        CASE
