            WHEN tg.floorcode = '02' THEN 'HNX'
            WHEN tg.floorcode = '04' THEN 'UPCOM'
            ELSE tg.floorcode
        END AS san,

        ng.industry_name AS nganh,
        kh.tong_kl,
        tg.gia_dong_cua,
        tg.gia_dong_cua - tg.gia_dau AS thay_doi,
        tg.phan_tram_thay_doi,
        vh.von_hoa,
        ROUND(vh.von_hoa / NULLIF(lt.lnst_ttm, 0), 2) AS pe,
        ROUND(vh.von_hoa / NULLIF(vm.vcsh, 0), 2) AS pb
    FROM Top_giam_gia tg
    LEFT JOIN KHGD kh
        ON kh.symbol = tg.symbol
    LEFT JOIN Von_hoa vh
        ON vh.symbol = tg.symbol
    LEFT JOIN Nganh ng
        ON ng.equity_ticker = tg.symbol
    LEFT JOIN LNST_TTM lt
        ON lt.equity_ticker = tg.symbol
    LEFT JOIN VCSH_moi_nhat vm
        ON vm.equity_ticker = tg.symbol
)

WHERE stt <= :top_n
ORDER BY stt;

column21:
WITH GIA_DAU AS 
(
    -- Giá đóng cửa tại phiên giao dịch gần nhất TRƯỚC từ_ngày (dùng để xếp hạng % tăng giá)
    SELECT symbol, closePrice AS gia_dau
    FROM (
        SELECT symbol, closePrice, tradingdate,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY tradingdate DESC) AS rn
        FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR
        WHERE tradingdate < :tu_ngay
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1
),
GIA_CUOI AS 
(
    SELECT symbol, closePrice AS gia_cuoi, floorCode
    FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR
    WHERE tradingdate = :den_ngay
),
Top_Ma AS
(
    -- Xếp hạng top N mã TĂNG GIÁ nhiều nhất, có thể lọc thêm theo Sàn hoặc Bộ chỉ số
    SELECT 
        gc.symbol,
        ROUND((gc.gia_cuoi - gd.gia_dau) / NULLIF(gd.gia_dau, 0) * 100, 2) AS pct_thay_doi
    FROM GIA_CUOI gc
    JOIN GIA_DAU gd ON gc.symbol = gd.symbol
    WHERE 
        (:san = 'ALL' OR (
            (:san = 'HOSE'  AND gc.floorCode = '10')
         OR (:san = 'HNX'   AND gc.floorCode = '02')
         OR (:san = 'UPCOM' AND gc.floorCode = '04')
        ))
        AND (:chi_so = 'ALL' OR gc.symbol IN (
            SELECT idx.Symbol FROM JAD_CSIDXINFOR idx WHERE idx.INDEXCODE = :chi_so
        ))
    ORDER BY pct_thay_doi DESC   -- DESC = tăng nhiều nhất lên đầu
    LIMIT :top_n
),
Khoi_luong_giao_dich AS
(
    -- Khối lượng RIÊNG TỪNG PHIÊN, để hiển thị cột dưới mỗi cây nến
    SELECT symbol, Trade_date AS ngay_gd, SUM(kl) AS kl_KL
    FROM (
        SELECT t.Symbol AS symbol, t.Trade_date, t.Execution_Volume AS kl
        FROM TRADE_BOOK_HOSE t
        WHERE t.Trade_date BETWEEN :tu_ngay AND :den_ngay 
          AND t.Market_ID = 'STK'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT t.`Issue Code` AS symbol, t.Trade_date, t.Trade_quantity AS kl
        FROM TRADE_BOOK_HNX t
        WHERE t.Trade_date BETWEEN :tu_ngay AND :den_ngay 
          AND t.Market_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
    ) x
    GROUP BY symbol, Trade_date
),
MDDS AS 
(
    -- OHLC từng phiên, chỉ lấy các mã nằm trong Top_Ma
    SELECT 
        s.floorCode                                          AS san,
        s.symbol                                              AS ma_chung_khoan,
        s.StockType,
        TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY')                  AS ngay_gd,
        s.open                                                AS Gia_mo_cua,
        s.high                                                AS Gia_cao_nhat,
        s.low                                                 AS Gia_thap_nhat,
        s.closePrice                                          AS Gia_dong_cua,
        s.reference                                           AS Gia_tham_chieu
    FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR s
    JOIN JAD_CSIDXINFOR idx ON idx.Symbol = s.symbol
    JOIN Top_Ma t            ON t.symbol = s.symbol
    WHERE TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') BETWEEN TO_DATE(:tu_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD') 
                                                    AND TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
      AND s.FloorCode  IN ('10', '02', '04', '03')
      AND s.StockType NOT IN ('1')
),
NGANH AS 
(
    SELECT c.industry_cd, c.industry_name, cp.equity_ticker 
    FROM IDS.categories c
    JOIN IDS.COMPANY_PROFILES cp ON cp.CATEGORY_L1_ID = c.id 
    WHERE c.active_flg = 1
),
Chi_so_thi_truong AS
(
    SELECT idx.Symbol AS symbol, idx.INDEXCODE AS bo_chi_so_thi_truong
    FROM JAD_CSIDXINFOR idx
    WHERE idx.INDEXCODE IN ('HOSE','HNX','UPCOM')
),
Chi_so_nganh AS
(
    SELECT idx.Symbol AS symbol, idx.INDEXCODE AS bo_chi_so_nganh
    FROM JAD_CSIDXINFOR idx
    WHERE idx.INDEXCODE  NOT IN ('HOSE','HNX','UPCOM')
),
Ky_bao_cao AS 
(
    SELECT DISTINCT
        m.ngay_gd,
        CASE WHEN CEIL(MONTH(m.ngay_gd) / 3.0) = 1 THEN YEAR(m.ngay_gd) - 1 ELSE YEAR(m.ngay_gd) END AS report_year,
        CASE WHEN CEIL(MONTH(m.ngay_gd) / 3.0) = 1 THEN 4 ELSE CEIL(MONTH(m.ngay_gd) / 3.0) - 1 END AS report_quarter
    FROM MDDS m
),
LNST AS
(
    SELECT SUM(d.data_value) AS lnst, equity_ticker, d.report_year, d.report_quarter
    FROM IDS.data d
    JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc     ON d.report_catalog_id = rc.id
    JOIN IDS.rrow rr                ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
    JOIN IDS.rcol rc2               ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
    JOIN IDS.company_profiles cp    ON cp.id = d.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID 
    JOIN Top_Ma tm                  ON tm.symbol = equity_ticker
    WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1' AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
      AND ((rc.enterprise_type_cd = 'dn' AND rr.row_desc IN ('60'))
       OR  (rc.enterprise_type_cd = 'bh' AND rr.row_desc IN ('60'))
       OR  (rc.enterprise_type_cd = 'td' AND rr.row_desc IN ('21')))
    GROUP BY equity_ticker, d.report_year, d.report_quarter
),
Doanh_thu AS
(
    SELECT SUM(d.data_value) AS doanh_thu, cp.equity_ticker AS MCK, d.report_year, d.report_quarter
    FROM IDS.data d
    JOIN IDS.company_profiles cp ON d.company_profile_id = cp.id
    JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc   ON d.report_catalog_id = rc.id
    JOIN IDS.rrow rr             ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
    JOIN IDS.rcol rc2            ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
    JOIN Top_Ma tm               ON tm.symbol = cp.equity_ticker
    WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1' AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
      AND ((rc.enterprise_type_cd = 'dn' AND rr.row_desc IN ('10'))
       OR  (rc.enterprise_type_cd = 'bh' AND rr.row_desc IN ('10'))
       OR  (rc.enterprise_type_cd = 'td' AND rr.row_desc IN ('03')))
    GROUP BY cp.equity_ticker, d.report_year, d.report_quarter
)
SELECT 
    a.ma_chung_khoan,
    n.industry_name          AS nganh,
    CASE 
        WHEN a.san = '10' THEN 'HOSE'
        WHEN a.san = '02' THEN 'HNX'
        WHEN a.san = '04' THEN 'UPCOM'
        ELSE a.san
    END                       AS San,
    ctt.bo_chi_so_thi_truong AS Bo_chi_so_thi_truong,
    cn.bo_chi_so_nganh       AS Bo_chi_so_nganh,
    tm.pct_thay_doi           AS Phan_tram_thay_doi_gia,   -- % thay đổi TỔNG cả khoảng (dùng để xếp hạng)
    a.ngay_gd,
    a.Gia_mo_cua,
    a.Gia_cao_nhat,
    a.Gia_thap_nhat,
    a.Gia_dong_cua,
    a.Gia_tham_chieu,
    k.kl_KL                   AS khoi_luong,
    kb.report_year,
    kb.report_quarter,
    dt.doanh_thu,
    ln.lnst
FROM MDDS a
JOIN Top_Ma tm                   ON tm.symbol = a.ma_chung_khoan
JOIN NGANH n                     ON n.equity_ticker = a.ma_chung_khoan
LEFT JOIN Khoi_luong_giao_dich k ON k.symbol = a.ma_chung_khoan AND k.ngay_gd = a.ngay_gd
JOIN Ky_bao_cao kb               ON kb.ngay_gd = a.ngay_gd
LEFT JOIN Doanh_thu dt           ON dt.MCK = a.ma_chung_khoan AND dt.report_year = kb.report_year AND dt.report_quarter = kb.report_quarter
LEFT JOIN LNST ln                ON ln.equity_ticker = a.ma_chung_khoan AND ln.report_year = kb.report_year AND ln.report_quarter = kb.report_quarter
LEFT JOIN Chi_so_thi_truong ctt  ON ctt.symbol = a.ma_chung_khoan
LEFT JOIN Chi_so_nganh cn        ON cn.symbol = a.ma_chung_khoan
ORDER BY tm.pct_thay_doi DESC, a.ngay_gd;

Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd,
        statement_cd,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
            SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) AS statement_cd,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    cd.company_profile_id,
                    cd.report_year,
                    cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY
                    CASE
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
                    END,
                    cd.submission_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM gms_ids_uat.company_data cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms f
            ON f.id = cd.form_id
           AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND f.form_cd LIKE '%QUAR'
          AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')
          AND cd.submission_date <= ts.den_ngay
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM gms_ids_uat.violation_report vr
              JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf
                  ON vf.id = vr.form_id
                 AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
              WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year
                AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                AND vr.base_date <= ts.den_ngay
          )
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* Doanh thu theo từng kỳ BCTC */
Doanh_thu AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        doanh_thu,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cdc.company_profile_id,
            cp.equity_ticker,
            cdc.report_year,
            cdc.report_quarter,
            d.data_value AS doanh_thu,
            cdc.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    d.company_profile_id,
                    d.report_year,
                    d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY
                    d.updated_date DESC NULLS LAST,
                    d.created_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp
            ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d
            ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
           AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
           AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc
            ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
           AND rc.financial_statement_cd = cdc.statement_cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr
            ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
           AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rcol
            ON rcol.col_cd = d.col_cd
           AND rcol.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        WHERE rcol.col_desc = '1'
          AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
          AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
          AND (
              (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) IN ('DN', 'BH')
               AND rr.row_desc = '10')
              OR (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD'
                  AND rr.row_desc = '03')
          )
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)

Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd,
        statement_cd,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
            SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) AS statement_cd,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    cd.company_profile_id,
                    cd.report_year,
                    cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY
                    CASE
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
                    END,
                    cd.submission_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM gms_ids_uat.company_data cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms f
            ON f.id = cd.form_id
           AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND f.form_cd LIKE '%QUAR'
          AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')
          AND cd.submission_date <= ts.den_ngay
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM gms_ids_uat.violation_report vr
              JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf
                  ON vf.id = vr.form_id
                 AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
              WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year
                AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                AND vr.base_date <= ts.den_ngay
          )
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* LNST theo từng kỳ BCTC */
LNST AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        lnst,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cdc.company_profile_id,
            cp.equity_ticker,
            cdc.report_year,
            cdc.report_quarter,
            d.data_value AS lnst,
            cdc.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    d.company_profile_id,
                    d.report_year,
                    d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY
                    d.updated_date DESC NULLS LAST,
                    d.created_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp
            ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d
            ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
           AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
           AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc
            ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
           AND rc.financial_statement_cd = cdc.statement_cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr
            ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
           AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rcol
            ON rcol.col_cd = d.col_cd
           AND rcol.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        WHERE rcol.col_desc = '1'
          AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
          AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
          AND (
              (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) IN ('DN', 'BH')
               AND rr.row_desc = '60')
              OR (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD'
                  AND rr.row_desc = '21')
          )
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)

WITH
Tham_so AS (
    SELECT
        TO_DATE(:tu_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD') AS tu_ngay,
        TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD') AS den_ngay
    FROM DUAL
),
/* EOD từng mã; lấy snapshot cuối cùng trong ngày */
Gia_EOD AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        ngay_gd,
        gia_dong_cua,
		floorCode
    FROM (
        SELECT
            s.symbol,
            TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay_gd,
			floorCode,
            s.closePrice AS gia_dong_cua,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY s.symbol, s.tradingdate
                ORDER BY s.INDEXTIME DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR s
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') <= ts.den_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* Giá đóng cửa phiên gần nhất trước ngày bắt đầu */
Gia_dau AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        gia_dong_cua AS gia_dau
    FROM (
        SELECT
            g.symbol,
            g.gia_dong_cua,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY g.symbol
                ORDER BY g.ngay_gd DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Gia_EOD g
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE g.ngay_gd < ts.tu_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),

NDTNN AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        SUM(kl_mua) AS kl_mua,
        SUM(kl_ban) AS kl_ban,
        SUM(kl_mua) - SUM(kl_ban) AS kl_rong,
        SUM(gt_mua) AS gt_mua,
        SUM(gt_ban) AS gt_ban,
        SUM(gt_mua) - SUM(gt_ban) AS gt_rong
    FROM Giao_dich_NN_goc
    GROUP BY symbol
),

Xep_hang_NDTNN AS (
    SELECT
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN :loai_top = 'MUA_RONG' THEN nd.gt_rong
                END DESC NULLS LAST,

                CASE
                    WHEN :loai_top = 'BAN_RONG' THEN nd.gt_rong
                END ASC NULLS LAST,

                nd.symbol
        ) AS stt,

        nd.symbol AS ma,

        CASE
            WHEN gc.floorcode = '10' THEN 'HOSE'
            WHEN gc.floorcode = '02' THEN 'HNX'
            WHEN gc.floorcode = '04' THEN 'UPCOM'
            ELSE gc.floorcode
        END AS san,

        ng.industry_name AS nganh,
        gc.gia_dong_cua,
        gc.gia_dong_cua - gd.gia_dau AS thay_doi,

        ROUND(
            (gc.gia_dong_cua - gd.gia_dau)
            / NULLIF(gd.gia_dau, 0) * 100,
            2
        ) AS phan_tram_thay_doi,

        nd.kl_mua,
        nd.kl_ban,
        nd.kl_rong,
        nd.gt_mua,
        nd.gt_ban,
        nd.gt_rong,

        vh.von_hoa,
        ROUND(vh.von_hoa / NULLIF(lt.lnst_ttm, 0), 2) AS pe,
        ROUND(vh.von_hoa / NULLIF(vm.vcsh, 0), 2) AS pb
    FROM NDTNN nd
    LEFT JOIN Gia_cuoi gc
        ON gc.symbol = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN Gia_dau gd
        ON gd.symbol = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN Von_hoa vh
        ON vh.symbol = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN Nganh ng
        ON ng.equity_ticker = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN LNST_TTM lt
        ON lt.equity_ticker = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN VCSH_moi_nhat vm
        ON vm.equity_ticker = nd.symbol
    WHERE (:loai_top = 'MUA_RONG' AND nd.gt_rong > 0)
       OR (:loai_top = 'BAN_RONG' AND nd.gt_rong < 0)
)

SELECT
    stt,
    ma,
    san,
    nganh,
    gia_dong_cua,
    thay_doi,
    phan_tram_thay_doi,
    kl_mua,
    kl_ban,
    kl_rong,
    gt_mua,
    gt_ban,
    gt_rong,
    von_hoa,
    pe,
    pb
FROM Xep_hang_NDTNN
WHERE stt <= :top_n
ORDER BY stt;

NDTNN AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        SUM(kl_mua) AS kl_mua,
        SUM(kl_ban) AS kl_ban,
        SUM(kl_mua) - SUM(kl_ban) AS kl_rong,
        SUM(gt_mua) AS gt_mua,
        SUM(gt_ban) AS gt_ban,
        SUM(gt_mua) - SUM(gt_ban) AS gt_rong
    FROM Giao_dich_NN_goc
    GROUP BY symbol
),

Xep_hang_NDTNN AS (
    SELECT
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN :loai_top = 'MUA_RONG' THEN nd.gt_rong
                END DESC NULLS LAST,

                CASE
                    WHEN :loai_top = 'BAN_RONG' THEN nd.gt_rong
                END ASC NULLS LAST,

                nd.symbol
        ) AS stt,

        nd.symbol AS ma,

        CASE
            WHEN gc.floorcode = '10' THEN 'HOSE'
            WHEN gc.floorcode = '02' THEN 'HNX'
            WHEN gc.floorcode = '04' THEN 'UPCOM'
            ELSE gc.floorcode
        END AS san,

        ng.industry_name AS nganh,
        gc.gia_dong_cua,
        gc.gia_dong_cua - gd.gia_dau AS thay_doi,

        ROUND(
            (gc.gia_dong_cua - gd.gia_dau)
            / NULLIF(gd.gia_dau, 0) * 100,
            2
        ) AS phan_tram_thay_doi,

        nd.kl_mua,
        nd.kl_ban,
        nd.kl_rong,
        nd.gt_mua,
        nd.gt_ban,
        nd.gt_rong,

        vh.von_hoa,
        ROUND(vh.von_hoa / NULLIF(lt.lnst_ttm, 0), 2) AS pe,
        ROUND(vh.von_hoa / NULLIF(vm.vcsh, 0), 2) AS pb
    FROM NDTNN nd
    LEFT JOIN Gia_cuoi gc
        ON gc.symbol = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN Gia_dau gd
        ON gd.symbol = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN Von_hoa vh
        ON vh.symbol = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN Nganh ng
        ON ng.equity_ticker = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN LNST_TTM lt
        ON lt.equity_ticker = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN VCSH_moi_nhat vm
        ON vm.equity_ticker = nd.symbol
    WHERE (:loai_top = 'MUA_RONG' AND nd.gt_rong > 0)
       OR (:loai_top = 'BAN_RONG' AND nd.gt_rong < 0)
)

SELECT
    stt,
    ma,
    san,
    nganh,
    gia_dong_cua,
    thay_doi,
    phan_tram_thay_doi,
    kl_mua,
    kl_ban,
    kl_rong,
    gt_mua,
    gt_ban,
    gt_rong,
    von_hoa,
    pe,
    pb
FROM Xep_hang_NDTNN
WHERE stt <= :top_n
ORDER BY stt;

WITH
Tham_so AS (
    SELECT
        TO_DATE(:tu_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD') AS tu_ngay,
        TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD') AS den_ngay
    FROM DUAL
),
/* EOD từng mã; lấy snapshot cuối cùng trong ngày */
Gia_EOD AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        ngay_gd,
        gia_dong_cua,
		floorCode
    FROM (
        SELECT
            s.symbol,
            TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay_gd,
			floorCode,
            s.closePrice AS gia_dong_cua,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY s.symbol, s.tradingdate
                ORDER BY s.INDEXTIME DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR s
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') <= ts.den_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* Giá đóng cửa phiên gần nhất trước ngày bắt đầu */
Gia_dau AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        gia_dong_cua AS gia_dau
    FROM (
        SELECT
            g.symbol,
            g.gia_dong_cua,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY g.symbol
                ORDER BY g.ngay_gd DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Gia_EOD g
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE g.ngay_gd < ts.tu_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* Giá đóng cửa phiên gần nhất tại hoặc trước ngày kết thúc */
Gia_cuoi AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        gia_dong_cua,
        ngay_gd AS ngay_gia_cuoi,
		floorCode
    FROM (
        SELECT
            g.symbol,
            g.gia_dong_cua,
            g.ngay_gd,
			g.floorCode,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY g.symbol
                ORDER BY g.ngay_gd DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Gia_EOD g
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE g.ngay_gd <= ts.den_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* KLLH gần nhất có hiệu lực tại ngày kết thúc */
KLLH_asof AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        so_luong_cp_luu_hanh
    FROM (
        SELECT
            t.MCK AS symbol,
            t."Khối lượng chứng khoán đang lưu hành"
                AS so_luong_cp_luu_hanh,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY t.MCK
                ORDER BY TO_DATE(t."Ngày báo cáo", 'DD/MM/YYYY') DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM "BM 1_Báo cáo về khối lượng chứng khoán đang lưu hành" t
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE t.Loai_CK = 'Co phieu'
          AND TO_DATE(t."Ngày báo cáo", 'DD/MM/YYYY') <= ts.den_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
Von_hoa AS (
    SELECT
        gc.symbol,
        gc.gia_dong_cua AS gia_cuoi,
        k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh AS kllh,
        CASE
            WHEN gc.gia_dong_cua IS NOT NULL
             AND k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh IS NOT NULL
            THEN gc.gia_dong_cua * k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh
        END AS von_hoa
    FROM Gia_cuoi gc
    LEFT JOIN KLLH_asof k
        ON k.symbol = gc.symbol
),
Nganh AS (
    SELECT
        cp.equity_ticker,
        c.industry_name
    FROM gms_ids_uat.categories c
    JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp
        ON cp.category_l1_id = c.id
    WHERE c.active_flg = 1
),

(
    SELECT

    FROM JAD_CSIDXINFOR idx
    JOIN JAD_MARKETINFOR m ON m.MARKETCODE = idx.INDEXCODE
    WHERE m.MARKETCODE IN ('HOSE','UPCOM','HNX')
),
Chi_so_nganh AS
(

    FROM JAD_CSIDXINFOR idx
    JOIN JAD_MARKETINFOR m ON m.MARKETCODE = idx.INDEXCODE
     WHERE m.MARKETCODE NOT IN ('HOSE','UPCOM','HNX')
)
/* BƯỚC 1:
   Xác định đúng 1 company_data cho mỗi NNT + kỳ:
   - Kỳ phải tồn tại trong violation_report với base_date <= :den_ngay
   - company_data phải APPROVED
   - Chỉ lấy HN/TH/ME/RI
   - Ưu tiên loại báo cáo: HN -> TH -> ME -> RI
   - Trong cùng loại báo cáo: lấy submission_date mới nhất
*/
Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd,
        submission_date
        ,SUBSTR(form_cd,1,2) STATEMENT_CD
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY CASE 	WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
							END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM gms_ids_uat.company_data cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND f.form_cd LIKE '%QUAR'
          AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM gms_ids_uat.violation_report vr
			  JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf ON vf.id = vr.form_id AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
              WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year
                AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                AND vr.base_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
				
          )
		  AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')
		  AND cd.submission_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
		  AND vr.LANGUAGE_CD = 'VI'
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),

                WHEN t.sell_foreign_investor_type_code IN ('10', '20')
                THEN t.trade_quantity
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS kl_ban,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.buy_foreign_investor_type_code IN ('10', '20')
                THEN t.trade_value
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS gt_mua,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.sell_foreign_investor_type_code IN ('10', '20')
                THEN t.trade_value
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS gt_ban
    FROM krx.trade_book_hnx t
    CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
    WHERE TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
          BETWEEN ts.tu_ngay AND ts.den_ngay
      AND t.market_id IN ('STX', 'UPX')
    GROUP BY t."Issue Code"
),

NDTNN AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        SUM(kl_mua) AS kl_mua,
        SUM(kl_ban) AS kl_ban,
        SUM(kl_mua) - SUM(kl_ban) AS kl_rong,
        SUM(gt_mua) AS gt_mua,
        SUM(gt_ban) AS gt_ban,
        SUM(gt_mua) - SUM(gt_ban) AS gt_rong
    FROM Giao_dich_NN_goc
    GROUP BY symbol
),

Xep_hang_NDTNN AS (
    SELECT
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN :loai_top = 'MUA_RONG' THEN nd.gt_rong
                END DESC NULLS LAST,

                CASE
                    WHEN :loai_top = 'BAN_RONG' THEN nd.gt_rong
                END ASC NULLS LAST,

                nd.symbol
        ) AS stt,

        nd.symbol AS ma,

        CASE
            WHEN gc.floorcode = '10' THEN 'HOSE'
            WHEN gc.floorcode = '02' THEN 'HNX'
            WHEN gc.floorcode = '04' THEN 'UPCOM'
            ELSE gc.floorcode
        END AS san,

        ng.industry_name AS nganh,
        gc.gia_dong_cua,
        gc.gia_dong_cua - gd.gia_dau AS thay_doi,

        ROUND(
            (gc.gia_dong_cua - gd.gia_dau)
            / NULLIF(gd.gia_dau, 0) * 100,
            2
        ) AS phan_tram_thay_doi,

        nd.kl_mua,
        nd.kl_ban,
        nd.kl_rong,
        nd.gt_mua,
        nd.gt_ban,
        nd.gt_rong,

        vh.von_hoa,
        ROUND(vh.von_hoa / NULLIF(lt.lnst_ttm, 0), 2) AS pe,
        ROUND(vh.von_hoa / NULLIF(vm.vcsh, 0), 2) AS pb
    FROM NDTNN nd
    LEFT JOIN Gia_cuoi gc
        ON gc.symbol = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN Gia_dau gd
        ON gd.symbol = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN Von_hoa vh
        ON vh.symbol = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN Nganh ng
        ON ng.equity_ticker = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN LNST_TTM lt
        ON lt.equity_ticker = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN VCSH_moi_nhat vm
        ON vm.equity_ticker = nd.symbol
    WHERE (:loai_top = 'MUA_RONG' AND nd.gt_rong > 0)
       OR (:loai_top = 'BAN_RONG' AND nd.gt_rong < 0)
)

SELECT
    stt,
    ma,
    san,
    nganh,
    gia_dong_cua,
    thay_doi,
    phan_tram_thay_doi,
    kl_mua,
    kl_ban,
    kl_rong,
    gt_mua,
    gt_ban,
    gt_rong,
    von_hoa,
    pe,
    pb
FROM Xep_hang_NDTNN
WHERE stt <= :top_n
ORDER BY stt;

WITH
/* Giá đóng cửa phiên gần nhất tại hoặc trước ngày kết thúc */
Gia_cuoi AS (  
        SELECT
            s.symbol,

            s.floorcode,
--			cat.industry_name               AS ten_nganh, 
            s.closeprice AS gia_dong_cua,
			s.change					Thay_doi,
--			idx.indexcode   AS bo_chi_so,
            CASE
        WHEN s.reference IS NULL OR s.reference = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND((s.change / s.reference) * 100, 2)
    END                              AS pct_thay_doi
        FROM uat_mdds_stg.tmp_jad_stockinfor_eod  s
--		LEFT JOIN uat_ids_stg.company_profiles cp
--        	ON cp.equity_ticker    = s.symbol
--    	LEFT JOIN uat_ids_stg.categories cat

--        	AND cat.active_flg  = 1
	WHERE date_format(TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd') = :den_ngay
),
/* KLLH gần nhất có hiệu lực tại ngày kết thúc */
KLLH_asof AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        so_luong_cp_luu_hanh
    FROM (
        SELECT
            t.ticker_symbol AS symbol,
            t.outstanding_shares AS so_luong_cp_luu_hanh,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY t.ticker_symbol
                ORDER BY TO_DATE(t.snapshot_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM uat_vsdc_stg.outstanding_shares  t
        WHERE 1=1
          AND date_format(TO_DATE(t.snapshot_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd') <= :den_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)
,Von_hoa AS (
    SELECT
        gc.symbol,
        gc.gia_dong_cua AS gia_cuoi,
        k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh AS kllh,
        CASE
            WHEN gc.gia_dong_cua IS NOT NULL
             AND k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh IS NOT NULL
            THEN gc.gia_dong_cua * k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh
        END AS von_hoa
    FROM Gia_cuoi gc
    LEFT JOIN KLLH_asof k
        ON k.symbol = gc.symbol
)
,Giao_dich_NN_goc AS (
    -- HOSE: Market ID thực tế dùng 'STK', 'STO', 'UPX'
    SELECT
    t.SYMBOL                                                                AS symbol,
--    date_format(to_date(t.TRADE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd'),
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
                  AND t.BOARD_TYPE  NOT IN ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')
             THEN CAST(REPLACE(t.EXECUTION_VOLUME, ',', '') AS DECIMAL(38,2))) AS kl,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
                  AND t.BUY_FOREIGNER_INVESTOR_TYPE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.EXECUTION_VOLUME                    ELSE 0 END)        AS kl_nn_mua,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
                  AND t.SELL_FOREIGNER_INVESTOR_TYPE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.EXECUTION_VOLUME                    ELSE 0 END)        AS kl_nn_ban,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
                  AND t.BUY_FOREIGNER_INVESTOR_TYPE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.EXECUTION_Value                  ELSE 0 END)        AS gt_nn_mua,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
                  AND t.SELL_FOREIGNER_INVESTOR_TYPE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.EXECUTION_Value                    ELSE 0 END)        AS gt_nn_ban
FROM uat_ordertrade_stg.trade_book_hose t
WHERE 1=1
--	and symbol = 'SHB' 
   AND date_format(TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd')
          BETWEEN :tu_ngay AND :den_ngay
GROUP BY t.SYMBOL
union all 
SELECT
    t.ISSUE_CODE                                                            AS symbol,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                  AND t.BOARD_ID NOT IN ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')
             THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY                                    ELSE 0 END) AS kl,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                  AND t.BUY_FOREIGN_INVESTOR_TYPE_CODE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY                                    ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_mua,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                  AND t.SELL_FOREIGN_INVESTOR_TYPE_CODE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY                                    ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_ban,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                  AND t.BUY_FOREIGN_INVESTOR_TYPE_CODE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY  * trade_price                               ELSE 0 END) AS gt_nn_mua,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                  AND t.SELL_FOREIGN_INVESTOR_TYPE_CODE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY * trade_price                                 ELSE 0 END) AS gt_nn_ban
 from uat_ordertrade_stg.trade_book_hnx t
 where 1=1 
AND date_format(TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd')
          BETWEEN :tu_ngay AND :den_ngay
group by  t.ISSUE_CODE
),
NDTNN AS (

    FROM Giao_dich_NN_goc

/* BƯỚC 1:
   Xác định đúng 1 company_data cho mỗi NNT + kỳ:
   - company_data phải APPROVED
   - Ưu tiên loại báo cáo: HN -> TH -> ME -> RI
   - Trong cùng loại báo cáo: lấy submission_date mới nhất
*/
,Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd, form_tp,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
			substr(f.form_cd,1,2) as form_tp,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY CASE 	WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
							END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM UAT_IDS_STG.company_data cd
        JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND cd.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
          AND f.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
--    AND report_year in (:p_year)
--	AND report_quarter in (:p_quarter)
),
/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 2: tính các chỉ tiêu theo từng DN, từng kỳ
   - Từ các kỳ hợp lệ ở trên, lấy chỉ tiêu trong DATA
   - DATA join bằng: company_profile_id + report_year + report_quarter
   - Điều kiện FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD = form_tp
   - Cùng chỉ tiêu: lấy create_date mới nhất
   ========================================================= */
Chitiet_DN AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
		Case when report_quarter = 1 then to_date ('31-03-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy')
			when report_quarter = 2 then to_date ('30-06-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy')
			when report_quarter = 3 then to_date ('30-09-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy')
			when report_quarter = 4 then to_date ('31-12-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy') 
			end as Ngay_ket_thuc,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'VCSH' THEN data_value END) AS VCSH,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'LNST' THEN data_value END) AS LNST,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'DOANH_THU' THEN data_value END) AS DOANH_THU
    FROM (
        SELECT
            rn, company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id,
            report_year, report_quarter,
            CASE
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='400')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='400')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='500')) THEN 'VCSH'
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='21')) THEN 'LNST'
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='10')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='10')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='03')) THEN 'DOANH_THU'
            END AS chi_tieu,
            data_value
        FROM (
            SELECT x.*,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                       PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id, x.report_year, x.report_quarter, x.row_id, x.col_id
                       ORDER BY x.updated_date DESC, x.created_date DESC, x.data_id DESC
                   ) AS rn
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    cdc.company_profile_id,
                    cp.equity_ticker,
                    cp.equity_listing_exch,
                    cp.category_l1_id,
                    rc.enterprise_type_cd,
                    cdc.report_year,
                    cdc.report_quarter,
                    rc.report_cd,
                    rc2.id AS col_id,
                    rc2.col_desc,
                    rr.id AS row_id,
                    rr.row_desc,
                    d.data_value,
                    d.created_date,
                    d.updated_date,
                    d.id AS data_id
                FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.company_profiles cp
                  ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.data d
                  ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
                 AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
                 AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.report_catalog rc
                  ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
                 AND cdc.form_tp = rc.FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rrow rr
                  ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
                 AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rcol rc2
                  ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd
                 AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                WHERE 1=1
                and cp.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND d.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rc.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rr.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rc2.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rc2.col_desc IN ('1','2')
            ) x
        ) t
        WHERE rn = 1
    ) q
    WHERE chi_tieu IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id, report_year, report_quarter
)

,LNST4Q as 
(
SELECT 
company_profile_id,

		CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 4 THEN SUM(LNST) END AS lnst_ttm

FROM (

	)
WHERE rn1 <=4
group by

,VCSH as 
(
SELECT company_profile_id,

		sum (VCSH) VCSH
FROM (
	select company_profile_id,

        report_year,
        report_quarter,
		VCSH,
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY company_profile_id ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC ) AS rn1
	from Chitiet_DN ct
	where report_quarter in (1,2,3,4)
	and date_format(TO_DATE(Ngay_ket_thuc, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd')  <= :den_ngay
	)
WHERE rn1=1
group by

)
SELECT

    gia_dong_cua,
    thay_doi,
    pct_thay_doi,
    kl_mua,
    kl_ban,
    kl_rong,
    gt_mua,
    gt_ban,
    gt_rong,
    von_hoa,
    pe,
    pb
    from 
    (
    SELECT
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN :loai_top = 'MUA_RONG' THEN nd.gt_rong
                END DESC NULLS LAST,
                CASE
                    WHEN :loai_top = 'BAN_RONG' THEN nd.gt_rong
                END ASC NULLS LAST,
                nd.symbol
        ) AS stt,
--        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
--            ORDER BY
--                CASE
--                    WHEN :loai_top = 'MUA_RONG' THEN nd.kl_rong
--                END DESC NULLS LAST,
--                CASE
--                    WHEN :loai_top = 'BAN_RONG' THEN nd.kl_rong
--                END ASC NULLS LAST,
--                nd.symbol
--        ) AS stt,
        nd.symbol AS ma,
        CASE
            WHEN gc.floorcode = '10' THEN 'HOSE'
            WHEN gc.floorcode = '02' THEN 'HNX'
            WHEN gc.floorcode = '04' THEN 'UPCOM'
            ELSE gc.floorcode
        END AS san,
        gc.gia_dong_cua,
        gc.thay_doi,
        pct_thay_doi,
        nd.kl_mua,
        nd.kl_ban,
        nd.kl_rong,
        nd.gt_mua,
        nd.gt_ban,
        nd.gt_rong,
        vh.von_hoa,
        ROUND(vh.von_hoa / NULLIF(lt.lnst_ttm, 0), 2) AS pe,
        ROUND(vh.von_hoa / NULLIF(vm.vcsh, 0), 2) AS pb
    FROM NDTNN nd
    LEFT JOIN Gia_cuoi gc
        ON gc.symbol = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN Von_hoa vh
        ON vh.symbol = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN LNST4Q lt
        ON lt.equity_ticker = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN VCSH vm
        ON vm.equity_ticker = nd.symbol
    WHERE (:loai_top = 'MUA_RONG' AND nd.gt_rong > 0)
       OR (:loai_top = 'BAN_RONG' AND nd.gt_rong < 0)
--       AND
--       (:loai_top = 'MUA_RONG' AND nd.kl_rong > 0)
--       OR (:loai_top = 'BAN_RONG' AND nd.kl_rong < 0)
)
WHERE stt <= :top_n
ORDER BY stt;

Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd,
        statement_cd,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
            SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) AS statement_cd,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    cd.company_profile_id,
                    cd.report_year,
                    cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY
                    CASE
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
                    END,
                    cd.submission_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM gms_ids_uat.company_data cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms f
            ON f.id = cd.form_id
           AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND f.form_cd LIKE '%QUAR'
          AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')
          AND cd.submission_date <= ts.den_ngay
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM gms_ids_uat.violation_report vr
              JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf
                  ON vf.id = vr.form_id
                 AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
              WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year
                AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                AND vr.base_date <= ts.den_ngay
          )
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* Doanh thu theo từng kỳ BCTC */
Doanh_thu AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        doanh_thu,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cdc.company_profile_id,
            cp.equity_ticker,
            cdc.report_year,
            cdc.report_quarter,
            d.data_value AS doanh_thu,
            cdc.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    d.company_profile_id,
                    d.report_year,
                    d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY
                    d.updated_date DESC NULLS LAST,
                    d.created_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp
            ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d
            ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
           AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
           AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc
            ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
           AND rc.financial_statement_cd = cdc.statement_cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr
            ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
           AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rcol
            ON rcol.col_cd = d.col_cd
           AND rcol.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        WHERE rcol.col_desc = '1'
          AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
          AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
          AND (
              (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) IN ('DN', 'BH')
               AND rr.row_desc = '10')
              OR (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD'
                  AND rr.row_desc = '03')
          )
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)

-- ── 2. SỔ LỆNH – UNION HOSE + HNX (ĐÃ SỬA LỖI) ──────────────────────────────
With
MDDS AS (
    SELECT
            s.symbol,
            TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS ngay_gd,
            s.floorcode AS floor_code,
			cat.industry_name               AS ten_nganh, 
            s.closeprice AS gia_dong_cua,
			s.change					Thay_doi,
--			idx.indexcode   AS bo_chi_so,
            CASE
        WHEN s.reference IS NULL OR s.reference = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND((s.change / s.reference) * 100, 2)
    END                              AS pct_thay_doi,
    	CASE s.floorcode
                WHEN '10' THEN 'HOSE'
                WHEN '02' THEN 'HNX'
                WHEN '04' THEN 'UPCOM'
                WHEN '03' THEN 'FDS'
            END AS ten_san,
           s.reference AS gia_tham_chieu
        FROM uat_mdds_stg.tmp_jad_stockinfor_eod  s
		LEFT JOIN uat_ids_stg.company_profiles cp
        	ON cp.equity_ticker    = s.symbol and cp.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
    	LEFT JOIN uat_ids_stg.categories cat
        	ON cat.id           = cp.category_l1_id
        	AND cat.active_flg  = 1 and cat.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
	WHERE date_format(TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd') = :Ngay_gd
	          AND s.floorcode IN ('10', '02', '04', '03')
	          AND s.stocktype <> '1'
),
SCPLH AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        so_luong_cp_luu_hanh
    FROM (
        SELECT
            t.ticker_symbol AS symbol,
            t.outstanding_shares AS so_luong_cp_luu_hanh,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY t.ticker_symbol
                ORDER BY TO_DATE(t.snapshot_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM uat_vsdc_stg.outstanding_shares  t
        WHERE 1=1
          AND date_format(TO_DATE(t.snapshot_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd') <= :Ngay_gd
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
 )
 ,so_lenh AS (
    -- HOSE: Market ID thực tế dùng 'STK', 'STO', 'UPX'
    SELECT
    t.SYMBOL                                                                AS symbol,
--    date_format(to_date(t.TRADE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd'),
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
             THEN t.EXECUTION_VOLUME                    ELSE 0 END)        AS tong_kl,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
             THEN CAST(REPLACE(t.EXECUTION_VALUE, ',', '') AS DECIMAL(38,2))
             ELSE 0 END)                                                    AS tong_gt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
                  AND t.BOARD_TYPE IN ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')
             THEN t.EXECUTION_VOLUME                    ELSE 0 END)        AS tong_kl_tt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
                  AND t.BOARD_TYPE IN ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')
             THEN CAST(REPLACE(t.EXECUTION_VALUE, ',', '') AS DECIMAL(38,2))
             ELSE 0 END)                                                                                                      AS tong_gt_tt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
                  AND t.BUY_FOREIGNER_INVESTOR_TYPE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.EXECUTION_VOLUME                    ELSE 0 END)        AS kl_nn_mua,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
                  AND t.SELL_FOREIGNER_INVESTOR_TYPE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.EXECUTION_VOLUME                    ELSE 0 END)        AS kl_nn_ban,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
                  AND t.BUY_FOREIGNER_INVESTOR_TYPE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.EXECUTION_Value                  ELSE 0 END)        AS gt_nn_mua,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
                  AND t.SELL_FOREIGNER_INVESTOR_TYPE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.EXECUTION_Value                    ELSE 0 END)        AS gt_nn_ban
FROM uat_ordertrade_stg.trade_book_hose t
WHERE 1=1
--	and symbol = 'SHB' 
   AND date_format(to_date(t.TRADE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd') = :Ngay_gd
GROUP BY t.SYMBOL
union all 
SELECT
    t.ISSUE_CODE                                                            AS symbol,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
             THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY                                    ELSE 0 END) AS tong_kl,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
             THEN CAST(t.TRADE_PRICE AS NUMERIC) * t.TRADE_QUANTITY   ELSE 0 END) AS tong_gt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                  AND t.BOARD_ID IN ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')
             THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY                                    ELSE 0 END) AS tong_kl_tt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                  AND t.BOARD_ID IN ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')
             THEN CAST(t.TRADE_PRICE AS NUMERIC) * t.TRADE_QUANTITY   ELSE 0 END) AS tong_gt_tt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                  AND t.BUY_FOREIGN_INVESTOR_TYPE_CODE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY                                    ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_mua,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                  AND t.SELL_FOREIGN_INVESTOR_TYPE_CODE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY                                    ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_ban,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                  AND t.BUY_FOREIGN_INVESTOR_TYPE_CODE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY  * trade_price                               ELSE 0 END) AS gt_nn_mua,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                  AND t.SELL_FOREIGN_INVESTOR_TYPE_CODE IN ('10','20')
             THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY * trade_price                                 ELSE 0 END) AS gt_nn_ban
 from uat_ordertrade_stg.trade_book_hnx t
 where 1=1 
AND date_format(to_date(t.TRADE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd')  = :Ngay_gd 
group by  t.ISSUE_CODE
)
,Von_hoa AS (
    SELECT
        c.symbol                          AS symbol,                        
        c.gia_dong_cua,                                                     
        s.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh,
        c.gia_dong_cua * s.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh           AS von_hoa
    FROM MDDS c
    Left JOIN SCPLH s ON c.symbol = s.symbol
)
SELECT
    c.ten_san,
--    c.ten_nganh,
        ROUND(
        (
            SUM(c.gia_dong_cua * COALESCE(vh.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.ten_nganh)
            / NULLIF(SUM(c.gia_tham_chieu * COALESCE(vh.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.ten_nganh), 0)
            - 1
        ) * 100,
        2
    ) AS pct_thay_doi_nganh,
    c.symbol                              AS Ma_ck,                            
    :Ngay_gd                             AS ngay_gd,
    c.gia_dong_cua,
    c.pct_thay_doi,
    COALESCE(sl.tong_kl,   0)            AS tong_kl,
    COALESCE(sl.tong_gt,   0)            AS tong_gt,
    COALESCE(sl.kl_nn_mua, 0)            AS kl_nn_mua,
    COALESCE(sl.kl_nn_ban, 0)            AS kl_nn_ban,
    COALESCE(sl.gt_nn_mua, 0)            AS gt_nn_mua,
    COALESCE(sl.gt_nn_ban, 0)            AS gt_nn_ban,
        COALESCE(sl.kl_nn_mua, 0) - COALESCE(sl.kl_nn_ban, 0) AS kl_nn_rong,
        COALESCE(sl.gt_nn_mua, 0) - COALESCE(sl.gt_nn_ban, 0) AS gt_nn_rong,
    vh.von_hoa                                                               
FROM MDDS c
LEFT JOIN so_lenh sl ON sl.symbol = c.symbol                                  
LEFT JOIN Von_hoa  vh ON vh.symbol = c.symbol                             
where 1=1 
--and ten_san not in  ('HNX')
and c.symbol =  'LDG'
ORDER BY c.floor_code, c.symbol

-- KL mua NN toàn thị trường — xếp hạng Top mua
WITH kl_nn AS (
    -- HOSE
    SELECT
        t.Symbol                        AS symbol,
        t.[Trade Date]                  AS ngay_gd,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Buy - Foreigner Investor type] IN ('10','20')
                 THEN t.[Execution - Volume] ELSE 0 END)    AS kl_nn_mua,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Sell - Foreigner Investor type] IN ('10','20')
                 THEN t.[Execution - Volume] ELSE 0 END)    AS kl_nn_ban
    FROM TRADE_BOOK_HOSE t
    WHERE t.[Trade Date]  = :ngay_gd
      AND t.[Market ID]   = 'STO'

    UNION ALL

    -- HNX + UPCOM
    SELECT
        t.[Issue Code]                  AS symbol,
        t.[Trade date]                  AS ngay_gd,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Buy Foreign Investor Type Code] IN ('10','20')
                 THEN t.[Trade quantity] ELSE 0 END)        AS kl_nn_mua,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Sell Foreign Investor Type Code] IN ('10','20')
                 THEN t.[Trade quantity] ELSE 0 END)        AS kl_nn_ban
    FROM Trade_HNX t
    WHERE t.[Trade date]  = :ngay_gd
      AND t.[Market ID] IN ('STX','UPX')
)
SELECT
    symbol,
    ngay_gd,
    SUM(kl_nn_mua)      AS kl_nn_mua,
    SUM(kl_nn_ban)      AS kl_nn_ban,
    SUM(kl_nn_mua) - SUM(kl_nn_ban)    AS kl_nn_rong
FROM kl_nn
GROUP BY symbol, ngay_gd
ORDER BY kl_nn_mua DESC     -- Xếp hạng Top mua NN
LIMIT :top_n;"

MDDS AS (
    -- Thông tin giá + return_i (dạng phân số) + pct_bien_dong (dạng %)
    -- Lấy đúng bản ghi CUỐI CÙNG trong ngày (giá đóng cửa chính thức), tránh lấy nhầm snapshot giữa phiên
    SELECT
        symbol,
        gia_dong_cua,
        gia_tham_chieu,
        change,
        ROUND(change / NULLIF(gia_tham_chieu, 0), 6)        AS return_i,
        ROUND((change / NULLIF(gia_tham_chieu, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pct_bien_dong
    FROM (
        SELECT
            symbol,
            closePrice AS gia_dong_cua,
            reference  AS gia_tham_chieu,
            change,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY symbol, tradingdate
                ORDER BY TRADINGTIME DESC  
            ) AS rn
        FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR
        WHERE date_format(TO_DATE(tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'yyyyMMdd') = :ngay_gd
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1
),,
-- tên bảng/cột chưa xác nhận thật
SCPLH AS (
    SELECT 
        a.MCK AS symbol,
        a.`Ngày báo cáo` AS ngay_bao_cao,
        SUM(a.`Khối lượng chứng khoán đang lưu hành`) AS KLLH,
        SUM(a.`Khối lượng CP tự do chuyển nhượng`) AS KL_tu_do
    FROM `BM 1_Báo cáo về khối lượng chứng khoán đang lưu hành` a
    WHERE a.Loai_CK = 'Co phieu'
    GROUP BY a.MCK, a.`Ngày báo cáo`
),
Von_hoa_theo_chiso AS (
    -- MarketCap = Giá tham chiếu × KLLH, KLLH lấy tại ngày t
    SELECT
        si.INDEXCODE,
        v.symbol,
        v.gia_dong_cua,
        v.von_hoa_luu_hanh,
        v.von_hoa_tu_do,
        SUM(v.von_hoa_luu_hanh) OVER (PARTITION BY si.INDEXCODE) AS tong_von_hoa_luu_hanh,
        SUM(v.von_hoa_tu_do)    OVER (PARTITION BY si.INDEXCODE) AS tong_von_hoa_tu_do
    FROM (        
        SELECT
            m.symbol,
            m.gia_dong_cua,
            m.gia_tham_chieu,
            s.KLLH,
            m.gia_tham_chieu * s.KLLH AS von_hoa_luu_hanh,
            s.KL_tu_do,
            m.gia_tham_chieu * s.KL_tu_do AS von_hoa_tu_do
        FROM MDDS m
        JOIN SCPLH s 
            ON m.symbol = s.symbol 
           AND date_format(s.ngay_bao_cao, 'yyyyMMdd') = :ngay_gd
    ) v                                             
    JOIN JAD_CSIDXINFOR si ON v.symbol = si.Symbol    
),
Chi_so_t_1 AS (
    -- Index_t-1 = giá trị chỉ số ngày hôm qua
    SELECT
        MARKETCODE,
        tradingdate,
        LAG(MARKETINDEX) OVER (
            PARTITION BY MARKETCODE ORDER BY TO_DATE(tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
        ) AS index_t_1,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY tradingdate, MARKETCODE ORDER BY INDEXTIME DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM JAD_MARKETINFOR
    WHERE MARKETID = '10'
),
KHGTGD AS (
    -- Tổng KLGD + GTGD trong ngày
    SELECT symbol, SUM(kl) AS khoi_luong_gd, SUM(gt) AS gia_tri_gd
    FROM (
        SELECT t.Symbol AS symbol, t.Execution_Volume AS kl, t.Execution_Value AS gt
        FROM TRADE_BOOK_HOSE t
        WHERE t.Trade_date = :ngay_gd AND t.Market_ID IN ('STK','STO')
        UNION ALL
        SELECT t.`Issue Code` AS symbol, t.Trade_quantity AS kl,
               CAST(t.Trade_price AS DOUBLE) * t.Trade_quantity AS gt
        FROM TRADE_BOOK_HNX t
        WHERE t.Trade_date = :ngay_gd AND t.Market_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
    ) x
    GROUP BY symbol
)
SELECT
    vc.symbol                                                             AS Ma_CK,
    vc.INDEXCODE                                                          AS Chi_so,
    -- Điểm đóng góp TUYỆT ĐỐI (dùng return_i dạng PHÂN SỐ)
    ROUND(
        (vc.von_hoa_luu_hanh / NULLIF(vc.tong_von_hoa_luu_hanh, 0))
        * m.return_i
        * ci.index_t_1
    , 4)                                                                   AS Diem_dong_gop_luu_hanh,
    ROUND(
        (vc.von_hoa_tu_do / NULLIF(vc.tong_von_hoa_tu_do, 0))
        * m.return_i
        * ci.index_t_1
    , 4)                                                                   AS Diem_dong_gop_tu_do_chuyen_nhuong,
    -- Điểm đóng góp TƯƠNG ĐỐI (%) = w_i × Return_i × 100 (dùng return_i dạng PHÂN SỐ)
    ROUND((vc.von_hoa_luu_hanh / NULLIF(vc.tong_von_hoa_luu_hanh, 0)) * m.return_i * 100, 4) AS Phan_tram_dong_gop_luu_hanh,
    ROUND((vc.von_hoa_tu_do / NULLIF(vc.tong_von_hoa_tu_do, 0)) * m.return_i * 100, 4)        AS Phan_tram_dong_gop_tu_do,
    vc.gia_dong_cua                                                       AS Gia_dong_cua,
    m.change                                                              AS Thay_doi_gia,
    m.pct_bien_dong                                                       AS Phan_tram_thay_doi_gia,   
    k.khoi_luong_gd                                                        AS Tong_KLGD_trong_ngay,
    k.gia_tri_gd                                                           AS Tong_GTGD_trong_ngay
FROM Von_hoa_theo_chiso vc
JOIN MDDS m       ON vc.symbol = m.symbol
JOIN Chi_so_t_1 ci ON vc.INDEXCODE = ci.MARKETCODE 
   AND date_format(TO_DATE(ci.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'yyyyMMdd') = :ngay_gd
   AND ci.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN KHGTGD k ON vc.symbol = k.symbol
ORDER BY vc.INDEXCODE, Diem_dong_gop_luu_hanh DESC;

WITH Lich_giao_dich AS (
    -- Lịch giao dịch lấy TRỰC TIẾP từ JAD_STOCKINFOR, lọc đúng theo sàn đang chọn
    SELECT
        ngay,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ngay DESC) AS rn
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay
        FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR s
        WHERE TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
          AND (:san = 'ALL' 
               OR (:san = 'HOSE'  AND s.FloorCode = '10')
               OR (:san = 'HNX'   AND s.FloorCode = '02')
               OR (:san = 'UPCOM' AND s.FloorCode = '04'))
    )
),
Khoang_thoi_gian AS (
    -- Xác định ngày bắt đầu theo bộ lọc: 1 NGÀY / 5 NGÀY / 20 NGÀY / TỪ ĐẦU NĂM / TÙY CHỈNH
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN :loai_khoang = '1_NGAY'    THEN TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
            WHEN :loai_khoang = '5_NGAY'    THEN (SELECT MIN(ngay) FROM Lich_giao_dich WHERE rn <= 5)
            WHEN :loai_khoang = '20_NGAY'   THEN (SELECT MIN(ngay) FROM Lich_giao_dich WHERE rn <= 20)
            WHEN :loai_khoang = 'DAU_NAM'   THEN (
                SELECT MIN(ngay) FROM Lich_giao_dich
                WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ngay) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD'))
            )
            WHEN :loai_khoang = 'TUY_CHINH' THEN TO_DATE(:tu_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
        END AS ngay_bat_dau
    FROM DUAL
),
-- 1. Danh sách mã CK hợp lệ + giá đóng cửa + % thay đổi TẠI ĐÚNG :den_ngay
co_phieu AS (
    SELECT
        s.symbol                                                          AS ma_ck,
        s.closePrice                                                      AS gia_dong_cua,
		s.change														  AS Thay_doi,
        CASE WHEN s.reference IS NULL OR s.reference = 0 THEN NULL
             ELSE ROUND((s.change / s.reference) * 100, 2) END            AS pct_thay_doi,
        s.floorCode
    FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR s
    WHERE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') = :den_ngay
      AND s.FloorCode IN ('10','02','04','03')
      AND s.StockType NOT IN ('B','1','BO','D')
      AND (:san = 'ALL' 
           OR (:san = 'HOSE'  AND s.FloorCode = '10')
           OR (:san = 'HNX'   AND s.FloorCode = '02')
           OR (:san = 'UPCOM' AND s.FloorCode = '04'))
),
-- 2. Tự doanh mua/bán trên HOSE, CỘNG DỒN trong khoảng [ngay_bat_dau, den_ngay]
tudoanh_all AS (
    SELECT
        t.Symbol AS symbol,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.Buy - Client/House Classification Code = '30'
                 THEN t.Execution - Value ELSE 0 END)                   AS tudoanh_mua,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.Sell - Client/House Classification Code = '30'
                 THEN t.Execution - Value ELSE 0 END)                   AS tudoanh_ban,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.Buy - Client/House Classification Code = '30'
                 THEN t.Execution - Volume ELSE 0 END)                  AS tudoanh_mua_kl,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.Sell - Client/House Classification Code = '30'
                 THEN t.Execution - Volume ELSE 0 END)                  AS tudoanh_ban_kl
    FROM TRADE_BOOK_HOSE t
    WHERE TO_DATE(t."Trade Date", 'DD/MM/YYYY') BETWEEN 
              (SELECT ngay_bat_dau FROM Khoang_thoi_gian) 
          AND TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
      AND t."Market ID" = 'STO'
    GROUP BY t.Symbol
union all 
    SELECT
        t."Issue Code" AS symbol,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t."Buy client/house classification" = '30'
                 THEN t."Trade quantity" * t."Trade price" ELSE 0 END)    AS tudoanh_mua,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t."Sell client/house classification" = '30'
                 THEN t."Trade quantity" * t."Trade price" ELSE 0 END)    AS tudoanh_ban,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t."Buy client/house classification" = '30'
                 THEN t."Trade quantity" ELSE 0 END)                     AS tudoanh_mua_kl,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t."Sell client/house classification" = '30'
                 THEN t."Trade quantity" ELSE 0 END)                     AS tudoanh_ban_kl
    FROM TRADE_BOOK_HNX t
    WHERE TO_DATE(t."Trade date", 'DD/MM/YYYY') BETWEEN 
              (SELECT ngay_bat_dau FROM Khoang_thoi_gian) 
          AND TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
      AND t."Market ID" IN ('STX','UPX')
    GROUP BY t."Issue Code"
),
tudoanh_gan_nhom AS (
SELECT
        p.*,
        CASE WHEN p.gia_tri_rong_theo_chi_tieu >= 0 THEN 'MUA_RONG' ELSE 'BAN_RONG' END AS nhom
		from 
	(	
    SELECT
        c.ma_ck,
        c.gia_dong_cua,
        c.pct_thay_doi,
        COALESCE(t.tudoanh_mua, 0)                                    AS gt_tudoanh_mua,
        COALESCE(t.tudoanh_ban, 0)                                    AS gt_tudoanh_ban,
        COALESCE(t.tudoanh_mua_kl, 0)                                  AS kl_tudoanh_mua,
        COALESCE(t.tudoanh_ban_kl, 0)                                  AS kl_tudoanh_ban,
        COALESCE(t.tudoanh_mua, 0) - COALESCE(t.tudoanh_ban, 0)        AS gt_tudoanh_rong,
        COALESCE(t.tudoanh_mua_kl, 0) - COALESCE(t.tudoanh_ban_kl, 0)  AS kl_tudoanh_rong,
        CASE 
            WHEN :loai_tudoanh IN ('GT_MUA_RONG','GT_BAN_RONG') 
                THEN COALESCE(t.tudoanh_mua, 0) - COALESCE(t.tudoanh_ban, 0)
            ELSE COALESCE(t.tudoanh_mua_kl, 0) - COALESCE(t.tudoanh_ban_kl, 0)
        END AS gia_tri_rong_theo_chi_tieu
    FROM co_phieu c
    LEFT JOIN tudoanh_all t ON t.symbol = c.ma_ck
    WHERE COALESCE(t.tudoanh_mua,0) <> 0 OR COALESCE(t.tudoanh_ban,0) <> 0
	)
)
-- 6. Kết quả cuối: mỗi ô treemap
SELECT
    p.ma_ck,
    p.nhom,
    p.gia_dong_cua,
	p.Thay_doi
    p.pct_thay_doi,
    p.gt_tudoanh_mua,-- có cả ở filtter giá trị tự doanh / giá trị tự doanh ròng
    p.gt_tudoanh_ban,-- có cả ở filtter giá trị tự doanh / giá trị tự doanh ròng
    p.gt_tudoanh_rong,-- có  ở filtter giá trị tự doanh ròng
    p.kl_tudoanh_mua,---có cả ở filtter giá trị tự doanh
    p.kl_tudoanh_ban,---có cả ở filtter giá trị tự doanh
	CASE WHEN p.nhom = 'MUA_RONG' THEN p.gia_tri_rong_theo_chi_tieu ELSE 0 END) AS gt_tudoanh_mua_rong,
	CASE WHEN p.nhom = 'BAN_RONG' THEN p.gia_tri_rong_theo_chi_tieu ELSE 0 END) AS gt_tudoanh_ban_rong,
 --   ROUND(ABS(p.gia_tri_rong_theo_chi_tieu) * 100.0
 ---         / SUM(ABS(p.gia_tri_rong_theo_chi_tieu)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.nhom), 2) AS ty_trong_pct_trong_khoi,--- sẽ xem xét sau 
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.nhom = 'MUA_RONG' THEN p.gia_tri_rong_theo_chi_tieu ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS tong_mua_rong,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.nhom = 'BAN_RONG' THEN -p.gia_tri_rong_theo_chi_tieu ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS tong_ban_rong,
	SUM(p.gt_tudoanh_mua) OVER () AS tong_gt_mua,
    SUM(p.gt_tudoanh_ban) OVER () AS tong_gt_ban
FROM tudoanh_gan_nhom p
ORDER BY p.nhom

    FROM TRADE_BOOK_HOSE t
    JOIN Symbol_Index si ON si.Symbol = t.Symbol                          -- ✅ MỚI: giới hạn theo chỉ số
    LEFT JOIN DANH_MUC_NDT dm_mua ON dm_mua.TAI_KHOAN = t."Buy_Acct_No"
    LEFT JOIN DANH_MUC_NDT dm_ban ON dm_ban.TAI_KHOAN = t."Sell_Acct_No"
    WHERE 1=1
        and TO_DATE(t."Trade Date", 'DD/MM/YYYY') BETWEEN 
              (SELECT ngay_bat_dau FROM Khoang_thoi_gian) 
          AND TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
      AND t."Market ID" = 'STK'
      AND (
          :loai_gtgd = 'TONG_GTGD' 
          OR (:loai_gtgd = 'KHOP_LENH' AND t."Board ID" LIKE 'G%')
      )

    UNION ALL

    -- HNX / UPCOM — tương tự, giới hạn theo chỉ số
    SELECT
        TO_DATE(t."Trade date", 'DD/MM/YYYY')                              AS ngay_gd,
        CASE
            WHEN t."Buy client/house classification" = '30'                THEN 'TU_DOANH'
            WHEN dm_mua.ma_loai_y = '3'                                    THEN 'CA_NHAN'
            WHEN dm_mua.ma_loai_y = '5'                                    THEN 'TO_CHUC'
            WHEN dm_mua.ma_loai_y IN ('4','6')                             THEN 'NUOC_NGOAI'
        END                                                                AS loai_ndt_mua,
        CASE
            WHEN t."Sell client/house classification" = '30'               THEN 'TU_DOANH'
            WHEN dm_ban.ma_loai_y = '3'                                    THEN 'CA_NHAN'
            WHEN dm_ban.ma_loai_y = '5'                                    THEN 'TO_CHUC'
            WHEN dm_ban.ma_loai_y IN ('4','6')                             THEN 'NUOC_NGOAI'
        END                                                                AS loai_ndt_ban,
        CAST(t."Trade price" AS NUMBER) * CAST(t."Trade quantity" AS NUMBER) AS gt_gd
    FROM TRADE_BOOK_HNX t
    JOIN Symbol_Index si ON si.Symbol = t."Issue Code"                  
    LEFT JOIN DANH_MUC_NDT dm_mua ON dm_mua.TAI_KHOAN = t."BUY_ACCOUNT_NUMBER"
    LEFT JOIN DANH_MUC_NDT dm_ban ON dm_ban.TAI_KHOAN = t."SELL_ACCOUNT_NUMBER"
    WHERE TO_DATE(t."Trade date", 'DD/MM/YYYY') BETWEEN 
              (SELECT ngay_bat_dau FROM Khoang_thoi_gian) 
          AND TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
      AND t."Market ID" IN ('STX','UPX')
      AND (
          :loai_gtgd = 'TONG_GTGD' 
          OR (:loai_gtgd = 'KHOP_LENH' AND t."Board ID" LIKE 'G%')
      )
),
gt_mua_theo_ngay AS (
    SELECT ngay_gd, loai_ndt_mua AS loai_ndt, SUM(gt_gd) AS gt_mua
    FROM giao_dich_phan_loai
    WHERE loai_ndt_mua IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ngay_gd, loai_ndt_mua
),
gt_ban_theo_ngay AS (
    SELECT ngay_gd, loai_ndt_ban AS loai_ndt, SUM(gt_gd) AS gt_ban
    FROM giao_dich_phan_loai
    WHERE loai_ndt_ban IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ngay_gd, loai_ndt_ban
),
gt_rong_theo_ngay AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(m.ngay_gd, b.ngay_gd)   AS ngay_gd,
        COALESCE(m.loai_ndt, b.loai_ndt) AS loai_ndt,
        COALESCE(m.gt_mua, 0)              AS gt_mua,
        COALESCE(b.gt_ban, 0)              AS gt_ban,
        COALESCE(m.gt_mua, 0) - COALESCE(b.gt_ban, 0) AS gt_rong
    FROM gt_mua_theo_ngay m
    FULL OUTER JOIN gt_ban_theo_ngay b
        ON m.ngay_gd = b.ngay_gd AND m.loai_ndt = b.loai_ndt
),
chi_so_gia AS (
    SELECT ngay_gd, gia_dong_cua
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            TO_DATE(jm.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay_gd,
            jm.MARKETINDEX                         AS gia_dong_cua,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY TO_DATE(jm.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
                ORDER BY jm.INDEXTIME DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM JAD_MARKETINFOR jm
        WHERE jm.MARKETID = '10'
          AND jm.MARKETCODE = :chi_so                                   
          AND TO_DATE(jm.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') BETWEEN 
                  (SELECT ngay_bat_dau FROM Khoang_thoi_gian) 
              AND TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    v.ngay_gd,
    v.gia_dong_cua,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN g.loai_ndt = 'CA_NHAN' THEN g.gt_rong END), 0) AS gt_ca_nhan_rong,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN g.loai_ndt = 'TO_CHUC' THEN g.gt_rong END), 0) AS gt_to_chuc_trong_nuoc_rong,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN g.loai_ndt = 'TU_DOANH' THEN g.gt_rong END), 0) AS gt_tu_doanh_rong,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN g.loai_ndt = 'NUOC_NGOAI' THEN g.gt_rong END), 0) AS gt_nuoc_ngoai_rong,
FROM chi_so_gia v
LEFT JOIN gt_rong_theo_ngay g ON g.ngay_gd = v.ngay_gd
GROUP BY v.ngay_gd, v.gia_dong_cua
ORDER BY v.ngay_gd;

                 ELSE 0 END) AS gt_mua,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.Sell_client_house_classification = '30'
                 THEN CAST(t.Trade_price    AS DOUBLE)
                    * CAST(t.Trade_quantity AS DOUBLE)
                 ELSE 0 END) AS gt_ban
    FROM TRADE_BOOK_HNX t
    WHERE t.Trade_date = :ngay_gd
      AND t.Market_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
    GROUP BY t.Issue_Code, t.Trade_date
)
SELECT
    ma_ck,
    ngay_gd,
    SUM(gt_mua)               AS gt_tudoanh_mua,
    SUM(gt_ban)               AS gt_tudoanh_ban,
    SUM(gt_mua) - SUM(gt_ban) AS gt_tudoanh_rong
FROM tu_doanh
GROUP BY ma_ck, ngay_gd
ORDER BY ABS(SUM(gt_mua) - SUM(gt_ban)) DESC;

             THEN  t.[Trade quantity] * Trade price ELSE 0 END)   AS kl_nn_rong

             THEN  t.[Execution - Value] ELSE 0 END)
