column21:
WITH Lich_giao_dich AS (
    SELECT
        ngay,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ngay DESC) AS rn
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay
        FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR s
        WHERE TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
    )
),
Khoang_thoi_gian AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN :loai_khoang = '5_NGAY'   THEN (SELECT MIN(ngay) FROM Lich_giao_dich WHERE rn <= 5)
            WHEN :loai_khoang = '20_NGAY'  THEN (SELECT MIN(ngay) FROM Lich_giao_dich WHERE rn <= 20)
            WHEN :loai_khoang = 'DAU_NAM'  THEN (
                SELECT MIN(ngay) FROM Lich_giao_dich
                WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ngay) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD'))
            )
        END AS ngay_bat_dau
    FROM DUAL
),
Symbol_Index AS (
    SELECT Symbol, INDEXCODE
    FROM JAD_CSIDXINFOR
    WHERE INDEXCODE = :chi_so
),
DANH_MUC_NDT AS (
    SELECT TAI_KHOAN, LOAI_NDT AS ma_loai_y
    FROM BM_DANH_MUC_NDT
),
--giữ lại t.Symbol / t."Issue Code" trong SELECT (trước đây bị bỏ qua)
giao_dich_phan_loai AS (
    -- HOSE
    SELECT
        TO_DATE(t."Trade Date", 'DD/MM/YYYY')                              AS ngay_gd,
        t.Symbol                                                           AS symbol,   -- ✅ MỚI
        CASE
            WHEN t."Buy - Client/House Classification Code" = '30'         THEN 'TU_DOANH'
            WHEN dm_mua.ma_loai_y = '3'                                    THEN 'CA_NHAN'
            WHEN dm_mua.ma_loai_y = '5'                                    THEN 'TO_CHUC'
            WHEN dm_mua.ma_loai_y IN ('4','6')                             THEN 'NUOC_NGOAI'
        END                                                                AS loai_ndt_mua,
        CASE
            WHEN t."Sell - Client/House Classification Code" = '30'        THEN 'TU_DOANH'
            WHEN dm_ban.ma_loai_y = '3'                                    THEN 'CA_NHAN'
            WHEN dm_ban.ma_loai_y = '5'                                    THEN 'TO_CHUC'
            WHEN dm_ban.ma_loai_y IN ('4','6')                             THEN 'NUOC_NGOAI'
        END                                                                AS loai_ndt_ban,
        t."Execution - Value"                                              AS gt_gd
    FROM TRADE_BOOK_HOSE t
    JOIN Symbol_Index si ON si.Symbol = t.Symbol
    LEFT JOIN DANH_MUC_NDT dm_mua ON dm_mua.TAI_KHOAN = t."Buy_Acct_No"
    LEFT JOIN DANH_MUC_NDT dm_ban ON dm_ban.TAI_KHOAN = t."Sell_Acct_No"
    WHERE TO_DATE(t."Trade Date", 'DD/MM/YYYY') BETWEEN 
              (SELECT ngay_bat_dau FROM Khoang_thoi_gian) 
          AND TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
      AND t."Market ID" = 'STK'
      AND (
          :loai_gtgd = 'TONG_GTGD' 
          OR (:loai_gtgd = 'KHOP_LENH' AND t."Board ID" LIKE 'G%')
      )

    UNION ALL

    -- HNX / UPCOM
    SELECT
        TO_DATE(t."Trade date", 'DD/MM/YYYY')                              AS ngay_gd,
        t."Issue Code"                                                     AS symbol,   -- ✅ MỚI
        CASE
            WHEN t."Buy client/house classification" = '30'                THEN 'TU_DOANH'
            WHEN dm_mua.ma_loai_y = '3'                                    THEN 'CA_NHAN'
            WHEN dm_mua.ma_loai_y = '5'                                    THEN 'TO_CHUC'
            WHEN dm_mua.ma_loai_y IN ('4','6')                             THEN 'NUOC_NGOAI'
        END                                                                AS loai_ndt_mua,
        CASE
            WHEN t."Sell client/house classification" = '30'               THEN 'TU_DOANH'
            WHEN dm_ban.ma_loai_y = '3'                                    THEN 'CA_NHAN'
            WHEN dm_ban.ma_loai_y = '5'                                    THEN 'TO_CHUC'
            WHEN dm_ban.ma_loai_y IN ('4','6')                             THEN 'NUOC_NGOAI'
        END                                                                AS loai_ndt_ban,
        CAST(t."Trade price" AS NUMBER) * CAST(t."Trade quantity" AS NUMBER) AS gt_gd
    FROM TRADE_BOOK_HNX t
    JOIN Symbol_Index si ON si.Symbol = t."Issue Code"
    LEFT JOIN DANH_MUC_NDT dm_mua ON dm_mua.TAI_KHOAN = t."BUY_ACCOUNT_NUMBER"
    LEFT JOIN DANH_MUC_NDT dm_ban ON dm_ban.TAI_KHOAN = t."SELL_ACCOUNT_NUMBER"
    WHERE TO_DATE(t."Trade date", 'DD/MM/YYYY') BETWEEN 
              (SELECT ngay_bat_dau FROM Khoang_thoi_gian) 
          AND TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
      AND t."Market ID" IN ('STX','UPX')
      AND (
          :loai_gtgd = 'TONG_GTGD' 
          OR (:loai_gtgd = 'KHOP_LENH' AND t."Board ID" LIKE 'G%')
      )
),
-- GROUP BY thêm symbol
gt_mua_theo_ngay AS (
    SELECT ngay_gd, symbol, loai_ndt_mua AS loai_ndt, SUM(gt_gd) AS gt_mua
    FROM giao_dich_phan_loai
    WHERE loai_ndt_mua IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ngay_gd, symbol, loai_ndt_mua
),
gt_ban_theo_ngay AS (
    SELECT ngay_gd, symbol, loai_ndt_ban AS loai_ndt, SUM(gt_gd) AS gt_ban
    FROM giao_dich_phan_loai
    WHERE loai_ndt_ban IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ngay_gd, symbol, loai_ndt_ban
),
-- FULL OUTER JOIN thêm điều kiện symbol
gt_rong_theo_ngay AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(m.ngay_gd, b.ngay_gd)   AS ngay_gd,
        COALESCE(m.symbol, b.symbol)     AS symbol,      
        COALESCE(m.loai_ndt, b.loai_ndt) AS loai_ndt,
        COALESCE(m.gt_mua, 0)              AS gt_mua,
        COALESCE(b.gt_ban, 0)              AS gt_ban,
        COALESCE(m.gt_mua, 0) - COALESCE(b.gt_ban, 0) AS gt_rong
    FROM gt_mua_theo_ngay m
    FULL OUTER JOIN gt_ban_theo_ngay b
        ON m.ngay_gd = b.ngay_gd 
       AND m.symbol = b.symbol                          
       AND m.loai_ndt = b.loai_ndt
),
chi_so_gia AS (
    SELECT ngay_gd, gia_dong_cua
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            TO_DATE(jm.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay_gd,
            jm.MARKETINDEX                         AS gia_dong_cua,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY TO_DATE(jm.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
                ORDER BY jm.INDEXTIME DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM JAD_MARKETINFOR jm
        WHERE jm.MARKETID = '10'
          AND jm.MARKETCODE = :chi_so
          AND TO_DATE(jm.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') BETWEEN 
                  (SELECT ngay_bat_dau FROM Khoang_thoi_gian) 
              AND TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)
-- Kết quả cuối: mỗi dòng = 1 ngày + 1 mã CK (thay vì chỉ 1 ngày như trước)
SELECT
    v.ngay_gd,
    g.symbol,
    v.gia_dong_cua,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN g.loai_ndt = 'CA_NHAN' THEN g.gt_mua END), 0)  AS gt_ca_nhan_mua,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN g.loai_ndt = 'CA_NHAN' THEN g.gt_ban END), 0)  AS gt_ca_nhan_ban,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN g.loai_ndt = 'CA_NHAN' THEN g.gt_rong END), 0) AS gt_ca_nhan_rong,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN g.loai_ndt = 'TO_CHUC' THEN g.gt_mua END), 0)  AS gt_to_chuc_mua,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN g.loai_ndt = 'TO_CHUC' THEN g.gt_ban END), 0)  AS gt_to_chuc_ban,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN g.loai_ndt = 'TO_CHUC' THEN g.gt_rong END), 0) AS gt_to_chuc_trong_nuoc_rong,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN g.loai_ndt = 'TU_DOANH' THEN g.gt_mua END), 0)  AS gt_tu_doanh_mua,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN g.loai_ndt = 'TU_DOANH' THEN g.gt_ban END), 0)  AS gt_tu_doanh_ban,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN g.loai_ndt = 'TU_DOANH' THEN g.gt_rong END), 0) AS gt_tu_doanh_rong,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN g.loai_ndt = 'NUOC_NGOAI' THEN g.gt_mua END), 0)  AS gt_nuoc_ngoai_mua,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN g.loai_ndt = 'NUOC_NGOAI' THEN g.gt_ban END), 0)  AS gt_nuoc_ngoai_ban,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN g.loai_ndt = 'NUOC_NGOAI' THEN g.gt_rong END), 0) AS gt_nuoc_ngoai_rong
FROM chi_so_gia v
JOIN gt_rong_theo_ngay g ON g.ngay_gd = v.ngay_gd   -- JOIN thường (không LEFT) vì cần có ít nhất 1 mã giao dịch
GROUP BY v.ngay_gd, g.symbol, v.gia_dong_cua
ORDER BY v.ngay_gd, g.symbol;

WITH
Tham_so AS (
    SELECT

    FROM DUAL
),
Khoi_luong_giao_dich AS (
select 
        symbol,
        ngay_gd,
        SUM(kl) AS khoi_luong
from 
(
    SELECT
        t.symbol,
        TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay_gd,
        t.execution_volume AS kl
    FROM krx.trade_book_hose t
    CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
    WHERE TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
          BETWEEN ts.tu_ngay AND ts.den_ngay
      AND t.market_id = 'STK'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        t."Issue Code" AS symbol,
        TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay_gd,
        t.trade_quantity AS kl
    FROM krx.trade_book_hnx t
    CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
    WHERE TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
          BETWEEN ts.tu_ngay AND ts.den_ngay
      AND t.market_id IN ('STX', 'UPX')
          )
              GROUP BY
        symbol,
        ngay_gd
),
/*
  Snapshot EOD của mỗi mã/ngày.
  Tránh tạo nhiều nến khi JAD_STOCKINFOR có dữ liệu intraday.
*/
MDDS AS (
    SELECT
        san,
        ma_chung_khoan,
        stock_type,
        ngay_gd,
        gia_mo_cua,
        gia_cao_nhat,
        gia_thap_nhat,
        gia_dong_cua,
        gia_tham_chieu
    FROM (
        SELECT
            s.floorcode AS san,
            s.symbol AS ma_chung_khoan,
            s.stocktype AS stock_type,
            TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay_gd,
            s.open AS gia_mo_cua,
            s.high AS gia_cao_nhat,
            s.low AS gia_thap_nhat,
            s.closeprice AS gia_dong_cua,
            s.reference AS gia_tham_chieu,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY s.symbol, s.tradingdate
                ORDER BY s.indextime DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR s
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
              BETWEEN ts.tu_ngay AND ts.den_ngay
          AND s.floorcode IN ('10', '02', '04', '03')
          AND s.stocktype <> '1'
                  AND s.symbol = :ma_chung_khoan
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* Kỳ BCTC gần nhất đã kết thúc tại từng ngày trên biểu đồ */
Ky_bao_cao AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        m.ngay_gd,
        CASE
            WHEN CEIL(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.ngay_gd, 'MM')) / 3) = 1
                THEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.ngay_gd, 'YYYY')) - 1
            ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.ngay_gd, 'YYYY'))
        END AS report_year,
        CASE
            WHEN CEIL(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.ngay_gd, 'MM')) / 3) = 1
                THEN 4
            ELSE CEIL(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(m.ngay_gd, 'MM')) / 3) - 1
        END AS report_quarter
    FROM MDDS m
),

/*
  Một company_data hợp lệ cho mỗi mã/năm/quý:
  HN > TH > ME > RI; cùng loại lấy bản nộp gần nhất.
*/
Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd,
        statement_cd,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
            SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) AS statement_cd,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    cd.company_profile_id,
                    cd.report_year,
                    cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY
                    CASE
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
                    END,
                    cd.submission_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM gms_ids_uat.company_data cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms f
            ON f.id = cd.form_id
           AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND f.form_cd LIKE '%QUAR'
          AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')
          AND cd.submission_date <= ts.den_ngay
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM gms_ids_uat.violation_report vr
              JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf
                  ON vf.id = vr.form_id
                 AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
              WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year
                AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                AND vr.base_date <= ts.den_ngay
                AND vr.language_cd = 'VI'
          )
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* LNST theo từng kỳ BCTC */
LNST AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,

    FROM (

            f.form_cd,

          AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')

              JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf
                  ON vf.id = vr.form_id
                 AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
              WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year
                AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter

    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        doanh_thu,
        submission_date

        SELECT
            cdc.company_profile_id,
            cp.equity_ticker,
            cdc.report_year,
            cdc.report_quarter,
            d.data_value AS doanh_thu,
            cdc.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    d.company_profile_id,
                    d.report_year,
                    d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY
                    d.updated_date DESC NULLS LAST,
                    d.created_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp
            ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d
            ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
           AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
           AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc
            ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
           AND rc.financial_statement_cd = cdc.statement_cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr
            ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
           AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rcol
            ON rcol.col_cd = d.col_cd
           AND rcol.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        WHERE rcol.col_desc = '1'
          AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
          AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
          AND (
              (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) IN ('DN', 'BH')

              OR (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD'
                  AND rr.row_desc = '03')
          )
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)

WITH
-- 1. KLLH MỚI NHẤT tính đến ngày :ngay_gd
KLLH_hien_tai AS (
    SELECT symbol, kllh
FROM (
    SELECT
        a.ma_ck AS symbol,
        SUM(a.khoi_luong_ck_dang_luu_hanh) AS kllh,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.ma_ck ORDER BY a.ds_snpst_dt DESC) AS rn
    FROM uat_vsdc_stg.outstanding_shares a
    WHERE a.ds_snpst_dt <= to_date(:ngay_gd, 'yyyyMMdd')
    GROUP BY a.ma_ck, a.ds_snpst_dt
) t
WHERE t.rn = 1
),
-- 2. Giá đóng cửa ngày chốt :ngay_gd
Gia_ngay_chot AS (
    SELECT symbol, firstTradingDate, closePrice, TotalListingQtty
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            symbol, firstTradingDate, closePrice, TotalListingQtty,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY tradingtime DESC) AS rn
        FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR
        WHERE TO_DATE(tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = TO_DATE(:ngay_gd, 'YYYYMMDD')
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
-- 3. Giá cao/thấp 4 tuần (28 ngày)
Gia_4_tuan AS (
    SELECT symbol, gia_cao_4tuan, gia_thap_4tuan
    FROM (
        SELECT
            symbol, TO_DATE(tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') ngay,
            MAX(closePrice) OVER (
                PARTITION BY symbol 
                ORDER BY TO_DATE(tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
                RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '28' DAY PRECEDING AND INTERVAL '1' DAY PRECEDING
            ) AS gia_cao_4tuan,
            MIN(closePrice) OVER (
                PARTITION BY symbol 
                ORDER BY TO_DATE(tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
                RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '28' DAY PRECEDING AND INTERVAL '1' DAY PRECEDING
            ) AS gia_thap_4tuan,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY tradingtime DESC) AS rn
        FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR
    ) x
    WHERE TO_DATE(ngay, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = TO_DATE(:ngay_gd, 'YYYYMMDD')
      AND rn = 1
),

-- 4. Chuẩn hóa BCTC Doanh nghiệp theo Point-in-time
Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT company_profile_id, report_year, report_quarter, statement_cd, submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter,
            SUBSTR(f.form_cd,1,2) AS statement_cd, cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY CASE WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1 WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
                              WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3 WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 3 END,
                         cd.submission_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM gms_ids_uat.company_data cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND f.form_cd LIKE '%QUAR'
          AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd,1,2) IN ('HN','TH','ME','RI')
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM gms_ids_uat.violation_report vr
              JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf ON vf.id = vr.form_id AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
              WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                AND vr.base_date <= TO_DATE(:ngay_gd,'YYYYMMDD') AND vr.language_cd = 'VI'
          )
          
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),

LNST_all_ky AS (
        SELECT x.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id ORDER BY x.report_year DESC, x.report_quarter DESC ) AS rn     
        FROM (
            SELECT
                cdc.company_profile_id,
                cp.equity_ticker,
                cdc.report_year,
                cdc.report_quarter,
                d.data_value AS lnst
                ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY d.company_profile_id, d.report_year, d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY d.UPDATED_DATE DESC NULLS LAST, d.CREATED_DATE DESC
            ) AS rn1
            FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
               AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
               AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
               AND cdc.STATEMENT_CD = FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD
                        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
            WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
              AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
              AND (
                     ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'DN' AND rr.row_desc = '60' )
                  OR ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'BH' AND rr.row_desc = '60' )
                  OR ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD' AND rr.row_desc = '21' )
              )
              /* kỳ phải thực sự có giá trị LNST */
              AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
--              AND cp.equity_ticker = 'HVN'
        ) x
        WHERE x.rn1 = 1
    ),
LNST_quy_gan_nhat AS (
    SELECT equity_ticker, report_year, report_quarter, lnst FROM LNST_all_ky WHERE rn = 1
),
LNST_ttm_quy_dau AS (
    SELECT equity_ticker, report_year, report_quarter FROM LNST_all_ky WHERE rn <= 4
),
LNST_TTM AS (
    SELECT equity_ticker, SUM(lnst) AS lnst_ttm_tho
    FROM LNST_all_ky WHERE rn <= 4
    GROUP BY equity_ticker HAVING COUNT(*) = 4
),

VCSH_all_ky AS (
    SELECT x.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id ORDER BY x.report_year DESC, x.report_quarter DESC ) AS rn     
        FROM (
            SELECT
        cp.equity_ticker, cdc.report_year, cdc.report_quarter, d.data_value AS vcsh,cdc.company_profile_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY d.company_profile_id, d.report_year, d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY d.UPDATED_DATE DESC NULLS LAST, d.CREATED_DATE DESC
            ) AS rn1
    FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
    JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
    JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
                             AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
    JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id AND cdc.statement_cd = rc.financial_statement_cd
    JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr  ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
    JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
    WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1' AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
      AND ((UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) IN ('DN','BH') AND rr.row_desc = '400')
       OR  (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD' AND rr.row_desc = '500'))
      AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
        ) x
        WHERE x.rn1 = 1
),
VCSH_quy_gan_nhat AS (
    SELECT equity_ticker, report_year, report_quarter, vcsh FROM VCSH_all_ky WHERE rn = 1
),
VCSH_binh_quan_4quy AS (
    SELECT equity_ticker, AVG(vcsh) AS vcsh_binh_quan_4quy
    FROM VCSH_all_ky WHERE rn <= 4
    GROUP BY equity_ticker HAVING COUNT(*) = 4
),

Ky_to_ngay AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT report_year, report_quarter,
        CASE report_quarter
            WHEN 1 THEN TO_DATE(report_year || '-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
            WHEN 2 THEN TO_DATE(report_year || '-04-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
            WHEN 3 THEN TO_DATE(report_year || '-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
            WHEN 4 THEN TO_DATE(report_year || '-10-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
        END AS ngay_dau_quy,
        CASE report_quarter
            WHEN 1 THEN TO_DATE(report_year || '-03-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
            WHEN 2 THEN TO_DATE(report_year || '-06-30', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
            WHEN 3 THEN TO_DATE(report_year || '-09-30', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
            WHEN 4 THEN TO_DATE(report_year || '-12-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
        END AS ngay_cuoi_quy
    FROM (
        SELECT report_year, report_quarter FROM LNST_all_ky
        UNION
        SELECT report_year, report_quarter FROM VCSH_all_ky
    )
),
Khung_ngay_all AS (
    -- 8.1. LNST Quý gần nhất (rn = 1)
    SELECT l.equity_ticker AS symbol, 'QUY_LNST' AS loai_khung, k.ngay_dau_quy AS ngay_dau, k.ngay_cuoi_quy AS ngay_cuoi
    FROM LNST_all_ky l JOIN Ky_to_ngay k ON k.report_year = l.report_year AND k.report_quarter = l.report_quarter
    WHERE l.rn = 1
    
    UNION ALL
    -- 8.2. LNST 4 Quý TTM (rn <= 4: Cắt từ MIN ngày đầu đến MAX ngày cuối)
    SELECT l.equity_ticker, 'TTM_LNST', MIN(k.ngay_dau_quy), MAX(k.ngay_cuoi_quy)
    FROM LNST_all_ky l JOIN Ky_to_ngay k ON k.report_year = l.report_year AND k.report_quarter = l.report_quarter
    WHERE l.rn <= 4
    GROUP BY l.equity_ticker HAVING COUNT(*) = 4

    UNION ALL
    -- 8.3. VCSH Quý gần nhất (rn = 1)
    SELECT v.equity_ticker, 'QUY_VCSH', k.ngay_dau_quy, k.ngay_cuoi_quy
    FROM VCSH_all_ky v JOIN Ky_to_ngay k ON k.report_year = v.report_year AND k.report_quarter = v.report_quarter
    WHERE v.rn = 1

    UNION ALL
    -- 8.4. VCSH 4 Quý TTM (rn <= 4: Cắt từ MIN ngày đầu đến MAX ngày cuối)
    SELECT v.equity_ticker, 'TTM_VCSH', MIN(k.ngay_dau_quy), MAX(k.ngay_cuoi_quy)
    FROM VCSH_all_ky v JOIN Ky_to_ngay k ON k.report_year = v.report_year AND k.report_quarter = v.report_quarter
    WHERE v.rn <= 4
    GROUP BY v.equity_ticker HAVING COUNT(*) = 4
),
-- Bảng WAOS Base
WAOS_base AS (
        SELECT 
        symbol, 
        ngay_bao_cao AS tradingdate, 
        KLLH AS outstanding_shares,
        LEAD(ngay_bao_cao) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY ngay_bao_cao) AS next_tradingdate
    FROM (
        SELECT a.ma_ck AS symbol, a.ds_snpst_dt AS ngay_bao_cao,
               SUM(a.khoi_luong_ck_dang_luu_hanh) AS KLLH
        FROM uat_vsdc_stg.outstanding_shares a 
        GROUP BY a.ma_ck, a.ds_snpst_dt
    )
    WHERE ngay_bao_cao <= to_date(:ngay_gd, 'yyyyMMdd')
),
-- KLLH Bình Quân Quý Gần Nhất
KLLH_binh_quan_all AS (
    SELECT 
        symbol,
        MAX(CASE WHEN loai_khung = 'QUY_LNST' THEN waos END) AS kllh_bq_quy_lnst,
        MAX(CASE WHEN loai_khung = 'TTM_LNST' THEN waos END) AS kllh_bq_ttm_lnst,
        MAX(CASE WHEN loai_khung = 'QUY_VCSH' THEN waos END) AS kllh_bq_quy_vcsh,
        MAX(CASE WHEN loai_khung = 'TTM_VCSH' THEN waos END) AS kllh_bq_ttm_vcsh
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            w.symbol, k.loai_khung,
            SUM(
                w.outstanding_shares *
                DATEDIFF(
                    LEAST(NVL(w.next_tradingdate, DATE_ADD(k.ngay_cuoi, 1)), DATE_ADD(k.ngay_cuoi, 1)),
                    GREATEST(w.tradingdate, k.ngay_dau)
                )
            )
            / NULLIF(SUM(
                DATEDIFF(
                    LEAST(NVL(w.next_tradingdate, DATE_ADD(k.ngay_cuoi, 1)), DATE_ADD(k.ngay_cuoi, 1)),
                    GREATEST(w.tradingdate, k.ngay_dau)
                )
            ), 0) AS waos
        FROM WAOS_base w
        JOIN Khung_ngay_all k ON w.symbol = k.symbol
        WHERE w.tradingdate <= k.ngay_cuoi
          AND NVL(w.next_tradingdate, DATE_ADD(k.ngay_cuoi, 1)) > k.ngay_dau
        GROUP BY w.symbol, k.loai_khung
    ) sub
    GROUP BY symbol
)

    gh.closePrice                                                           AS Gia_dong_cua,
    gh.closePrice * kl.KLLH                                                 AS Gia_tri_von_hoa,
    g4.gia_cao_4tuan                                                        AS Gia_cao_nhat_4_tuan,
    g4.gia_thap_4tuan                                                       AS Gia_thap_nhat_4_tuan,

    -- EPS (Dùng KLLH bình quân LNST)
    ROUND(l1.lnst / NULLIF(bq.kllh_bq_quy_lnst, 0), 4)                      AS EPS_quy_gan_nhat,
    ROUND(lt.lnst_ttm_tho / NULLIF(bq.kllh_bq_ttm_lnst, 0), 4)              AS EPS_binh_quan_4_quy,

    ROUND(gh.closePrice / NULLIF(v1.vcsh / NULLIF(bq.kllh_bq_quy_vcsh, 0), 0), 2)         AS PB

WITH
/* BƯỚC 1:
   Xác định đúng 1 company_data cho mỗi NNT + kỳ:
   - Kỳ phải tồn tại trong violation_report với base_date <= :den_ngay
   - company_data phải APPROVED
   - Chỉ lấy HN/TH/ME/RI
   - Ưu tiên loại báo cáo: HN -> TH -> ME -> RI
   - Trong cùng loại báo cáo: lấy submission_date mới nhất
*/
Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd,
        submission_date
        ,SUBSTR(form_cd,1,2) STATEMENT_CD
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY CASE 	WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
							END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM gms_ids_uat.company_data cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND f.form_cd LIKE '%QUAR'
          AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM gms_ids_uat.violation_report vr
			  JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf ON vf.id = vr.form_id AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
              WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year
                AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                AND vr.base_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')

          )
		  		AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')
				AND cd.submission_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
				AND vr.LANGUAGE_CD = 'VI'
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
--SELECT * FROM Company_data_chuan 
--WHERE 1=1 
--AND company_profile_id = '1591';
/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 2:
   - Từ các kỳ hợp lệ ở trên, lấy LNST trong DATA
   - DATA join bằng: company_profile_id + report_year + report_quarter
   - Chỉ các kỳ thực sự có LNST mới tồn tại ở đây
   - Xếp thứ tự và lấy 4 kỳ LNST gần nhất
   ========================================================= */
LNST_4_ky AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        lnst
    FROM (
        SELECT x.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id ORDER BY x.report_year DESC, x.report_quarter DESC ) AS rn     
        FROM (
            SELECT
                cdc.company_profile_id,
                cp.equity_ticker,
                cdc.report_year,
                cdc.report_quarter,
                d.data_value AS lnst
                ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY d.company_profile_id, d.report_year, d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY d.UPDATED_DATE DESC NULLS LAST, d.CREATED_DATE DESC
            ) AS rn1
            FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
               AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
               AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
               AND cdc.STATEMENT_CD = FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD
			JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
            WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
              AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
              AND (
                     ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'DN' AND rr.row_desc = '60' )
                  OR ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'BH' AND rr.row_desc = '60' )
                  OR ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD' AND rr.row_desc = '21' )
              )
              /* kỳ phải thực sự có giá trị LNST */
              AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
--              AND cp.equity_ticker = 'HVN'
        ) x
        WHERE x.rn1 = 1
    )
    WHERE rn <= 4
)
/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 3:
   Chỉ tính TTM khi đủ 4 kỳ có LNST
   ========================================================= */
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 4 THEN SUM(lnst) END AS lnst_ttm
    FROM LNST_4_ky
    WHERE 1=1
    AND equity_ticker = 'HVN'
    GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker

/* BƯỚC 1:
           Xác định đúng 1 company_data cho mỗi NNT + kỳ:
           - Kỳ phải tồn tại trong violation_report với base_date <= :den_ngay
           - company_data phải APPROVED
           - Chỉ lấy HN/TH/ME/RI
           - Ưu tiên loại báo cáo: HN -> TH -> ME -> RI
           - Trong cùng loại báo cáo: lấy submission_date mới nhất
        */
        Company_data_chuan AS (
                SELECT
                        company_profile_id,
                        report_year,
                        report_quarter,
                        company_data_id,
                        form_cd,
                        submission_date
                        ,SUBSTR(form_cd,1,2) STATEMENT_CD
                FROM (
                        SELECT
                                cd.company_profile_id,
                                cd.report_year,
                                cd.report_quarter,
                                cd.id AS company_data_id,
                                f.form_cd,
                                cd.submission_date,
                                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                                        ORDER BY CASE         WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
                                                                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
                                                                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
                                                                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
                                                                END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
                        FROM gms_ids_uat.company_data cd
                        JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
                        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
                          AND f.form_cd LIKE '%QUAR'
                          AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM gms_ids_uat.violation_report vr
                                  JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf ON vf.id = vr.form_id AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
                                  WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                                        AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year
                                        AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                                        AND vr.base_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
                          )
                                  AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')
                                AND cd.submission_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
                )
                WHERE rn = 1
        ),
        --SELECT * FROM Company_data_chuan 
        --WHERE 1=1 
        --AND company_profile_id = '1591';
        /* =========================================================
           BƯỚC 2:
           - Từ các kỳ hợp lệ ở trên, lấy VCSH trong DATA
           - DATA join bằng: company_profile_id + report_year + report_quarter
           - Chỉ các kỳ thực sự có VCSH mới tồn tại ở đây
           - lấy 1 kỳ VCSH gần nhất
           ========================================================= */
        VCSH_quy AS (
                SELECT
                        equity_ticker,
                        report_year,
                        report_quarter,
                        vcsh,
                        company_profile_id
                FROM (
                        SELECT x.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id ORDER BY x.report_year DESC, x.report_quarter DESC ) AS rn1   
                        FROM 
                        (
                        SELECT
                                cp.equity_ticker,
                                d.report_year,
                                d.report_quarter,
                                d.data_value AS vcsh,
                                cdc.company_profile_id,
                                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                                        PARTITION BY
                                                d.company_profile_id,
                                                d.report_year,
                                                d.report_quarter
                                        ORDER BY
                                                d.updated_date DESC NULLS LAST,
                                                d.created_date DESC
                                ) AS rn
                        FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
                        JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp
                                ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
                        JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d
                                ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
                           AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
                           AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
                        JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc
                                ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
                           AND rc.financial_statement_cd = cdc.statement_cd
                        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr
                                ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
                           AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rcol
                                ON rcol.col_cd = d.col_cd
                           AND rcol.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                        WHERE rcol.col_desc = '1'
                          AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                          AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
                          AND (
                                  (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) IN ('DN', 'BH')
                                   AND rr.row_desc = '400')
                                  OR (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD'
                                          AND rr.row_desc = '500')
                          )
                ) x
                WHERE rn = 1
        )
        WHERE rn= 1
                )

column3: Giao dịch & thanh khoản
column17:
TRADE_BOOK_HOSE:
 kl_nn_mua: Execution - Volume (điều kiện: Buy - Foreigner Investor type IN ('10','20'))
 kl_nn_ban: Execution - Volume (điều kiện: Sell - Foreigner Investor type IN ('10','20'))
 Trade_HNX:
 kl_nn_mua: Trade quantity (điều kiện: Buy Foreign Investor Type Code type IN ('10','20'))
 kl_nn_ban: Trade quantity (điều kiện: Sell Foreign Investor Type Code IN ('10','20'))
column18: Market ID in (UPX,STX,STO)
column19:
SELECT
  t.[Issue Code] AS symbol,
  t.[Trade date] AS ngay_gd,
 1. HNX:
  -- KL NN mua: dòng mà BÊN MUA là nước ngoài
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Buy Foreign Investor Type Code] IN ('10','20')
  THEN t.[Trade quantity] ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_mua,
 
  -- KL NN bán: dòng mà BÊN BÁN là nước ngoài
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Sell Foreign Investor Type Code] IN ('10','20')
  THEN t.[Trade quantity] ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_ban,
 
  -- KLNN ròng = mua - bán
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Buy Foreign Investor Type Code] IN ('10','20')
  THEN t.[Trade quantity] ELSE 0 END)
  - SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Sell Foreign Investor Type Code] IN ('10','20')
  THEN t.[Trade quantity] ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_rong
 
 FROM Trade_HNX t
 WHERE t.[Trade date] = :ngay_gd
  AND t.[Market ID] IN ('STX','UPX') -- HNX niêm yết + UPCOM, loại trừ DVX/BDX/HCX
 GROUP BY t.[Issue Code], t.[Trade date];
 2.HOSE
 SELECT
  t.Symbol,
  t.[Trade Date] AS ngay_gd,
 
  -- KL NN mua: dòng mà BÊN MUA là nước ngoài
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Buy - Foreigner Investor type] IN ('10','20')
  THEN t.[Execution - Volume] ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_mua,
 
  -- KL NN bán: dòng mà BÊN BÁN là nước ngoài

  - HOSE: Buy/Sell - Client/House Classification Code = '30'

column19:
-- GT tự doanh ròng (HOSE + HNX)
 WITH tu_doanh AS (
  -- HOSE
  SELECT t.Symbol AS ma_ck, t.[Trade Date] AS ngay_gd,
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Buy - Client/House Classification Code]='30'
  THEN t.[Execution - Value] ELSE 0 END) AS gt_mua,
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Sell - Client/House Classification Code]='30'
  THEN t.[Execution - Value] ELSE 0 END) AS gt_ban
  FROM TRADE_BOOK_HOSE t
  WHERE t.[Trade Date]=:ngay_gd AND t.[Market ID]='STO'
  GROUP BY t.Symbol, t.[Trade Date]
 
  UNION ALL
 
  -- HNX / UPCOM
  SELECT t.[Issue Code], t.[Trade date],
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Buy client/house classification]='30'
  THEN CAST(t.[Trade price] AS NUMERIC)
  * CAST(t.[Trade quantity] AS NUMERIC)
  ELSE 0 END) AS gt_mua,
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Sell client/house classification]='30'
  THEN CAST(t.[Trade price] AS NUMERIC)
  * CAST(t.[Trade quantity] AS NUMERIC)
  ELSE 0 END) AS gt_ban
  FROM Trade_HNX t
  WHERE t.[Trade date]=:ngay_gd AND t.[Market ID] IN ('STX','UPX')
  GROUP BY t.[Issue Code], t.[Trade date]
 )
 SELECT ma_ck, ngay_gd,
  SUM(gt_mua) AS gt_tudoanh_mua,
  SUM(gt_ban) AS gt_tudoanh_ban,
  SUM(gt_mua)-SUM(gt_ban) AS gt_tudoanh_rong
 FROM tu_doanh
 GROUP BY ma_ck, ngay_gd;

WITH
Tham_so AS (
    SELECT
        TO_DATE(:tu_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD') AS tu_ngay,
        TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD') AS den_ngay
    FROM DUAL
),
/* EOD từng mã; lấy snapshot cuối cùng trong ngày */
Gia_EOD AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        ngay_gd,
        gia_dong_cua,
		floorCode
    FROM (
        SELECT
            s.symbol,
            TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay_gd,
			floorCode,
            s.closePrice AS gia_dong_cua,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY s.symbol, s.tradingdate
                ORDER BY s.INDEXTIME DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR s
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') <= ts.den_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* Giá đóng cửa phiên gần nhất trước ngày bắt đầu */
Gia_dau AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        gia_dong_cua AS gia_dau
    FROM (
        SELECT
            g.symbol,
            g.gia_dong_cua,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY g.symbol
                ORDER BY g.ngay_gd DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Gia_EOD g
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE g.ngay_gd < ts.tu_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* Giá đóng cửa phiên gần nhất tại hoặc trước ngày kết thúc */
Gia_cuoi AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        gia_dong_cua,
        ngay_gd AS ngay_gia_cuoi,
		floorCode
    FROM (
        SELECT
            g.symbol,
            g.gia_dong_cua,
            g.ngay_gd,
			g.floorCode,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY g.symbol
                ORDER BY g.ngay_gd DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Gia_EOD g
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE g.ngay_gd <= ts.den_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* KLLH gần nhất có hiệu lực tại ngày kết thúc */
KLLH_asof AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        so_luong_cp_luu_hanh
    FROM (
        SELECT
            t.MCK AS symbol,
            t."Khối lượng chứng khoán đang lưu hành"
                AS so_luong_cp_luu_hanh,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY t.MCK
                ORDER BY TO_DATE(t."Ngày báo cáo", 'DD/MM/YYYY') DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM "BM 1_Báo cáo về khối lượng chứng khoán đang lưu hành" t
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE t.Loai_CK = 'Co phieu'
          AND TO_DATE(t."Ngày báo cáo", 'DD/MM/YYYY') <= ts.den_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
Von_hoa AS (
    SELECT
        gc.symbol,
        gc.gia_dong_cua AS gia_cuoi,
        k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh AS kllh,
        CASE
            WHEN gc.gia_dong_cua IS NOT NULL
             AND k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh IS NOT NULL
            THEN gc.gia_dong_cua * k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh
        END AS von_hoa
    FROM Gia_cuoi gc
    LEFT JOIN KLLH_asof k
        ON k.symbol = gc.symbol
),
Nganh AS (
    SELECT
        cp.equity_ticker,
        c.industry_name
    FROM gms_ids_uat.categories c
    JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp
        ON cp.category_l1_id = c.id
    WHERE c.active_flg = 1
),
Chi_so_thi_truong AS
(
    SELECT 
        idx.Symbol AS symbol,
        m.MARKETCODE AS bo_chi_so_thi_truong
    FROM JAD_CSIDXINFOR idx
    JOIN JAD_MARKETINFOR m ON m.MARKETCODE = idx.INDEXCODE
    WHERE m.MARKETCODE IN ('HOSE','UPCOM','HNX')
),
Chi_so_nganh AS
(
    SELECT 
        idx.Symbol AS symbol,
        m.MARKETCODE AS bo_chi_so_nganh
    FROM JAD_CSIDXINFOR idx
    JOIN JAD_MARKETINFOR m ON m.MARKETCODE = idx.INDEXCODE
     WHERE m.MARKETCODE NOT IN ('HOSE','UPCOM','HNX')
)
/* BƯỚC 1:
   Xác định đúng 1 company_data cho mỗi NNT + kỳ:
   - Kỳ phải tồn tại trong violation_report với base_date <= :den_ngay
   - company_data phải APPROVED
   - Chỉ lấy HN/TH/ME/RI
   - Ưu tiên loại báo cáo: HN -> TH -> ME -> RI
   - Trong cùng loại báo cáo: lấy submission_date mới nhất
*/
Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd,
        submission_date
        ,SUBSTR(form_cd,1,2) STATEMENT_CD
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY CASE 	WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
							END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM gms_ids_uat.company_data cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND f.form_cd LIKE '%QUAR'
          AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM gms_ids_uat.violation_report vr
			  JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf ON vf.id = vr.form_id AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
              WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year
                AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                AND vr.base_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
				
          )
		  AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')
		  AND cd.submission_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
		  AND vr.LANGUAGE_CD = 'VI'
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
--SELECT * FROM Company_data_chuan 
--WHERE 1=1 
--AND company_profile_id = '1591';
/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 2:
   - Từ các kỳ hợp lệ ở trên, lấy LNST trong DATA
   - DATA join bằng: company_profile_id + report_year + report_quarter
   - Chỉ các kỳ thực sự có LNST mới tồn tại ở đây
   - Xếp thứ tự và lấy 4 kỳ LNST gần nhất
   ========================================================= */
LNST_4_ky AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        lnst
    FROM (
        SELECT x.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id ORDER BY x.report_year DESC, x.report_quarter DESC ) AS rn     
        FROM (
            SELECT
                cdc.company_profile_id,
                cp.equity_ticker,
                cdc.report_year,
                cdc.report_quarter,
                d.data_value AS lnst
                ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY d.company_profile_id, d.report_year, d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY d.UPDATED_DATE DESC NULLS LAST, d.CREATED_DATE DESC
            ) AS rn1
            FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
               AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
               AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
               AND cdc.STATEMENT_CD = rc.FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD 
			JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
            WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
              AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
              AND (
                     ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'DN' AND rr.row_desc = '60' )
                  OR ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'BH' AND rr.row_desc = '60' )
                  OR ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD' AND rr.row_desc = '21' )
              )
              /* kỳ phải thực sự có giá trị LNST */
              AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
--              AND cp.equity_ticker = 'HVN'
        ) x
        WHERE x.rn1 = 1
    )
    WHERE rn <= 4
),
lnst_ttm AS
(
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker symbol,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 4 THEN SUM(lnst) END AS lnst_ttm
    FROM LNST_4_ky
    WHERE 1=1
--    AND equity_ticker = 'HVN'
    GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker
/* Một giá trị VCSH cho mỗi mã/kỳ */
),
VCSH_quy AS (
    SELECT
        equity_ticker symbol,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        vcsh,
        company_profile_id
    FROM (
        SELECT x.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id ORDER BY x.report_year DESC, x.report_quarter DESC ) AS rn1   
        FROM 
        (
        SELECT
            cp.equity_ticker,
            d.report_year,
            d.report_quarter,
            d.data_value AS vcsh,
            cdc.company_profile_id,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    d.company_profile_id,
                    d.report_year,
                    d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY
                    d.updated_date DESC NULLS LAST,
                    d.created_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp
            ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d
            ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
           AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
           AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc
            ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
           AND rc.financial_statement_cd = cdc.statement_cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr
            ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
           AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rcol
            ON rcol.col_cd = d.col_cd
           AND rcol.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        WHERE rcol.col_desc = '1'
          AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
          AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
          AND (
              (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) IN ('DN', 'BH')
               AND rr.row_desc = '400')
              OR (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD'
                  AND rr.row_desc = '500')
          )
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1
)
WHERE rn1 = 1
    )
,Giao_dich_NN_goc AS (
    SELECT
        t.symbol,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.buy_foreigner_investor_type IN ('10', '20')
                THEN t.execution_volume
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS kl_mua,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.sell_foreigner_investor_type IN ('10', '20')
                THEN t.execution_volume
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS kl_ban,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.buy_foreigner_investor_type IN ('10', '20')
                THEN t.execution_value
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS gt_mua,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.sell_foreigner_investor_type IN ('10', '20')
                THEN t.execution_value
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS gt_ban
    FROM krx.trade_book_hose t
    CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
    WHERE TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
          BETWEEN ts.tu_ngay AND ts.den_ngay
      AND t.market_id = 'STK'
    GROUP BY t.symbol

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        t."Issue Code" AS symbol,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.buy_foreign_investor_type_code IN ('10', '20')
                THEN t.trade_quantity
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS kl_mua,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.sell_foreign_investor_type_code IN ('10', '20')
                THEN t.trade_quantity
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS kl_ban,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.buy_foreign_investor_type_code IN ('10', '20')
                THEN t.trade_value
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS gt_mua,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.sell_foreign_investor_type_code IN ('10', '20')
                THEN t.trade_value
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS gt_ban
    FROM krx.trade_book_hnx t
    CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
    WHERE TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
          BETWEEN ts.tu_ngay AND ts.den_ngay
      AND t.market_id IN ('STX', 'UPX')
    GROUP BY t."Issue Code"
),

NDTNN AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        SUM(kl_mua) AS kl_mua,
        SUM(kl_ban) AS kl_ban,
        SUM(kl_mua) - SUM(kl_ban) AS kl_rong,
        SUM(gt_mua) AS gt_mua,
        SUM(gt_ban) AS gt_ban,
        SUM(gt_mua) - SUM(gt_ban) AS gt_rong
    FROM Giao_dich_NN_goc
    GROUP BY symbol
),

Xep_hang_NDTNN AS (
    SELECT
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN :loai_top = 'MUA_RONG' THEN nd.gt_rong
                END DESC NULLS LAST,

                CASE
                    WHEN :loai_top = 'BAN_RONG' THEN nd.gt_rong
                END ASC NULLS LAST,

                nd.symbol
        ) AS stt,

        nd.symbol AS ma,

        CASE
            WHEN gc.floorcode = '10' THEN 'HOSE'
            WHEN gc.floorcode = '02' THEN 'HNX'
            WHEN gc.floorcode = '04' THEN 'UPCOM'
            ELSE gc.floorcode
        END AS san,

        ng.industry_name AS nganh,
        gc.gia_dong_cua,
        gc.gia_dong_cua - gd.gia_dau AS thay_doi,

        ROUND(
            (gc.gia_dong_cua - gd.gia_dau)
            / NULLIF(gd.gia_dau, 0) * 100,
            2
        ) AS phan_tram_thay_doi,

        nd.kl_mua,
        nd.kl_ban,
        nd.kl_rong,
        nd.gt_mua,
        nd.gt_ban,
        nd.gt_rong,

        vh.von_hoa,
        ROUND(vh.von_hoa / NULLIF(lt.lnst_ttm, 0), 2) AS pe,
        ROUND(vh.von_hoa / NULLIF(vm.vcsh, 0), 2) AS pb
    FROM NDTNN nd
    LEFT JOIN Gia_cuoi gc
        ON gc.symbol = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN Gia_dau gd
        ON gd.symbol = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN Von_hoa vh
        ON vh.symbol = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN Nganh ng
        ON ng.equity_ticker = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN LNST_TTM lt
        ON lt.equity_ticker = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN VCSH_moi_nhat vm
        ON vm.equity_ticker = nd.symbol
    WHERE (:loai_top = 'MUA_RONG' AND nd.gt_rong > 0)
       OR (:loai_top = 'BAN_RONG' AND nd.gt_rong < 0)
)

SELECT
    stt,
    ma,
    san,
    nganh,
    gia_dong_cua,
    thay_doi,
    phan_tram_thay_doi,
    kl_mua,
    kl_ban,
    kl_rong,
    gt_mua,
    gt_ban,
    gt_rong,
    von_hoa,
    pe,
    pb
FROM Xep_hang_NDTNN
WHERE stt <= :top_n
ORDER BY stt;

-- Bước 1: Lấy danh sách mã thuộc rổ chỉ số từ JAD_CSIDXINFOR 
 -- Bước 2: Tính KLNN ròng từ TRADE_BOOK_HOSE/Trade_HNX, lọc theo mã thuộc rổ 
 with HNX as 
 ( 
 SELECT 
 t.[Trade Date] AS ngay_gd, 
 t.indexCode, 
 -- KL NN mua: dòng mà BÊN MUA là nước ngoài 
 SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Buy Foreign Investor Type Code] IN ('10','20') 
 THEN t.[Trade quantity] ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_mua, 
 
 -- KL NN bán: dòng mà BÊN BÁN là nước ngoài 
 SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Sell Foreign Investor Type Code] IN ('10','20') 
 THEN t.[Trade quantity] ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_ban, 
 
 FROM Trade_HNX t 
 JOIN JAD_CSIDXINFOR idx 
 ON t.Symbol = idx.symbol 
 WHERE t.[Trade date] = :ngay_gd 
 AND t.[Market ID] IN ('STX','UPX') -- HNX niêm yết + UPCOM, loại trừ DVX/BDX/HCX 
 GROUP BY t.[Issue Code], t.[Trade date] 
 ) 
 ,Hose as 
 ( 
 SELECT 
 t.[Trade Date] AS ngay_gd, 
 t.indexCode, 
 
 -- KL NN mua: dòng mà BÊN MUA là nước ngoài 
 SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Buy - Foreigner Investor type] IN ('10','20') 
 THEN t.[Execution - Volume] ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_mua, 
 
 -- KL NN bán: dòng mà BÊN BÁN là nước ngoài 
 SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Sell - Foreigner Investor type] IN ('10','20') 
 THEN t.[Execution - Volume] ELSE 0 END) AS kl_nn_ban, 
 FROM TRADE_BOOK_HOSE t 
 JOIN JAD_CSIDXINFOR idx 
 ON t.Symbol = idx.symbol 
 WHERE t.[Trade Date] = :ngay_gd 
 AND t.[Market ID] = 'STO' 
 GROUP BY t.indexCode, t.[Trade Date] 
 ) 
 SELECT 
 indexCode, 
 kl_nn_mua, 
 kl_nn_ban, 
 (kl_nn_mua - kl_nn_ban) AS kl_nn_rong 
 FROM (SELECT * FROM HNX UNION ALL SELECT * FROM HOSE)
